abstract: Business People may not be aware of the complex SQL writing skills. To convert the business requirements into SQL queries, which can be timeconsuming and error-prone. So, we decided to resolve this problem through developing a software to convert a text or voice to SQL query using Natural Language Processing. To form an SQL query from natural language processing, Parse the natural language input to extract the relevant information. This might involve tokenizing the input, identifying the parts of speech, and extracting nouns, verbs, and other important elements. • Map the extracted information to the appropriate SQL keywords and clauses. For example, a verb like “select” might map to the SQL SELECTkeyword, and a noun like “employees” might map to a table name. Use the extracted information to construct an SQL query. This might involve building the query string piece by piece, using the mapped keywords and clauses as well as any additional conditions or filters that were specified in the natural language input. • Test and refine the query to ensure that it is correct and returns the expected results. This might involve trying the query out on a test database or adding additional processing steps to handle edge cases or ambiguities in the input. • NLP models can be difficult to design and implement: Building an NLP system that can accurately understand and generate SQL queries canbe a challenging task, requiring specialized knowledge and expertise.

articleTitle: Portable DC Mixer Grinder
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Appliance with DC supply provides effective way to use limited energy. Mixer grinder is operated with universal motor and works with 230V 1-phase AC supply. The majority of household appliances use DC power internally. A dc motor-powered mixer-grinder can be an effective volition to these coventional mixer- grinders. As a part of our ongoing efforts to improve efficiency and ensure robust and user-friendly control, we are currently exploring the potential utilization of DC motors in this operation. AC -DC &DC-AC conversion are avoided thereby preventing the losses at each stage of conversion. As a result energy obtained from sustainable sources can be used effectively.

Author Keywords: DC- AC and AC- DC conversion

articleTitle: Plastic Collection Bank and Waste Segregation
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Plastic pollution is a critical global concern necessitating innovative and eco-friendly solutions. In this context, we introduce the “Plastic Collection Bank and Waste Segregation” initiative, a transformative approach to plastic waste management. Central to our system are advanced “Smart Bins,” integrating infrared sensors and weighing machines for autonomous and precise segregation of plastic waste into recyclable plastics, non-recyclable plastics, and non-plastics categories. To encourage community engagement, we have implemented a QR scanner-driven incentive scheme, rewarding users based on their contribution to recyclable plastics. This initiative transforms waste disposal into a gratifying and responsible endeavor, fostering environmental consciousness within communities. Transparency and real-time accessibility are ensured through our intuitive online platform, which provides current data on plastic waste levels, recycling metrics, and collaborations with recycling industries. This transparency enhances trust and accountability, pivotal factors in stimulating community participation. The “Plastic Collection Bank and Waste Segregation” initiative aims to achieve efficient waste segregation, elevate community involvement, and promote sustainable recycling practices. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, encouraging active participation, and ensuring transparency, our initiative contributes significantly to combating plastic pollution and fostering a greener, more sustainable future

articleTitle: Detection of Lung Cancer Using Watershed Algorithm and CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Lung cancer is a serious public health issue that requires better early detection. To establish a novel framework for lung cancer detection, we combine the Watershed Algorithm for feature extraction with the VGG-16 Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture. This comprehensive system has the potential to improve diagnosis accuracy. An advanced feature extraction method, the Watershed Algorithm, segments lung areas while maintaining small features, reducing data loss during preprocessing. These segments are fed into the CNN VGG-16, which is well-known for recognizing complex patterns. To detect small lung anomalies, we fine-tune and train it using a huge dataset of lung CT scans. Our method, which incorporates the Watershed Algorithm and CNN VGG-16, provides a realistic way for early lung cancer diagnosis.

articleTitle: Tech Trash - A Smart Dustbin
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The creation of an intelligent, eco-friendly trash can that will help keep the environment clean is the major objective of the project. Motivated by Swachh Bharat Mission. Making a smart trashcan powered by Arduino would help maintain a clean environment in this day and age where technology is advancing every day. The microcontroller-based technology that drives this clever garbage can management system includes the ultrasonic sensors on the trashcan. A neglected trash can can contaminate the air and create an unhealthy atmosphere, which can be harmful to human health. The dustbin is free of hands. distinguishes between biodegradable, non-biodegradable, and electronic trash. Sends an alert notification to the trash collector appointed to that region. Degrade the biodegradable waste inside the dustbin, compressor in-order to compress and have more space inside the Dustbin. Generates power through the heat which is produced during the decomposition process of the biodegradable wastes and with the help of load cells.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Real-Time Speech-to-Speech Translation for Virtual Meetings Using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In our interconnected world, language diversity poses communication challenges, particularly in virtual meetings. Our solution, a Real-Time Speech-to-Speech Translation system for Virtual Meetings, bridges these gaps. It captures speech in one language, providing clear and understandable translations in real-time during virtual meetings. By seamlessly integrating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Machine Translation (MT), and Text-to-Speech (TTS) components, this system transcends language barriers, enabling participants to engage effortlessly and effectively in multilingual virtual interactions. It's more than text; it fosters spoken interaction, revolutionizing cross-lingual communication in virtual meetings. Applications abound, from enhancing global business negotiations to aiding virtual travelers and connecting educators to broader international audiences of diverse languages in virtual educational platforms. In an era where virtual communication is paramount, our project empowers meaningful connections, proving technology's remarkable ability to unite people and transcend language barriers in virtual settings worldwide.

articleTitle: Behavioral Analysis of Dog using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Machine learning is a dynamic field enabling computers to learn from historical data via diverse algorithms, applicable in image recognition, voice ID, email filtering, and more. In veterinary research and animal welfare, behavioural analysis of companion animals is vital. This article provides a brief overview of the evolving role of machine learning in analysing and understanding dog behaviour. With the use of ML (machine learning) algorithms and advanced data, scientist can better understand dog behaviour to improve their health and interactions with humans. This review covers data collection techniques, extraction techniques, and potential applications and summarizes the broad perspectives of the field. Machine learning in behaviour analysis promises to transform our understanding of dog behaviour by providing researchers and practitioners with effective tools to assess and improve dog health and promote healthy interactions between dogs and humans. For those interested in the intersection of machine learning and dog behaviour analysis, this brief summary is useful and provides insight into the growth and impact of a promising field.

articleTitle: Seed Sprinkling Agribot with Irrigation Processor
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Seed Sprinkling AgriBot with Irrigation Processor is an agricultural robot modeled for various useful purpose in agriculture. The most recent trends in the development of agricultural machinery in the twenty first century all based on intelligent automation. Almost all the countries worldwide created numerous models of agribots that have been developed and employed in the agricultural field to increase the production enormously. The proposed Bot is designed to do the process such as, soil ploughing, digging and closing the soil to sowing seed, irrigating the entire field, proper spraying of fertilizers and pesticides. The bot is designed in such a way that can be operated manually and automatically. Robots are specifically manufactured to increase the repetitive working efficiency thereby reducing the complexity of human task. The fisrt and foremost step in farming is seeding which is carried out in the rows and columns of the farming plot with equal spacing distance. The next process is irrigation, wherein water need to be sparyed initially and gradually increase the amount of water as when the plant grows. Spraying of fertilizer and pesticides also as the same process as irrigation but these need to be supplied after germination and the crops begin to grow.

articleTitle: Virtual Personal Assistant by Using Hand Gesture and Voice Assistant for Disabilities
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In the 21st-century voice assistant usage has increased among people to make ease their work. It helps in several task to overcome our day to day consequences over the user commands. Unfortunately, it does not help people with speech disorder which makes them lack confidence and create social anxiety. So, implementing hand sign recognition over the voice assistant helps differently abled people to overcome their consequences. Implementing hand sign language over virtual assistants there are various measurements of hands has to be recognised since the user may be in early childhood (puerile), Childhood (puer) stage, Adolescence stage (adolescents), Youth (juvenis), Maturity (Vir) Ageing (senior), Old age (senex) or the user may have any genetic disorder like gigantism, drafts, Down syndrome, Turner syndrome, 3M syndrome etc which may affect the recognition of the software. Several queries have been made in the survey to increase the success rate of the application. On an average approximation of 72 to 76 over 100 man have the fear of public speaking. It makes inconvenient like using voice assistance before colleagues which can be overcome by implementing hand recognition.

articleTitle: Insect Identification in Field Crops Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In recent times, many individuals have been leaving the agricultural sector due to challenging environmental conditions and meager income prospects. However, there is a growing interest among the younger generation in pursuing farming, despite their limited knowledge in the field. To support this resurgence in agriculture, an innovative application and website have been developed for insect identification and classification. This technology aims to empower Indian farmers who struggle with detecting pests that harm paddy crops, a significant contributor to crop damage and yield loss. By utilizing shape features and machine learning techniques, a proposed algorithm combines foreground extraction, contour identification, and a CNN model to effectively identify pests like Tissueborers, Gundhi bugs, and Paddy Gall flies within the intricate backgrounds of paddy fields. This pest detection method offers faster computation times and high accuracy, enabling the early identification of insects during paddy crop growth. Ultimately, by preventing insect-related damage, this approach has the potential to boost both crop yield and quality, leading to enhanced agricultural productivity.

articleTitle: ESP-8266-Based Indoor Localization System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Although the indoor positioning system (IPS) has advanced greatly in recent years, no solution has become standardized. Wi-Fi technology is the system that is utilized in many public settings, and the solution we suggest in this dissertation would not involve changing the infrastructure—rather, it would only need to be reused and improved. Considering the existing five-meter Global Positioning System (GPS) precision, this method is reasonably precise and low-cost. A motorized directional antenna prototype employing the signal strength of two ESP8266s is designed in this dissertation. These position readings are computed and displayed using an ESP8266 Wi-Fi enabled device and a micro controller. For Internet of Things applications, one of the most widely used devices is the WiFi serial transceiver module ESP8266. It includes readings from the module's Received Signal Strength Indicator. This study analyses the characteristically obtained Received Signal Strength Indicator readings using the ESP8266 WiFi serial transceiver module. The objective is to look into the possible future applications of the Received Signal Strength Indicator value as a separate, stand-alone parameter for use in a range of applications, especially in the Internet of Things domain. Understanding the characteristics of Received Signal Strength Indicator readings and how they might be used in a variety of other scenarios has been made possible by the findings.

articleTitle: SPYBOT: Unmanned Surveillance Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The concept of an unmanned Spybot, controllable remotely via a web-based interface and capable of streaming surveillance data over a WiFi network, showcases advancements in robotics and communication technologies. While it may have practical applications in military and security fields, several complex issues must be addressed. Privacy concerns loom large, as covert surveillance in public or private spaces can infringe upon individual rights and raise ethical questions. Legal implications also come into play, as the deployment of such technology must comply with jurisdiction-specific laws and regulations. Security vulnerabilities pose a significant risk, potentially enabling malicious actors to hijack the Spybot or intercept sensitive data. The technical challenges of creating a reliable and secure system for remote control and data streaming cannot be understated, demanding rigorous testing and safeguards. Regulatory approval, safety considerations, and adherence to data protection laws are crucial elements of responsible development and deployment. Moreover, accountability for the actions of the Spybot and the handling of collected data must be clearly defined. Building public trust through transparency and collaboration with experts in law, ethics, and cybersecurity is essential for responsible innovation. Balancing technological progress with ethical, legal, and security considerations is paramount when pursuing projects of this nature.

articleTitle: Swachh Surveillance Drobot Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The suggested approach employs a deep neural network to recognize garbage and locate it precisely and autonomously. A unique navigation method is also suggested to guide the robot's progress using ground segmentation using a deep neural network. Thanks to the waste levels and automatic navigation features, the robotic arm can quickly and accurately pick up trash from the floor in locations like parks or schools thanks to the waste levels and automatic navigation features. According to research results, the accuracy of garbage recognition can reach up to 95%, and even without route planning, the navigation approach can achieve virtually the same cleaning performance as traditional techniques. Therefore, the proposed robot can be an incredible aid in reducing physical labour for tasks related to rubbish collection.

articleTitle: Visual-Inertial Mapping, Localization and Planning for Autonomous Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Navigation has long been used to determine one's position, location, and path to an object. It provides precise information on the location of a certain place or object. Though there have been several changes and improvements to navigation, there have also been rumours of making it autonomous. This indicates that navigation occurs automatically and without human assistance. The device will understand where it's going and how to get there. Visual odometry (VO) is a key term in this context. It calculates the relative positions of two picture pairs. Similarly, the mobile robot's location is studied. However, there is an issue here. Noise rise (drift error) causes VO to worsen with time. To address this, the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) was invented. The IMU consists of accelerometers, gyroscopes, and magnetometers. These produce more accurate findings and aid in noise reduction. The IMU and VO are coupled to generate Visual Inertial Odometry (VIO). An Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) is used to integrate the VIO and GPS for more accurate localization on a local and global scale. Stereo disparity estimation generates a depth sensation map, which is then converted into a 2D occupancy grid map to detect impediments. To avoid obstacles, local path planning generates temporary waypoints, and a waypoint follower directs the device/robot towards the goal.

articleTitle: DETR-DC5 Approaches for Improved Spatial Object Detection in Satellite Imagery
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Satellite spatial object detection is crucial for urban planning, environmental monitoring, and catastrophe management. The DETR-DC5 (Data Efficient Transformer with DC5 Backbone) is a cutting-edge object detection model. This study introduces DETR-DC5 framework-based satellite spatial object detection improvements. DETR-DC5's strengths are used to improve feature extraction and post-processing. First, a specific feature augmentation technique extracts richer and more discriminative spatial features to let the model capture subtle object attributes. Second, a semi-supervised learning training technique is used to address the lack of labeled satellite imagery data and improve the model's generalization. A new satellite imagery post-processing refining method uses non-maximum suppression methods. This refinement stage reduces false positives and improves localization, especially in densely populated metropolitan regions and complicated natural surroundings. On benchmark satellite imagery datasets, the suggested methods outperform baseline DETR-DC5 models in spatial object detection. Experimental findings indicate significant improvements in precision, recall, and F1-score, proving the upgrades work. This study uses the DETR-DC5 architecture, targeted feature augmentation, semi-supervised training, and refined post-processing algorithms to recognize spatial objects in satellite data. These techniques have the potential to dramatically improve satellite-based object detection, which has implications for urban planning, environmental monitoring, and disaster response.

articleTitle: Currency Detector For Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The currency has a great meaning in everyday life.Almost each of us using the Currency notes in our day to day lives through Cash or online Payment. Thus currency recognisation has gained a great interest for many researchers across the varoius part of the globe. Currency Identification System is an important area of processing of the image. This is used worldwide for various purposes. Our project aims to develop an intelligent system for recognizing Indian paper currency, which has diverse applications in electronic banking, currency monitoring systems, money exchange machines, and other related fields. With the rise of modern currency automation systems, the ability to accurately identify and process paper currency is becoming increasingly important. By leveraging advanced computer vision and machine learning techniques, we hope to create a system that can quickly and accurately recognize Indian paper currency, enabling it to be used in a range of applications. This project is essential to addressing the current needs of currency automation systems and has the potential to make a significant impact on various industries. In this project We are using Opencv(Open Computer Vision) which is a Image Processing libraray, the Approach is correlation technique is applied to extract Gandhiji images and Thin Strip, and forming clusters of featuresIt is a very helpful system for blind people toknow the denomination on the paper currency

articleTitle: Agriculture Land Connect: A Platform for Efficient Agricultural Land Rental and Smart Farming
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Food, as a fundamental necessity, plays a pivotal role in our lives. However, the world grapples with mounting agricultural challenges, including soaring food prices and limited access to arable land. In response to these pressing issues, Agriculture Land Connect emerges as an innovative web-based platform. It not only streamlines agricultural land rental processes and advocates sustainable farming practices but also provides guidance on optimizing farming based on soil type, climatic conditions, and seasonal variations. The platform's core objectives encompass reducing food prices, improving food accessibility, and empowering farmers with insights into soil quality and eco-friendly farming practices. Offering a comprehensive suite of features, including user management, detailed land listings, robust search capabilities, secure payments, efficient administration, and a feedback system, the platform extends its impact beyond agriculture by highlighting technology's potential to revolutionize traditional industries. As we continue to expand and accumulate data, the platform's contribution to efficient land use, enhanced yields, and responsible farming practices will become increasingly apparent.

articleTitle: Site-Specific Crop Management
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Machine learning (ML) is an emerging technology in which both researchers and academic communities have been able to obtain a distinct range of numerous applications such as image recognition, healthcare, fraud detection, and so on. In addition to this, ML algorithms have been identified for prediction, classification, and other purposes. On the contrary, agriculture plays an important role in a country's economy. Further crop yield is mainly affected by diverse factors like types of soil, temperature, moisture, and rainfall. Moreover, the crops are not evenly distributed in an agricultural field restricting the possibility of complete utilization of the field. Even modern technology like artificial intelligence(AI), ML, and the Internet of Things(IOT) help to overcome problems related to agricultural aspects. Therefore ML is reliable, suitable and well developed, which are not utilized properly by farmers. The proposed research work is to predict the crop yield of a given area and map the yield distribution using an ML algorithm through the Random Forest (RF) mechanism. RF approach is a widely used supervised learning technique that may be applied to regression and classification problems. Hence crop yield prediction is carried out by analyzing data on various factors affecting agriculture like temperature, soil type, moisture, etc. Subsequently, the main motivation of this research is to build an interactive user-friendly interface for the farmers which provides the yield map distinguishing the yield rate in a given field along with suggestions for the better utilization of the low-yielding areas.

articleTitle: Unveiling Hidden Patterns: Exploration of Data Dependencies in Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In the current scenario, the possibility of getting affected by disease is high so it is important to predict in advance. Due to technological advancement, it is for early prediction. Hence, this paper is focused on analysis of various DL algorithms for prediction system. This work provides a comprehensive report for the disease prediction system with the analysis of test input parameters for different disease. Further, different algorithms useful for the prediction framework has been discussed. Studying the interdependence of these risk factors in patients' medical records and comprehending their respective contributions to stroke prediction is critical. Deep learning techniques are crucial in overcoming these issues since they enable automatic disease identification in healthcare facilities. The prediction framework is analyzed using data from the Electronic Health Record dataset. Parametric statistics are used to evaluate the results.

articleTitle: Third Eye
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This abstract presents an innovative approach to assist blind individuals in perceiving their surroundings through the integration of ultrasonic sensors and face recognition technology. By providing real-time object detection and facial recognition capabilities, the suggested system intends to improve the independence and mobility of visually impaired individuals. Ultrasonic sensors are utilized to detect objects within the user's vicinity. By emitting ultrasonic waves and analyzing the reflected signals, the system can determine the distance and approximate size of objects in the surrounding environment. This information is then translated into auditory or tactile feedback to provide the user with a comprehensive understanding of their surroundings. In addition to object detection, the system incorporates face recognition technology to enable blind individuals to recognize and identify people they encounter. Using a combination of image processing algorithms and machine learning techniques, facial features are analyzed, matched against a pre-existing database, and communicated to the user in a non-visual format.

articleTitle: Smart Traffic Control System with Ambulance Detection Using Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In densely populated urban environments, the rapid and efficient passage of emergency vehicles, such as ambulances, is paramount to saving lives. This abstract introduces a cutting-edge approach to enhance traffic management and emergency response by leveraging signal processing techniques for real-time ambulance detection and priority routing. A timely response during emergencies, especially for ambulances, depends on effective traffic management. This study describes a smart traffic control system that can identify and rank ambulance vehicles in traffic using signal processing techniques. To analyze real-time traffic data from various sources, including cameras and sensors, the proposed system makes use of sophisticated signal processing algorithms. Rapid identification of emergency vehicles is made possible by ambulance detection, which is accomplished through image processing and pattern recognition. When an ambulance is detected, the traffic control system dynamically modifies the timing of the traffic signals to allow the ambulance to pass quickly through the busy roads. This clever traffic control system not only speeds up overall traffic flow efficiency and reduces response times for emergency vehicles. This proposed system includes the process of data collection and processing, ambulance detection, pattern recognition and classification, dynamic traffic control light adjustment. The proposed intelligent traffic control system improves overall traffic flow efficiency while also speeding up emergency vehicle response times. The effectiveness of the system in optimizing urban transportation systems for both emergency situations and routine traffic scenarios is shown by experimental results.

articleTitle: Alcohol Detection and Theft Alert System for Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Our project deals with two major problems that are facing vehicle users right now. One is Vehicle theft. It has rapidly increased in our country. Another problem is drunken driving. Drunken driving is the major cause of road accidents because driving under the influence of alcohol reduces the driver's perception and vehicle control. Manual checking of alcohol using a breathalyzer is done by the police to reduce the problem. However, this method has very little effect as it is not possible to check if every driver is under the influence of alcohol. Another aspect of this project is theft detection. Once the vehicle is stolen, the owner cannot track the vehicle. They do not know where to find the vehicle and the chances of getting their vehicle back are very low. It is so hard to track the vehicle when there is no evidence. This system will keep tabs on and track the whereabouts of the vehicle.

articleTitle: Iot Based Health Monitoring System for Disabled and Senior Citizens
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Researchers and healthcare professionals are getting more and more interested in patient health monitoring systems. Every fifteenth second, the wheelchair structure can measure the patient's physiological parameters. This system is in charge of taking an ECG, measuring the patient's body temperature, and monitoring their heart rate before sending the information via the WIFI-Module to the cloud-based Internet of Things platform. The cloud stores the patient's health information. Medical experts or authorized individuals can continuously check the patient's health status on the cloud server, enabling them to track the patient's health state. The findings of this study offer patients access to appropriate and effective medical facilities.

articleTitle: Mask Detection and Temperature Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: With COVID-19, the globe is currently experiencing a challenging pandemic situation. Since COVID-19 is commonplace around the world, precautions must be taken everywhere. Making sure the general people is taking appropriate safety precautions is the main challenge in this COVID - 19 pandemic. The World Health Organisation (WHO) offers the usual advice on containing COVID-19 and stresses the necessity of using a face mask to protect oneself from the virus. In a country with a dense population like India, it is extremely difficult for government officials to station workers at every public site to ensure and monitor the safety of the population. Many shopping centres, temples, public gathering places, movie theatres, colleges, and schools, among other places, struggle to maintain safety precautions. The objective is to verify an employee's identity and determine whether they adhere to the institution's rules. The system was created with simplicity of use, maintenance, and installation in mind. Corporate headquarters and educational institutions stand to gain the most. It is advised to use a contactless temperature monitoring and mask detection IOT (Internet of Things) artificial intelligence system. Our system employs a camera module to identify mask wearers and an infrared thermometer to take someone's body temperature without making physical contact.

articleTitle: Charging Electric Vehicles at Fuel Stations Using Solar Energy And Fuel Cell Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Design and optimization of a smart charging station that utilizes solar power to charge both electric and hydrogen vehicles. The proposed system integrated the solar panels, a fuel cell, a water electrolyzer, hydrogen storage, and vehicles capable of operating on either electricity or hydrogen. Mathematical modeling was employed to determine the optimal power ratings for the solar system, fuel cell, and hydrogen storage. Simulation results indicate that the solar system and fuel cell utilizes this system with the remaining energy contributing a diesel generator. To ensure a consistent power supply, the fuel cell and diesel generator to operates during periods of low solar energy production, such as from 18:00 to 6:00. Energy allocation analysis reveals that approximately 20% of the solar energy powers the electrical load, 50% is used for hydrogen production, and 30% is diverted to the diesel generator.

articleTitle: Smart Glove for Impaired People to Convert Sign into Voice with Text
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The Smart Glove for Sign Language Translation is an innovative technology that has the potential to improve communication for people who are speech and hearing impaired. The glove uses flex detectors and accelerometers to detect sign language gestures, which are then converted into spoken language that can be understood by others. One of the key advantages of this technology is its portability, enabling users to communicate easily and conveniently anytime and anywhere. The glove also uses Bluetooth technology to wirelessly communicate with an Android phone, which can be used to convert signs into written or spoken language. Despite its potential benefits, there are still some limitations that need to be addressed. The glove may not accurately recognize all sign language gestures, leading to misinterpretation of the user's intended meaning. Additionally, the cost of the technology may be prohibitive for many individuals, especially those living in developing countries. Despite these limitations, the Smart Glove for Sign Language Translation proposed a positive step forward in improving communication for speech and hearing impaire individuals. As technology continues to advance, it islikely that i will see further improvements in this area, resulting in even more efficient and cost-effective solutions. Ultimately, these advancements have the potential to significantly enhance the quality of life for people with speech and hearing impairments, enabling them to better communicate and connect with others.

articleTitle: Innovative Method of Predicting Crime Rate by CNN Model Compared with Naive Bayes Algorithm to Increase Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The objective is precisely determine rate of crime utilizing an enhanced methodology using innovative CNN model in comparison to NB. There are two groups made up of a total of 20 samples. Ten samples each were given. Group 1 is a member of the CNN algorithm, whereas Group 2 is a member of the Naive Bayes algorithm. Naive Bayes' accuracy (84%) is less than CNN's (86%).

articleTitle: Early Detection and Support for Learning Disabilities: A Machine Learning Approach Empowering Educators
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Learning disabilities among students present significant challenges for educators and specialists in delivering timely support and interventions. This project aims to develop a machine learning-based system for early detection and support of students with learning disabilities. We collect and preprocess a comprehensive dataset, including academic records, assessments, cognitive test results, and behavioral observations. We employ feature engineering techniques to extract meaningful features indicative of learning disabilities. We compare various machine learning methods, including support vector machines, decision trees, random forests, logistic regression, and k-nearest neighbors, to identify the most suitable model. The deployed system offers real-time predictions and interventions for educators and specialists, facilitating early identification of students at risk of learning disabilities. The decision tree proves effective in predicting the presence of dyslexia, achieving an accuracy of 88.94%. We recommend personalized support strategies tailored to each student's needs to promote inclusive learning environments. A user-friendly interface with visualizations enhances data interpretation for educators and specialists. Continuous evaluation and improvement ensure the system's effectiveness and adaptability. This system has the potential to significantly impact the field of education by empowering educators to support students with learning disabilities and promote equal educational opportunities for all

articleTitle: Integrating Regenerative Braking with Advanced Battery Management for Sustainable Transportation
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The demand for effective energy management systems to improve range, performance, and sustainability overall has been fueled by the quick advancement of electric vehicle (EV) technology. The combination of an advanced Battery Management System (BMS) with a Regenerative Braking System (RBS) for electric cars is thoroughly studied in this research. The suggested solution seeks to maximize energy recovery during braking and deceleration events while preserving the battery pack's longevity and security. When braking, the regenerative braking system captures kinetic energy and transforms it into electrical energy that is subsequently put back into the battery pack of the car. With a longer range and less reliance on external charging sources, this approach considerably improves the vehicle's overall energy efficiency. The study looks into several RBS setups. and investigates their effect on energy recovery rates under various driving circumstances. In order to maximize the battery pack's efficiency and durability, integration with a cutting-edge BMS is essential. The BMS keeps track of the voltages, temperatures, and charge states of the cells to ensure even charging and discharging. In order to avoid overcharging, over discharging, and thermal runaway events, it uses cutting-edge algorithms for cell balance, thermal management, and fault detection. The suggested system also has clever control schemes that can adjust to changing driving conditions. These techniques optimize energy recovery without sacrificing comfort or safety by dynamically adjusting regenerative braking force that is based on current data from the car's sensors. Through a series of lab experiments and on-road testing employing a prototype electric car platform, the integrated system is experimentally validated. Results show significant advancements in energy efficiency compared to traditional non-integrated systems, and battery life.

articleTitle: Influence of e-HRM on Organizational Effectiveness: Towards a Research Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Growth in e-HRM (electronic- Human Resource Management) is unprecedented after the advent of COVID-19. Even public sector organizations adopted digital HRM in the perspective of the prevalent COVID scenario. One of the most advanced researches is to measure e-HRM success. The study's goal is to explore the linkage of e-HRM towards organizational effectiveness in Indian public sector organizations and then develop a conceptual framework. To assess how e-HRM affects net benefits, we provide a model that builds on the DeLone & McLean (D&M) IS success model and the Expectation-Confirmation model (ECM). Major constructs used in the model are e-HRM service quality, e-HRM Information quality, e-HRM system quality, Expectation, Confirmation, Satisfaction, System Use, Individual Effectiveness, and organizational effectiveness. This paper proposes an answer to how e-HRM can influence organizational effectiveness. In the context of Indian public sector companies, the article adds value by augmenting the D&M and ECM models. A thorough framework for assessing organisational effectiveness must include expectation and confirmation, as well as their satisfaction for better acceptance. The paper could aid HR in better understanding how human factors work viz. Satisfaction, expectation, and confirmation affect the correlation of e-HRM towards organizational effectiveness. To give line managers a fresh perspective on e-HRM acceptance, it is helpful to understand the influence of the e-HRM context on net benefits. The suggested approach is a comprehensive model that may be used to support future studies.

articleTitle: Usage of Millimeter Wave Signal Propagation for Outdoor Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The need for more bandwidth in wireless communication has led to the utilization of the millimeter wave spectrum at higher frequencies. Millimeter waves will have a frequency range of 30 to 300 GHz, which corresponds to the wavelength of 10 to 1mm. Though mobile service providers are working to provide enough bandwidth at fast speeds to achieve reduced latency for improved streaming, the limited frequency range accessible is a big roadblock. This can be avoided by using mm-wave to reduce the size of various components, particularly antennas, by employing steerable antennas. The data rate limit is greatly increased by increasing the RF channel transmission capacity for portable radio channels. The propagation of millimeter wave signals was analyzed using the method of ray tracing & examining its effects and losses in the outdoor environment. The attenuation due to path loss and weather loss is significant, hence the signal cannot be propagated over long distances. The main challenges are addressed and the suggested solution is proposed for minimizing such losses incurred during the transmission of signals.

articleTitle: Automated Sensing Cleaner

articleTitle: Text to Audio Listener Tool in Tamil Language for Dyslexics
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Our project introduces customizable text-to-speech technology in Tamil to enhance literacy development for dyslexic children, addressing their phonological-core deficits. This adaptable system identifies text within PDFs and vocalizes it while allowing dyslexic users to customize word presentation. Additional modules include sound recognition, letter and object identification, and kinesthetic activities for multisensory learning. articleTitle: Comprehensive Smart Home Automation: Network Setup, Fire Prevention, and Network Security using Cisco Packet Tracer
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Aim: This paper presents a three-phase approach to smart home automation using Cisco Packet Tracer. Phase 1 establishes the foundational network and integrates IoT devices, ensuring successful packet transfer. In Phase 2, the focus shifts to fire detection and prevention, utilizing smoke detectors and automated water sprinklers. Phase 3 enhances network security through firewall implementation, restricting access to specific IP addresses and blocking ICMP and PING messages. These phases collectively create a robust smart home system, combining device integration, safety measures, and network security, offering enhanced convenience and safety for residents. This work aims to use Cisco Packet Tracer and implement it to design a Smart Home for fire detection and prevention, where home appliances are connected to the router, which in turn is connected to the internet and set up a firewall that adds up network security to the system.

articleTitle: Data Securing Using LSTM-CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The Hybrid LSTM-CNN Intrusion Detection System (IDS) is a peculiar Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture-based IDS. The hybrid model emerges as a potent instrument for accurate and effective intrusion detection by combining LSTM's capacity for sequential data analysis and CNN's mastery of spotting spatial patterns. Extensive tests performed on recognized benchmark datasets highlight the system's exceptional performance, showing unmistakable advantages over single-model competitors in terms of F1-score, recall, accuracy, and precision. The system's ability to incrementally learn demonstrates how adaptable it is to changing cybersecurity environments, supporting its resilience against developing threats. The addition of attention mechanisms improves the model's interpretability and offers security analysts insightful information for quick threat detection.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Abnormalities Identification by Machine Learning Classifiers and its Comparision

articleTitle: Person Identification and Movement Analysis for Surveillance using Machine Learning and Web Scraping

Suspects will be detected using machine learning based on their behaviors and unidentifiable facial matching records. The photo or video frame was captured by one of the cameras placed at various locations, and it can be utilized with Prohibited Activities (Physical) and face recognition to identify the stranger. articleTitle: RFID Card Based Petrol Pump Automation System

articleTitle: Autonomous Surveillance Robot (ASR): A Video Surveillance Rover for Military Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Security in the border areas has always been a threat to mankind. Even if we try to increase security, the cost to implement the same security system will increase exponentially. Apart from the cost, the human deprivation due to a few problems like bomb blast is also a substantial issue. In ordinance to solve this issue, this work aims to give the best security in the border areas with the minimum cost. This rover can work in manual mode which can be controlled using fly-sky. First this is splitted into 2 ends of operation. This includes user end and rover end. On the user end, there will be a fly-sky transmitter which will be able to send the signal up to 1km range. In the first module this work aims to make the rover run through the motor driver, fly-sky receiver and Arduino to implement its testing process in all directions. Second module consists of detecting bombs using metal detection. This module will be placed under the rover that detects the metallic intrusion and sends the output to the 3rd module. In the 3rd module GPS location is included where the output of the metal detection will be given as input to the GPS sensor which will send the exact location of the metal where it is detected through nrf24l01 transmitting module(1 km range) placed in the rover end. This transmitting module will send the signal to the receiving end of the nrf2401 module which will be placed in the user end. In the 4th module, need to integrate an arm controller with a camera at the gripper end which will rotate 360 up to degree the view of which will also be sent to the user end. This will reduce the cost of making the rover enormously. In the 5th module our work aims to display all locations (latitude and longitude) and the camera view to the user end through PyQt5. This will give the whole view of the rover movement, the camera view and also the location of the bomb where it should be detected.

articleTitle: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis: An Extensive Study of Techniques, Challenges, and Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis(ABSA) has gained significant attention in recent years because of its ability to provide more fine-grained insights into customer preferences. ABSA, an NLP-based data mining technique, focuses on identi-fying user sentiments related to different aspects of a product or service. This paper presents a comprehensive overview of ABSA including aspect extraction, sentiment analysis, and aspect-based summarization techniques, and discusses its challenges, applications, and future scope. In addition, the paper presents a thorough comparative analysis of deep learning-based models for ABSA and also discusses the commonly used datasets. Deep learning-based techniques have produced better outcomes than the traditional ABSA methods.

articleTitle: Implementation of Characteristic Mode Analysis in Single Fed Triple Mode Wideband Circularly Polarized Low Profile Antennas

Circularly Polarized bandwidth augmentation, linearly polarized (LP) three orthogonal modes are used, where the one of mode is co-operated by two modes which are cross-polarized with the same polarization, in contrary to even numbered linearly polarized modes with four phases. articleTitle: Cursor Control Based on Eyeball Movement Using Deep Learning

abstract: We bring forth the notion of using the eyes to control the computer cursor. Finding a person's gaze point or tracking their eye movement is called eye tracking. Without requiring hardware input, it is feasible to interact with interfaces directly by capturing eye movements and using them as control signals. It aspires to replace the mouse, the piece of hardware most essential for using a computer. In order to classify the individual eyeballs of both human eyes with a high degree of accuracy and control over movement, this system additionally implements a deep learning approach with some built-in data set. For those with restricted mobility, this concept will be quite helpful. Python, OpenCV, NumPy, and a few more facial recognition programs are required software for this method, along with a simple webcam. The HOG (Histogram of Oriented Gradients) is a popular tool for building face detectors.

articleTitle: Geospatial Object Detection in Hyperspectral Imagery Using Spectral-Spatial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: By recording a wide range of spectral bands across the electromagnetic spectrum, hyperspectral imagery (HSI) delivers extensive information. Due to the complicated interaction between spectral and spatial properties, extracting meaningful geographical information from HSI is difficult. This article uses Spectral-Spatial Networks to detect geographical objects in hyperspectral data. The proposed deep learning system blends spectral and spatial information to improve object discrimination in complicated scenarios. SSN uses convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and spectral attention mechanisms to adaptively weigh spectral bands and capture spatial correlations. A large dataset of annotated hyperspectral photography with ground truth object identification trains the SSN. The collection includes different lighting, topography, and item scales. The object detection task is fine-tuned after pre-training on a large HSI dataset. Experimental results on benchmark hyperspectral datasets show that the SSN outperforms state-of-the-art approaches. Precision, recall, and F1-score for numerous object classes reveal that the suggested technique can distinguish objects in complicated and congested situations. The suggested SSN framework is also resilient to illumination, climatic conditions, and sensor properties, making it suitable for real-world applications. The SSN architecture's scalability is further examined, showing its suitability for heterogeneous HSI datasets with different spectral resolutions.

articleTitle: Student Academic Analyser and Career Guidance System Using Data Analytics and Visualization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In the age of data-driven education, our research presents a transformative solution: a Student Performance Analysis and Guidance System seamlessly integrated with an existing academic management system. This system empowers students by offering a holistic view of their academic performance while harnessing a wealth of academic data, including grades, course history, and projects. Leveraging data analytics and visualization, it provides personalized guidance, considering factors such as academic performance and domain interests. Moreover, mentors gain a comprehensive view of student performance, enabling them to offer tailored guidance and foster mentor-student collaboration. Preliminary results indicate enhanced academic performance and user satisfaction. Our research opens doors to further exploration, including data integration improvements and future research directions in personalized academic advising. In essence, our system marks a pivotal shift toward data-enabled educational empowerment, shaping a brighter future for both students and mentors in the ever-evolving landscape of education.

articleTitle: MoodVue: A Smart Mirror with Emotional Intelligence

abstract: This research paper introduces a groundbreaking smart mirror with emotional intelligence, merging artificial intelligence and human-computer interaction. We explore its design, development, and evaluation, focusing on facial recognition and sentiment analysis capabilities. Our study underscores the significance of emotional intelligence in technology interactions and addresses the gap by proposing this innovative solution. The smart mirror captures and analyzes emotions, ensuring user data privacy. User studies validate the mirror's effectiveness in recognizing and responding to emotions, enhancing user engagement. This research contributes to the evolving field of human- computer interaction, highlighting the potential of emotional intelligence in smart mirrors and suggesting future research directions.

articleTitle: Estimation of Brain Age from MRI Images Using Convolutional Neural Network and Compared with K-Nearest Neighbor to Improve the Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The research aims in enhancing the precision of brain age estimation from MRI scans through the application of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and to conduct a comparative analysis with the K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) method. Kagle data is used in the Convolutional neural network (CNN). The study involves a comparison between the CNN algorithm and the K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) method. Two groups, labeled as group 1 and group 2, each comprised 20 samples. Poor estimation of data collection is improved by using CNN with KNN at the accuracy rate of 94.31% to accuracy of 93.08%. The obtained value for the independent sample t-test is 0.029 (p<0.05). This shows that the two techniques have different statistical results. The estimation of brain age using the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) involves assessing dataset efficiency and accuracy. In this regard, the CNN outperforms the K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) method, achieving an accuracy rate of 94.31% compared to KNN's 93.08%.

articleTitle: IoT Based Real-Time Virtual Doctor Model for Human Health Monitoring

abstract: The healthcare sector is being swiftly transformed by IoT thanks to the proliferation of innovative models in health care industry. This IoT gadget could check the temperature and read the heart rate. articleTitle: Raspberry Pi Pico Based Real Time Patient Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Many people are affected every day in India because patients are not treated quickly and correctly, in many cases the current system does not work well and individual screening for pain is often impossible. Our system is very useful to handle these situations. In India, many people are affected on a daily basis and pain often goes uncontrolled due to patients not being cared for in a timely and efficient manner and the current system not working well in many cases and people. By using this, the observation of the patient is monitored by the doctor endlessly while not really visiting the patient. Once an important condition happens, the visual indications are going to be sent onto the screen as well as the alarm will blow and concerned person will get a text message from the GSM module we insert in the device intimating any abnormal activities in temperature as well as heart rate changes. The proposed model is less expensive due to The Raspberry Pi Pico board is a high-performance microcontroller board. It can be used for computer programming, robotics, and even making everyday items computerized. In conclusion, The Raspberry Pi Pico can reduce the difficulty faced by patients and doctors. articleTitle: Research on Regulators Required for Cell Migration Using Gene Encoding Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Many of the mechanisms that were found in simple organisms like yeast, worms, and flies are well preserved in humans, and many of the molecules that were found in these organisms have functions that are similar to those in humans. Simple organisms can be used to investigate the intricate mechanisms of cell migration. Drosophila ovary border cell migration has emerged as a straightforward model for studying cell migration in recent decades. There are various stages of egg chambers in the Drosophila ovary. There are approximately 650 follicle-epithelial cells and 16 germline cells in each egg chamber. The oocyte is formed by one of the germline cells, and the remaining 15 cells become nurse cells. A pair of distinct follicle cells, known as polar cells, form at each of the egg chamber's poles during early oogenesis. The border cell cluster, which consists of six to ten cells, is formed when the anterior polar cells recruit adjacent follicular cells at the beginning of stage 9 of oogenesis. The border cells migrate between the nurse cells after separating from the follicle epithelial cells. They are referred to as border cells because they migrate through the center of the egg chamber for approximately six hours before reaching the oocyte's anterior border at early stage 10.

articleTitle: Malaria Detection Using Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Malaria is a serious and occasionally fatal disease brought on by a parasite that frequently infects a particular species of mosquito that feeds on people. Malaria frequently results in severe illness in its victims, including high temperatures, chills that make you shiver, and flu-like symptoms. The four different forms of malaria parasites that infect humans are most likely to result in serious infections and, if untreated, death. Malaria can be devastating, but symptoms and deaths from malaria are typically preventable. Deep Learning models, or to be extra unique,ConvolutionalNeuralNetworks(CNN)modelsarepr oposedonthistaskAcomparisonoftheproposed and contemporary algorithms exhibits that the accuracy of malaria disorder classificationprimarily based on CNN's is higher than other algorithms. If the CNN approach is supported by the addition of more feature extraction techniques and accurately classifying malaria disease in the image, it is projected that the achievement of the acquired results will increase.

articleTitle: Power and Signal Transmission for Electric Vehicles by Using Cascaded Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: BLDC motors are widely used because of its improved efficiency, ease of manufacture, reduced cost, greater torque or high output power per unit volume, and lower maintenance requirements, high power, high voltage applications. To power the BLDC motor, an electrical commutator (inverter) is necessary. The PWM inverter operates admirably. Harmonic distortions are an issue with two-level inverters. PWM methods make it possible to generate sinusoids with variable voltages and frequencies from discrete voltage levels in multilevel inverters. Increasing the number of voltage steps is one solution to the aforementioned problems. The three level approach has the advantage of allowing the production of multilevel voltage waveforms using lower voltage rated equipment. To do this, multilevel inverters can be employed. The traditional technique causes considerable low drive performance and switching losses. This paper suggests a plausible alternative. Simulation with the MATLAB Simulink tool demonstrates the effectiveness of a driving system using neutral clamped multilayer inverters.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition Using EfficientNet-B2 Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Human activity recognition refers to the automated process of categorizing and classifying human activities that is derived from sensor data or visual input. They are widely used in research, benchmarking various algorithms, and building real-world applications that benefit from understanding and predicting human activity, such as healthcare, fitness tracking, assistive technology, and intelligent environments. EfficientNetB2 is well known for its superiority in performance and efficiency, making it an ideal option for tasks requiring HAR. This study demonstrates the efficacy of the EfficientNetB2 model in precisely classifying a range of human activities using data gathered from several sensors. Our goal is to evaluate the model's performance in classifying different human activities. The results clearly show that this model gave the highest accuracy of 75 percent for 9 epochs

articleTitle: Enhancing the Prediction of Communication Using Support Vector Machine Over Decision Tree for Underwater Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Effort of this research is to enhance our ability to forecast how underwater wireless sensor networks would behave for underwater wireless communication. Materials and to make accurate projections on the functionality of underwater wireless sensor networks (UWSN), it is necessary to put the Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Decision Tree algorithms through their paces by using a wide range of training and testing strategies. The accuracy based on the result suggests that the SVM, has a value of 92.509% than the Decision Tree, having a value of 83.1156%, with a statistically significant value of 0.001 (p<0.05) which is statistically significant and concludes the Support Vector Machine has a higher Accuracy and Loss. When compared to the accuracy of a decision tree, the accuracy of a support vector machine is superior.

articleTitle: Review of Face Emotion Recognition Using Feature Extraction Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Face Emotion Recognition is a much-needed technique in a number of business, community and government applications. It involves a number of processes including feature extraction and selection. The present paper provides a thorough review of existing literature on the topic. The review provides various pointers for future research on Face Emotion Recognition. Some of the pointers are features types, feature extraction methods, feature selection methods and emotion classifying techniques. The study shows promising attributes for face emotion recognition like color, shape, texture of the face image. It also provides a comparative study of different techniques used for emotion classification techniques such as support vector machine, neural networks, Gabor Filters etc.

articleTitle: Enhancing Quantum Key Distribution Protocols with Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) promises theoretically unbreakable encryption by using fundamental quantum physics principles. QKD has emerged as a contender in the next generation of encryption protocols as the demand for more secure communication grows in our linked society. However, practical QKD implementations confront obstacles such as noise, interception attempts, and flaws in quantum hardware. We investigate the possibilities of Machine Learning (ML) techniques to improve the efficiency, resilience, and security of QKD protocols in this study. We provide a novel system that uses deep learning models to optimize photon polarization states and hence increase the key generation rate. Our approach detects and mitigates eavesdropping attempts using unsupervised learning algorithms, substantially enhancing the security of quantum communications. To achieve security, the BB84 protocol makes use of fundamental quantum mechanics features. Furthermore, we use reinforcement learning to adaptively alter system settings in real time to account for the quirks and noise profiles of different quantum channels. In comparison to typical QKD setups, experimental results show that our ML-enhanced QKD system is more resilient to known quantum attacks and provides a more consistent and efficient key distribution rate. Our findings indicate that the interaction of quantum physics and machine learning can pave the way for more secure and practical quantum communication networks in the near future.

articleTitle: Identification of Fake and Spam Users on Social Networking Platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Social networking sites attract several users from varied parts around the world. Some of the popular sites containing a huge volume of users are Twitter, Facebook, and so on. All these sites poses a significant impact among its users and sometimes undesirable for a standard of living. articleTitle: Cybug – The Malicious File Detecting Software
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The most significant fact of ages is that when we install Antivirus software, our system is safe from viruses. But what if we prove it wrong, The most classic and effective way to hack or spread viruses into systems is by malicious files. These are done by sending an infected file to the user and this file bypasses the antivirus software using its blind spots to its advantage to evade the software. When you just click on it the virus file also runs in the background and the system's security is being compromised. articleTitle: A Systematic Approach on Waste Water Treatment Using Predictive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Wastewater treatment is essential for maintaining public health and safeguarding water supplies. By removing dangerous bacteria from sewage, it helps to keep people healthy. In order to improve the efficiency of wastewater treatment, our study offers a systematic methodology that applies machine learning to a non-intrusive prediction model. The optimisation of control systems and of treatment processes like membrane filtration and chemical precipitation are crucial. We create predictive models to foresee changes in wastewater parameters, assisting with treatment optimisation and evaluating system performance.

articleTitle: Advancements in Fake News Detection: Integrating NLP and Multi-Modal Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This comprehensive investigation uses powerful NLP and multi-modal integration to detect fake information on social media. Our technique was tested using 10,000 news pieces from various social media networks. Advanced NLP models are crucial, with the state-of-the-art transformer model, BERT, collecting subtle contextual information with 94.2% accuracy. SVM and BERT had the greatest classification accuracy at 95.6% when combined with ensemble approaches. Multi-modal information sources including picture captions and user metadata improved classification performance, with the textual-image model achieving the greatest accuracy at 96.8%. The research was ethical, incorporating fairness analysis and transparency measures, to ensure detection trustworthiness and fairness. These findings show that sophisticated NLP models and multi-modal integration can improve fake news detection, enabling the creation of strong, real-world apps to combat disinformation and protect digital discourse.

articleTitle: Devising Sustainabile Development Strategies for Online Retailing in India
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The trend of online retailing/shopping is growing at an unprecedented rate across the world and has taken the business world at storm. Despite this huge growth in recent years, the studies on its environmental implications are not very clear from previous researchers. This research gap is being addressed in this research paper. Online shopping/retailing is easy, fast, and simple. It also ensures a unique satisfaction of store/product comparison at consumer's convenience. Bur, this convenience is often at the cost of environment. The concept of sustainability in online retailing deals with adopting green practices in business activities like business models, packaging, supply chain etc. This change will in variably increase price of the product and in this competitive environment it will pose challenges for the marketers. This research paper is an attempt to answer these questions.

articleTitle: IoT- Powered Real Time Smart Plant Surveillance System for Digital Gardening and Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This paper presents an IoT-enabled plant monitoring and automated watering system that leverages the power of sensors, wireless communication, and cloud computing to provide a scalable and cost-effective solution for precision agriculture. The proposed system consists of soil moisture, temperature and humidity sensors that collect real-time data on plant growth conditions and transmit it to a cloud-based platform for analysis and decision-making. The system's control unit receives commands from the cloud platform and activates the watering system when the soil moisture falls below a threshold value. The system also provides individuals with remote access to the plant growth data, enabling them to make informed decisions on crop management and resource allocation. The proposed system offers several benefits, such as water conservation, increased crop yields, and reduced labor costs, making it an attractive solution for precision agriculture. The experimental results demonstrate the system's effectiveness in maintaining optimal soil moisture levels, enhancing plant growth, and reducing water wastage. Overall, this paper provides a valuable contribution to the field of IoT-enabled precision agriculture and offers practical insights for designing a scalable and intelligent plant monitoring and watering system.

articleTitle: Smart Traffic Control System with Ambulance Detection Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In densely populated urban environments, the rapid and efficient passage of emergency vehicles, such as ambulances, is paramount to saving lives. This abstract introduces a cutting-edge approach to enhance traffic management and emergency response by leveraging image processing techniques for real-time ambulance detection and priority routing. The system we suggest consists of a network of sharp cameras placed at crucial crossroads and along major thoroughfares. These cameras record live video feeds of the traffic situation continuously. The video frames are processed using advanced computer vision algorithms, including object detection and tracking. Specifically, a deep neural network is employed to identify and track ambulance vehicles based on their unique visual characteristics, such as flashing lights, sirens, and distinctive vehicle markings. Upon ambulance detection, the system promptly triggers a series of actions to ensure swift and unimpeded passage. First, nearby traffic signals are dynamically adjusted to give the ambulance a green light, thereby expediting its route. Simultaneously, notifications are sent to connected vehicles via a dedicated communication network, advising them to make way for the approaching emergency vehicle. This communication can take various forms, such as in-car alerts, smartphone notifications, or even messages displayed on electronic road signs. To ensure the system's reliability and responsiveness, it operates in real-time, with minimal latency. Additionally, machine learning models are continuously trained and updated to improve ambulance detection accuracy, adapt to changing environmental conditions, and reduce false positives. By utilizing image processing and intelligent traffic management, our solution contributes to safer, more efficient urban transportation systems and ultimately plays a crucial role in saving lives during critical emergencies.

articleTitle: An Improved Precision Using an Integrated Neural Network Model and Support Vector Machine Algorithms to Find the Instagram Users Profile Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This work proposes a Novel Integrated Neural Network (NINN) for Fake profile detection on Instagram and evaluates its precision against a Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm. The goal is to enhance the accuracy of identifying fake profiles on the social media platform using the NINN approach. It is expected that the NINN will provides reliable predictions, with greater accurate results than existing models considered in this article for classifying fake profiles and reducing security threats in Instagram. The research utilized two sample groups, each containing 20 samples. We used the clinic calc tool to perform the calculations and set the significance level at 0.05. This implies that we are ready to tolerate a 5% probability of rejecting the null hypothesis when it is true. We also specified a last beta rate of 0.2 and a 95% confidence interval (CI) for the effect size estimation. NINN are trained using a dataset and a cost function, and their performance is measured by the precision of their output. The model has three components: an input component, a hidden component that implements the NINN algorithm, and an output component that shows the accuracy of the algorithm. After conducting a thorough analysis, the Novel Integrated Neural Networks Algorithm was found to have a precision of 90.91%, while the Support Vector Machine Algorithm had a precision of 88.19%. A statistical analysis was performed to compare the performance of the two algorithms. The analysis used an Independent samples T-Test, which tests the null hypothesis that the means of two populations are equal. The analysis yielded a p-value of p=0.000 (p<0.05), which indicates that the null hypothesis can be rejected with a high level of confidence. Therefore, the difference between the algorithms is statistically significant. In this research article on Automated fake profile classification on Instagram, the Novel Integrated Neural Networks algorithm was found to have a higher prediction precision percentage (90.91%) than the Support Vector Machine algorithm (88.19%). A more precise fake profile detection method was implemented by applying the NINN algorithm along with the SVM algorithm, this method allows users to distinguish fake profiles more accurately. The goal of this study is to overcome the drawbacks of SVM approaches and developed a better approach using NINN to identify fraudulent accounts on Instagram.

articleTitle: A Lightweight (Recurrent Neural Network) RNN Architecture for IoT Based Baby Monitoring System to Provide Real Time Alerts and Notification to Parents or Care Takers
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Our modern way of life is characterized by its busy, hectic nature. People are constantly on the move, juggling various responsibilities, which can make it difficult to dedicate uninterrupted care to infants. Working parents are the one facing a major parenting challenge. The paper proposes an IoT device build using light weight Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) architecture that monitors an infant's vital signs, safety, and environmental conditions in real-time, providing parents with real-time insight into the well-being of their child. By using smartphones and other connected devices, parents can access vital information about their babies remotely. Parental confidence is further enhanced by the incorporation of safety features like motion sensors and Accelerometer sensor. If certain conditions are met, the moisture level of the diaper is tracked by the humidity sensor, and the parents are notified by text or phone call. The RNN architecture implemented in our proposed device is capable to recognize the gesture and motion of the baby in the cradle.
