The paper outlines Lightweight Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) architecture for computationally intensive and memory Constrained IoT Based Bay monitoring system. Results from the prototype were compared with certified market alternatives proving the proposed baby monitoring system's cost-effectiveness and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Food Vlogs Stimulate the Perception of Millennials Through Wealthy Information
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Information technology is playing a major role in the development of business sectors across the India. Tremendous use of internet and smart phone has paved way for a new business distribution channel. The entire lifestyle of the human beings has taken a booming diversion due to the technological and communication advancement in business. The major advantage of e-commerce is that based on the convenience of the customers be it the place or time value can be added to the customer satisfaction. The communication technology in digital era has led to the introduction of video blogger (vloggers). Food vloggers in Youtube show from the preparation of food to serving of food in video format, attracting people and influencing their perception to try the cuisine/ food. The more they like the vlog, their intention to use the vlog will increase. The study aims in identifying the determinants of food vlog that attracts the millennials to purchase. Convenience sampling technique is used among 300 millennial and the results indicate that food vlogger reviews create a strong positive impact on the purchasing behavior of the millennials.

articleTitle: Measure of Well-Being of Freelancers in it Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Freelancers contribute significantly to the expansion of the economy and businesses within the “gig economy.” The ongoing research aims to assess the level of job satisfaction among IT contractors and workers by conducting surveys. A cross-sectional survey questionnaire is utilized to assess various dimensions of individuals' happiness. The scales' validity and reliability were demonstrated before conducting a oneway ANOVA to predict the life satisfaction of freelancers and IT employees. The findings have the potential to provide valuable insights into the gig economy as a whole.

articleTitle: Smart Dine-in: A Personalized Food Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Personalization in business involves a strategy where companies gather data from their users and utilize Machine Learning techniques to provide customized content or recommendations. In this context, the paper outlines the development of an application that focuses on food recommendations tailored to individual user preferences. The application takes various user inputs into account, such as weather conditions, dietary restrictions, and the time of day. These inputs are analyzed and fed into a Machine Learning algorithm, which serves as the core decision-making component of the system. The algorithm itself operates on two primary concepts: content-based filtering and collaborative filtering. Content-based filtering assesses the characteristics and features of food items, comparing them to the user's preferences to recommend similar options. On the other hand, collaborative filtering looks at user behavior and preferences, suggesting items based on the preferences of similar users. In addition to content-based filtering and collaborative filtering, the paper also incorporates the k-nearest neighbors (KNN) algorithm as part of its recommendation system. The KNN algorithm is used to further enhance the personalization of food recommendations. It works by measuring the similarity between users based on their preferences and behaviors. Specifically, it identifies the “k” nearest users who have similar food preferences to the current user. These similar users' food choices and ratings are then analyzed to suggest food items that align with the user's taste. By employing these methods, the application generates recommendations that are highly personalized, ensuring that users receive food suggestions that align with their specific tastes and the contextual factors relevant to their meal choices. This approach can significantly enhance the user experience and increase user engagement with the application.

articleTitle: Analysis of 2.4 GHz Circular Patch Antenna on FR4 Substrate for Wi-Fi and Bluetooth: Exploring Reflection Coefficient, Gain, VSWR, and Current Density Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: A metal patch is attached to one side of a dielectric substrate to create a small, planar antenna that is frequently employed in wireless communication applications. The advantages of circular patch antennas include their ease of production, low profile, and lightweight design. An antenna with a circular radiating metal patch is called a circular patch antenna and is most frequently employed in wireless communication systems. Design circular microstrip patch antennas for this study's FR4 substrate to analyse 2.4 GHz reflection coefficient, gain VSWR, and current distribution. The HFSS software was used to construct a circular patch antenna.

articleTitle: Industrial Automation Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Industrial automation has emerged as a crucial driver of efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness across a range of industries in a time marked by the unrelenting march of technology. As a set out on a mission to design and create Industrial Automation using the Internet of Things (IoT) for a variety of industries, This system is at the forefront of this technological revolution. The IoT, sensor networks, Radio-Frequency Identification (RFID), and Global Positioning System (GPS) technologies are all combined in this project to create a comprehensive system for real-time data collection, analysis, and decision-making [8]. Main goal of Industry 4.0 is to give businesses the tools they need to track the whereabouts, mobility, and status of industrial assets [7]. Additionally, a focus on enhanced operational safety by integrating features like predictive maintenance, which anticipates equipment failures to reduce downtime and prevent accidents. The system is designed for scalability and adaptability, ensuring it can be seamlessly implemented across various industries and environments. Furthermore, The project promotes environmental sustainability by optimizing asset utilization and reducing energy consumption, thereby helping businesses reduce their carbon footprint and resource waste while maintaining data security and privacy through robust measures and encryption protocols.

articleTitle: Student Refined Report Portal
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: When student or staff wants to attend some event like conference, training, seminar, etc. or go on a long-term event like an internship, we must submit an On Duty request in paper and gain clearance from many college chancellors, which is a lengthy procedure. The same procedure is used when we need to request authorization for pre-informed leave. Also, getting some academic details like internship profiles, course certificates is a tedious and complicated task when collecting from entire college students. So, we plan to create a website portal termed STUDENT REFINED REPORT PORTAL which makes it easier and more technologically advanced, to simplify and save as much as paper work and time for both students and authorities by finishing as much as the necessary procedure with ease.

articleTitle: MedLyric - Exploring Health and Well-Being Through a Website
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: “MedLyric” is a comprehensive online platform meant to give immediate information and help to individuals during emergency circumstances and in other healthcare scenarios. The major goal of the project is to provide a user-friendly, accessible, and educational resource for medical assistance, first aid, and treatment counselling. MedLyric's primary features include an intelligent symptom-based guiding system that supports users in recognising their ailment and provides step-by-step directions for rapid therapy. The website also incorporates capabilities to link users with top hospitals and physicians in regions of their choosing. To further enhance user engagement and accessibility, MedLyric incorporates a chatbot feature, capable of providing basic first aid information and aiding in the identification of injuries and ailments based on user inputs, including images and descriptions. In addition to these essential functions, the project intends to constantly extend its capabilities by incorporating video lessons, emergency checklists, prescription reminders, and a variety of educational materials relating to emergency preparedness and healthcare. MedLyric strives to empower individuals to respond effectively to medical emergencies and access quality healthcare resources by combining technology, healthcare expertise, and user-centric design principles, ultimately contributing to improved health outcomes and increased confidence in emergency situations.

articleTitle: Tapping the Wave Power of Seas and Oceans Using Salter Duck
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This research paper focuses on the design and optimization of a wave energy generator model based on Salter's Duck, a wave energy converter device. The objective is to improve the efficiency of energy conversion from the kinetic and potential energy of ocean tides to electrical energy. The proposed modifications include altering the incident angle between incoming waves and the Salter's Duck device and incorporating a solar sheet to augment energy generation. Furthermore, the study involves regulating the RPM (Revolutions Per Minute) of the generator input to fine-tune the duck's output energy, thereby increasing overall efficiency. The analysis of the device's design and operating principles identifies key areas for enhancement, encompassing structural modifications, hydrodynamic improvements, and control mechanisms. Computational modeling techniques are employed to simulate and assess the suggested modifications, with the goal of achieving an optimal configuration that strikes a balance between energy capture efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and structural integrity. This research contributes significantly to the advancement of wave energy conversion technology, particularly by elevating the efficiency of the Salter's Duck system. The study unlocks the untapped potential of harnessing ocean waves as a sustainable and renewable energy resource. The implications of this work extend to the prospect of future wave energy farms, supporting the global transition towards clean and sustainable energy sources.

articleTitle: Interactive Media Control System Using Hand Gestures
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In recent years, there has been an increase in interest in creating novel human-computer interaction techniques, particularly in the area of media consumption. This abstract introduces the idea of a “Hand-Controlled Media Player,” a unique interface that enables users to manage media playback and navigation with simple hand movements. For a seamless and interesting user experience, this technology makes use of developments in sensor technologies, gesture recognition, and computer vision.

articleTitle: Emerging Trends in Hybrid Solar and Wind Power Sharing V2C and C2V Power Exchange with Integrated Charging Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This research paper focuses on the design and optimization of a Hybrid Solar and Wind Power Sharing with V2C and C2V Power Exchange and Utilization to Home. The transition towards renewable energy sources is vital to combat climate change and reduce dependence on fossil fuels. Solar and wind power are two prominent renewable energy options that harness the natural elements to generate electricity. Grid- tied solar and wind power sharing with V2C and G2C power exchange offers numerous benefits, including reduced carbon emissions, energy cost savings, and increased grid reliability. The power from the hybrid power generation is sent to charging unit. The power is delivered from charging unit to electric vehicle and electric vehicle to charging unit. The PSM technique is used used for modeling the circuit. The power is also delivered from charging unit through battery to the home appliance. The graphs are plotted and analyse the operating conditions using MATLAB at charging and discharging from electric vehicle.

Author Keywords: Hybrid solar and wind power sharing

articleTitle: Indoor Campus Navigation using Web Application System for Seamless University Mobility
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: A two-dimensional navigation system is developed to give consumers location-based information. The resulting program gives the user the ability to navigate across the university area and locate routes to particular destinations on campus. An application for campus navigation was created as part of this development. A technology called interior navigation is used to find specific destinations within a campus. The navigation system discussed in this paper leverages data from a campus' active database to identify the locations that users request. The campus floor plan serves as the basis for the two- dimensional navigation system, which guides users with the aid of a route and a mechanism for path assistance. A path can be manually entered into the web application and exhibited from the user's position right now to the targeted destination. The building of a working model for smartphone or laptop software that aids students in exploring the campus is the stated goal of this project. The user's existing spot can be used in association with the navigational tool to highlight them nearby attractions and aid them in becoming familiar with the campus.

articleTitle: Using a Machine Learning Algorithm and Fundus Images to Treat Diabetic Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Diabetes-related complications include diabetic retinopathy (DR), a condition that damages the eyes. Pictures of the retinal fundus can be used to find it. Traditional methods for processing photos have several limitations when it comes to analyzing data and hiding patterns. In recent years, deep neural network have to be effectively used in a variety of computer vision tasks. On the openly avatlable retinal fundus picture available on Kaggle dataset, we have to apply the pre-trained images in Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), MobileNetV1 and VGG16 in this research. In favor of to get larger and clear the of feature extraction, we have used pre-processing and augmentation approaches. 35,126 retinal eye funds images from the Kaggle dataset with five labelsof class are used in the experiment. OnEary trained MobileNet and V1VGG16 with learning are transferred and Tuning clearly, training accuracy was 91.42% and 91.84%, respectively. VGG16 and MobileNetV1 both achieved test accuracy of 91.51% and 91.77%, respectively.

articleTitle: Employment Forum Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The candidate ranking problem is addressed in this work by utilizing machine learning algorithms to evaluate job candidates in online recruitment systems. Our method is put into practice as a prototype system, whose functionality is demonstrated and assessed in a real-world recruitment scenario. By performing language analysis on their blog posts, the proposed approach infers a set of objective criteria about the candidates' personalities from their profiles. Our method was found to perform consistently when compared to human recruiters; as a result, application ranking and personality mining may be automated with confidence. We examine the effects of HRM practices including recruiting and selection, career planning and development opportunities, work-life balance, etc. in the whole scheme of things.

articleTitle: AGRIBOT-The Technology of Smart and Sustainable Farming
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: A significant resource demanded for the durability of ultramodern society is agrarian land. But tending civilization has several difficulties. The crop must first be grown in perfect conditions for temperature, moisture, and sun. The crop must also be shielded from troubles outdoors. In terms of smart husbandry, remote crop status monitoring has lately gained fashionability. This agrarian revolution, still, comes at a significant cost because the bulk of the systems are too precious to apply on small granges and the systems might not cover enormous fields. Agribot seeks to produce a network of fluently posted bias that may be placed on the field being covered. Due to shy or devilish irrigation, as well as natural disasters like cyclones, rain, and strong wind currents, the bias collects atmospheric data, soil parameter values, light intensity values, and water position from the field. They upload all the data to the pall, where a dashboard operation shows it.

articleTitle: Smart Gas System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The smart gas system has two purposes, the first is to monitor and display gas consumption levels. The other is to detect if there is a gas leak. Gas levels can be determined using the LCD screen on the front of the cart. A buzzer alerts the user when the gas level is getting low. As this is an IoT project, users will receive reminders on their phones, so gas reservations are made in advance and they can also track their daily gas consumption. The gas level is calculated based on the weight of gas present in the cylinder. Alternatively, gas leaks are a big problem in residential buildings. One of the means of prevention to eradicate accidents related to gas leaks is to install gas leak detection kits in vulnerable places. The purpose of this article is to present a design capable of automatically detecting and stopping gas leaks in vulnerable places. In particular, high sensitivity propane and butane gas sensors are used. The gas leak system consists of a GSM module (Global System for Mobile Communications), which warns by sending SMS.

articleTitle: Biometric-based Smart Electronic Voting System Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The electoral commission encounters a number of issues throughout every election. Duplication, unlawful voting, and erroneous confirmation of the order of casting the ballots are the most prevalent problems the electoral commission encounters. This concept employs iris recognition to replace the present voting system with a new, secure one. One of the most reliable biometrics for identifying people is the iris. This post's primary objective is to prevent individuals from voting more than once. This study's main focus is an enhanced voting mechanism that uses both fingerprints and eyes. In the sophisticated voting system being created for this project, iris and fingerprint technologies are utilized. Each voter's iris is being scanned, and the information is being entered into a voter database along with the relevant AADHAR card number. Only when the voter's fingerprint matches the saved value is the voting procedure deemed successful. When a voter arrives, their iris is detected, and the image obtained is compared to their voting history. When the iris is picked up, we access the voter's data from our PC and contrast it with the voter's fingerprint. The person is permitted to cast a vote if both facts are true. The existing voting system is insecure because some voters cast false ballots or have multiple registrations. In this essay, voter security is thoroughly examined, and false voters are eradicated in order to strengthen and improve the credibility of the voting system. After voting is successfully finished, the results are stored in the cloud using IoT. Data collection and calculations are done automatically. The results are displayed in IoT at the conclusion of the day after the total votes and data have been automatically calculated. Less time will be spent storing voting machines, and less unauthorised people will replace voting equipment.

articleTitle: Malware Analysis Using RNN and Naive Bayes Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The main thing about the internet age is the protection and coverage from the intruders. The instinct of the security experts will find the malware which is notorious in nature but the case is not similar at all times. Many malwares can intrude a system and even after scanning phase many viruses may exist. So the main part in the detection and analysis of the malware is the scanning phase and identification phase. Moreover in the scanning phase there should be a dynamic approach to predict and detect the malware. This can be achieved by the new emerging technology “Machine learning”. Machine learning provides a good prediction mechanism which will in return give us great results. The Algorithms in machine learning are used to predict the output of an event with various number of ways and accuracies. The Main algorithms and networks are the classification and the sequential data analyzing networks. RNN algorithm and Naive bayes algorithm provide this purpose. As these algorithms are tested separately in the field of analysis the combination of these algorithms will be a boost for the malware analysis. RNN provides a standard model for sequential data analysis and data prediction in sequential order. The Naive Bayes algorithm provides a model for classification of the malware families so that we can easily do things to prevent those families of malwares. As we are using the common name malware we are proposing this solution to the wide range if the malicious softwares

articleTitle: IoT Based Anti-Theft Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This abstract presents an IoT-based anti-theft detection system using Arduino, designed to enhance security systems in personal and commercial This system combines sensor technology, Arduino microcontrollers, and cloud connectivity to create an edge a strong anti-theft remedy. Sensors such as motion detectors, door/window contact sensors, vibration sensors, etc. are strategically placed in the target area to detect unauthorized activities. Users have instant access to information on their mobile devices, allowing them to take action faster. The cloud-based architecture not only facilitates remote monitoring but also enables data storage and analysis for further security enhancements. The proposed IoT-based anti-theftdetection system provides an effective and scalable solution to reduce theft risk and ensure the security of valuable assets.

articleTitle: Detection of Brain Tumor Using YOLOv5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In order to provide quick, efficient treatment, disease prediction in the healthcare industry must be exceedingly accurate. The overall goal of this project is to predict brain tumors at early stages using a deep learning model. The Brain is the most important organ in the human body since it controls how all other organs function and helps us make decisions. The tumor is an unchecked growth of unwanted tissue inside of our brain that has developed into a fibrous mesh. The main objective of this study is to identify brain tumors early on. The research would offer a prognosis identifying the presence or absence of a tumor. Among all machine learning algorithms, the YOLO (You Only Look Once) deep learning method is employed because it has a greater degree of precision, produces results more quickly, and is easy to train on large datasets. Another benefit of the deep learning method is that it permits parallelization and has higher testing accuracy than other algorithms. This technique makes it possible to diagnose brain tumors quickly and precisely (96% of the time), which helps with patient care.

articleTitle: Comparison of P&O and Incremental conductance for MPPT algorithm in bifacial solar PV system
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In this paper, a review is carried on existing MPPT control techniques and their performances were evaluated when applied to bifacial solar panels. With the increasing demand for sustainable and efficient energy solutions, bifacial solar panels have gained significant attention due to their ability to harness sunlight from both the front and backside, resulting in higher energy yields. To fully capitalize on the potential of bifacial panels, the integration of an effective Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) charge control system becomes crucial. This paper presents a comprehensive review and analysis of the application of MPPT control on bifacial solar panels, focusing on its benefits, challenges, and advancements in the field. The research aims to provide valuable insights to scientists, engineers and policy makers, promote the adoption of this technology and advance the development of renewable energy systems. By utilizing sunlight from both the panel's front and back surfaces, bifacial solar panels present a possible way to increase solar energy acquisition. Advanced control tactics must be used if these advanced solar systems are to reach their full potential. The studies and advancements in charge control using Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) that are specific to bifacial solar panels are summarized in this abstract. The operating voltage and current of bifacial solar panels are dynamically adjusted by bifacial MPPT charge control systems, ensuring that they function at their peak power points under a variety of environmental situations. Orientation optimization, rear-side irradiance measurement, bifacial component integration, and the employment of complex computations are important design factors for these systems. These devices can change light conditions, shading effects, and other environmental factors, thus maximizing energy generation.

articleTitle: Impact of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) on Fertility and Pregnancy Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is a common endocrine disorder affecting reproductive-aged women worldwide. This research paper explores the multifaceted impact of PCOS on fertility and pregnancy outcomes. It discusses the complex interplay of hormonal, metabolic, and inflammatory factors associated with PCOS and their influence on ovulation, conception, and gestation. Furthermore, it delves into the management strategies and interventions aimed at optimizing fertility and improving pregnancy outcomes for women with PCOS.

articleTitle: AireWatch: Futuristic Gas Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The maintenance of safety and security in industries dealing with hazardous gases is of importance, and IoT-based alerting and monitoring devices have emerged as indispensable tools to address this need. These devices offer real-time data monitoring capabilities, continuously collecting information from various sensors to provide immediate insights into environmental conditions, including gas levels, temperature, humidity, and air quality. They enable early warning and alerts by triggering notifications when safety thresholds are breached, thus preventing accidents and minimizing damage. IoT-based solutions facilitate remote monitoring, reducing the need of physical presence in dangerous environments, enhancing worker safety. The data collected by these devices can be subjected to powerful analytics, allowing for trend identification, anomaly detection, and informed decision-making to optimize operations and safety measures. An automated data collection and reporting, reducing the risk.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Strategic Approach to Utilizing Deep Learning for the Purpose of Predicting Stock Prices
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Stock price forecasting for extended periods of time is notoriously challenging, so it pays to create a solid algorithmic groundwork before delving in. Due to the interconnected nature of stock prices imposed by market dynamics, accurate price forecasting is difficult. The suggested method employs artificial intelligence techniques like recurrent neural networks and Long Short Term Memory to anticipate the share price based on market data. The system's visualizations can now be informed by the training and validation outcomes obtained across several dimensions of input data. The results are promising, suggesting that an LSTM model can be used to forecast the stock market.

articleTitle: An X-Ray Image Enhancement Algorithm for Dangerous Goods in Airport Security Inspection
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The issue of colour twist in Contrast limited adaptive histogram equalization)-enhanced airway security X-ray images is applied with a Unsharp Masking-CLAHE X-ray image enhancement approach. After applying CLAHE enhancement to the calculated grey scale pictures for the R, G, and B channels of the X-ray image, the combined R, G, & B grey scale images will be merged. The USM sharpening procedure is then applied to the CLAHE-enhanced X- ray image, and depending on its weight, it is mixed with the original and USM-sharpened photos. The studies' findings show that the USM+CLAHE algorithm is able to successfully enhance security X-ray images while also reducing colour distortion in the enhanced images.

articleTitle: Smart Walking Cane for Navigation of Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Smart walking cane for navigation of the visually impaired using Arduino UNO and OpenCV– presents the development of a smart system for navigation for blind people using Google App Maker. This develops one's own Application Programming Interface (API) for Blind and low-vision users. Google Application Developer also provides tools for designers who must develop transparency features in their applications. Here Arduino UNO embedded with moisture, ultrasonic sensor, and Google Maps Cloud is used for making a smart cane for the visually impaired. An ultrasonic sensor is used to support the detection of real-time obstacles while walking. With the help of Google Maps cloud connected to the Arduino UNO ideal route for the low-vision or visually impaired can be given. This will develop a smarter system that helps blind people to manage their day-to-day activities more accurately and safely. The blind people use audio commands to interact with the system. 4G technology is used to enable communication between the cloud platform and smartphone. The proposed system can give more information about the surrounding environment and exact route with low latency which supports real-time scenarios without the support of a third person.

articleTitle: Design of Piezoelectric-Enabled Wireless Sensor Nodes: Self-Powered Solutions
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This paper focuses on the implementation of WSN powered by an energy harvesting circuit. It describes potential energy extraction techniques to power a WSN effectively. Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have emerged as a transformative technology in the realm of data sensing, collection, and dissemination. Piezoelectric energy is harvested using the energy harvesting circuit, converted into dc voltage and then supplied as a power source to WSN. The main goal of this paper is to self-generate energy from energy harvesting circuit while simultaneously monitoring and controlling the parameters of temperature, humidity, pressure, and air quality in real-time.

articleTitle: Auto Climate Deducer using Data Science and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Most The motive of this work is to enable Artificial Intelligence algorithms (ARIMA - Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average Models is used here), to foretell climate changes and turn around events accurately. Huge datasets are used to train these algorithms but it is a major demerit if the dataset is lagging in its own updation. Therefore, the solution proposed is to solve the time delay in updating the dataset and thereby empower the algorithm to produce right results.

articleTitle: VLSI Implementation of an Efficient Lossless EEG Compression for WBAN Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Despite the growing prevalence of wireless body area networks (WBAN), there are still unresolved issues about the technology's efficacy and efficiency in transmitting electroencephalography (EEG) data. Utilising a voting-based system, an adaptive fuzzy predictor, and a tri-stage entropy encoder are the components that comprise this technique. There are three steps that make up the tri-stage entropy encoder. A CMOS technology with a resolution of 0.18 micrometres and 8405 gates was used in the manufacturing process of the design using this technology. The clock speed was 100 megahertz, and the power consumption that was simulated to occur during operation was 2.58 milliwatts. When applied to the CHB-MIT Scalp EEG Database, the method that was recommended was successful in achieving an average compression rate of 2.35 for the 23 channels that were examined. This research resulted in a 14.6% increase in compression rates while simultaneously resulting in a 77.3 percent decrease in hardware expenses. This was accomplished by comparing the results of this study to the presently existing hardware-oriented lossless EEG compression methodologies.

articleTitle: Automating Timetable Generation with Conflict Resolution Algorithms in Web-Based Systems for Educational Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: An unique web-based solution for effective and automated schedule administration in educational institutions is presented by the Automatic Time Table Generator. Heuristic algorithms are used by the system to generate thorough schedules while taking into account a variety of restrictions and needs. The system provides several user interfaces for administrators, Heads of Departments (HODs), and faculty members with a focus on user-friendliness. This guarantees easy access to key functions, such as subject assignment and classroom management. The suggested method offers an automated, precise, and user-centered solution to address the difficulties associated with manual timetable generation. The paper describes the system's numerous components, from its conception through its use. It discusses heuristic algorithms and pertinent research as it goes into the literature review. The benefits of the suggested approach are emphasized, highlighting its capacity to produce schedules with less effort and time consumption. In-depth explanations of the user interfaces, database architecture, and framework are provided for the implementation process. The discussion of prospective improvements for the future and ways to better optimize decision-making and resource allocation comes to a close in the article.

articleTitle: Remote Plant Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: One of the key factors that determines the loss of agricultural production and in its yield is the discernment and recognition of plant diseases. Plant disease research is the investigation of any visible points of defects in any portion of the plant that differentiates it from others. Identifying the disease requires a great deal of effort and competence, as well as extensive knowledge of plants and disease detection investigations. The methods of image accession, extraction, segmentation, and pre-processing of the image's layers, are used to detect diseases, commonly, and still here. This paper presents the technical architecture of our solution, highlighting the integration of Python, FastAPI, and React.js to detect plant diseases and demonstrates its effectiveness through comprehensive testing and evaluation. The results indicate high accuracy in disease detection and underscore the system's potential to revolutionize potato crop health monitoring.

articleTitle: Detecting Brain Tumor at Early Stage Tumor Attest
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: A brain tumor is an accumulation of aberrant brain tissue. Tumors are typically separated into benign and malignant categories when they initially develop. Since tumors can be lethal, it is vital to identify and specify their presence in a brain image. The proposed method employs CNN and support vector machines to identify if a brain tumor is present or absent from an MRI image. In the first stage, when spots are discovered, the input image is converted to grayscale using binary thresholding. The discovered spots are shown according to their intensities in order to differentiate between the normal and tumor brains. Tumor identification is done by employing the SVM-CNN hybrid technique after characterizing the extracted set of characteristics.

articleTitle: IoT-WSN Based Water Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Water pollution poses a significant challenge in the context of promoting environmentally sustainable globalization.Regularly monitoring the quality of water is crucial to guarantee a secure and reliable source of drinking water. In the past twenty years, numerous maritime environmental monitoring systems have been developed, incorporating groundbreaking hi-tech, transmission technologies. The Internet of Things (IoT) has played a significant role in this sector, among other factors, exerting a notable influence. In this study, our proposal involves creating and designing a worthwhile system for control quality of water in real-time by utilizing Internet of Things (IoT) technology. The system is composed of a variety of sensors utilized to evaluate both the physical and chemical characteristics of the water. The attributes of the flow sensor encompass factors such as PH, temperature, turbidity, and various others. The central controller can process the recorded data from sensors. An Arduino model can be utilized to construct the central controller, and, in the end, a mobile app can be employed to access the sensor data online.

articleTitle: Automatic Door Locking System in Households Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Smart door lock system with IoT has become a revolutionizing way of securing houses, banks and offices. Door lock system with IoT have made a huge impact over traditional locking system, it is now one of the efficient ways to avoid unauthorized persons entering inside the premises. This smart door is nowadays installed in almost every houses and offices. By this smart door lock system we can access and monitor the entry of unauthorized person while sitting anywhere in the world.

articleTitle: Smart Women Safety Device Using IoT and GPS Tracker
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The utilisation of IOT is one of the crucial components. Since women are always scared to leave their houses for fear of being physically or sexually mistreated or subjected to violence, women's safety in the modern world has become a critical worry. Despite the market being flooded with smart devices and software, none of them provide a practicalsolution. Experts in many sectors have discovered women's safety technology that operates both manually and automatically for an older method. The message can be provided immediately if the user calls the police station, and the message's accuracy will depend on how accurately the user talks. This work uses a GPS module, GSM module, heartbeat sensor, and Esp-cam to illustrate a women's safety detectionsystem. And the monitoring and messaging system is made up of a “microcontroller”, “GSM modem”, and a “GPS receiver”. Latitude and longitude information is obtained by the GPS receiver from satellites in the form of location data.

articleTitle: Smart Glasses for Disabled People
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative assistive technology aimed at improving the quality of life for individuals with visual impairments. This project presents a system that combines the capabilities You Only Look Once [6] (YOLO) deep learning algorithm with the ESP32 [7] microcontroller to create Object Detection Glasses. These glasses employ real-time object detection to provide users with auditory feedback about their surroundings, enabling them to navigate and interact with their environment more independently. The first task of the glasses is to take pictures of the object and store it as a snap. The second task is that they compare the captured image to the existing image. In order to convert the text into speech, it used Text to Speech technology (TTS). The picture will be taken by ESP 32 with the perfect size the image will be displayed and then by using the speaker the object will be detected. The integration of YOLO [6] and ESP32 [7] offers a cost-effective and efficient solution for enhancing accessibility and inclusivity, promoting greater autonomy and safety for individuals with visual disabilities.

articleTitle: Finger Vein Identification based on Feature Extraction using Line Tracking Method over Edge Detection for Improved Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The aim of the study is to implement finger vein recognition for authorized person identification in security systems for smart homes, industries, and banks. The chosen machine learning techniques are Line Tracking Algorithm and Edge Detection. This phase involves selection of collection of data, training and testing of selected data with suggested classifiers Line Tracking and Edge Detection. For SPSS analysis, the outcomes of the two classifiers are categorized into two groups, each consisting of 20 samples. A G-power pre-test score of 80% and a 95% confidence interval (CI) are used for analysis. Line Tracking Algorithm achieved an accuracy of 93.7220%. Edge Detection achieved an accuracy of 92.1620%. The selected Line Tracking Algorithm showed a statistically significant improvement in digital security compared to the Edge Detection model, with a p-value of 0.004 (p<0.05) in the SPSS statistical analysis. The Line Tracking Algorithm demonstrated a higher accuracy rate (93.7220%) compared to the Edge Detection model (92.1620%). Overall, the study suggests that the Line Tracking Algorithm is more effective for finger vein recognition in security applications compared to the Edge Detection method.

articleTitle: Brain Tumour Detection and Classification using Deep Learning And Transfer Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Identifying a brain tumor in its early stages is crucial, as the condition can become severe and incurable once it progresses. A precise diagnosis of a brain tumor is pivotal in initiating proper treatment, ultimately improving the patient's chances of survival. The examination specifically focuses on techniques rooted in deep learning and transfer learning, such as CNN, ResNet, U Net, and capsule networks. ResNet, an innovative deep learning architecture, has been recently developed to address the limitations of CNNs. Capsule networks are not affected by rotations and translations. Moreover, it explores essential matters and lingering challenges, bringing attention to constraints while proposing intriguing directions for future research. We expect this overview to act as a valuable launchpad for additional inquiries in this domain.

articleTitle: Sniffing Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Sniffing Detection using Machine Learning presents an innovative approach for detecting malicious Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) using the Random Forest Classifier. This system stands out with real-time adaptability, comprehensive feature extraction, and user customization. By integrating cutting-edge machine learning techniques, it offers a robust defense against the evolving landscape of malicious URLs, bridging the gap in cybersecurity solutions. This system's core is an advanced and adaptive URL identification and classification tool. The Random Forest Classifier excels in discerning intricate patterns within URLs, including structure, content, and behavior. Its adaptability and versatility make it an ideal choice for this multifaceted task. Real-time data integration ensures our model remains up-to- date with emerging threats. Additionally, the comprehensive feature extraction process contributes to accuracy, and user customization options adapt to specific needs. Compared to existing solutions, this system offers a holistic approach to malicious URL detection, positioning it as a forward-looking sentinel in the cybersecurity landscape.

articleTitle: E-Commerce System Using Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Consumers have always been concerned with the challenge of a product's size and dimensions being clearly perceived when shopping on the internet. This paper addresses this issue by proposing the development of an e-commerce application created using Android Studio, which integrates Augmented Reality (AR) technology. The primary objective of this effort is to make it easier for consumers to see products in Augmented Reality, which provides them with a visual representation of their size and dimensions before making the purchase. The process of creating an augmented reality module in this app involves a series of steps. In the first place, accurate 3D models of products are obtained by a portable 3D scanner. For the purpose of refinement and enlargement, these scanned models are then imported into software such as Blender. Once mastered, these 3D models will be exported as an Augmented Reality module. For accessibility purposes, these AR modules are then stored in the cloud. To utilize this system, customers simply need to access the AR feature within the app and point their mobile device's front camera at the plain surface. The AR module shall be attached to a real world view through the application and users are able to see their product's size and dimensions in an environment of their choice. In short, it is possible to integrate this technology directly into existing eshop systems or develop new platforms that offer flexibility and accessibility for a broad range of online retailers. Overall, the innovative ECommerce app uses Augmented Reality Technology to overcome the persisting challenge of seeing how much a product is when you shop on the Internet. By providing customers with a real world context of product interaction, they strengthen their trust, reduce uncertainty and in the end achieve a more pleasant and reliable shopping experience on the internet.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Machine Learning Classification for Parkinson's Disease from Biomedical Audio Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Millions of people throughout the world suffer from the crippling neurological ailment known as Parkinson's disease (PD). While there is no cure for PD, early recognition and intervention can improve a patient's quality of life. The use of machine learning for the categorization of Parkinson's disease using biomedical audio data has gained popularity in recent years. In this study, we employ classification algorithms to categorize Parkinson's disease patients using a clinical, genetic, and audio dataset. In this paper, we analyze the effectiveness of various classification algorithms for detecting Parkinson's disease, such as Logistic Regression, k-NN, decision tree, random forest, and an ensemble model employing AdaBoost classifier. Our results demonstrate that the accuracy of the decision tree classifier algorithm outperforms the other algorithms by 92.59% on our dataset. In particular, the study highlights the potential use of algorithms for machine learning in identifying and diagnosing the early stages of Parkinson's disease.

articleTitle: IoT-RPC Based Remote Controlling System for Energy-Efficient Air Conditioning and Ventilation in Shopping Malls
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The rapid increase in public places, such as shopping malls, theatres, and supermarkets, has made it imperative to maintain a comfortable indoor environment for visitors. This work proposes a remote-controlling system to optimize the operation of air conditioners, ventilators, lights, and fans in shopping malls, ensuring both visitor comfort and energy efficiency. The system integrates the ESP32 microcontroller and the ThingsBoard IoT platform for seamless communication between devices and by utilizing the JSON-RPC protocol over MQTT communication. The proposed hardware setup involves deploying ESP32 microcontrollers on each shopping mall floor. MQTT communication is established between the ESP32 microcontroller and the ThingsBoard platform, enabling remote control of devices through an intuitive dashboard. The results demonstrate effective control over air conditioners and ventilators, leading to significant energy savings and enhanced visitor comfort.

articleTitle: Legal Solutions - Intelligent Chatbot using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In the digital age, navigating legal complexities can be challenging for individuals lacking legal expertise or access to legal counsel. To address this issue, we present an innovative AI chatbot solution. This chatbot empowers users by offering fundamental legal knowledge, personalized instructions, and rapid responses aligned with specific document requirements and procedural nuances. Users also have the unique capability to engage in real-time discussions with qualified attorneys, enabling them to effectively manage intricate legal matters. Furthermore, our system allows users to customize searches based on their financial circumstances and geographic location, ensuring legal guidance tailored to their individual context. Leveraging advanced machine learning techniques, the chatbot autonomously retrieves and processes information pertinent to users' particular legal concerns, ensuring timely and accurate responses. This comprehensive approach seeks to democratize legal resource access, providing equal opportunities for individuals across society to seek clarity and assistance for their legal needs. This paper outlines the chatbot's architecture, NLP techniques, and machine learning algorithms while highlighting its potential to revolutionize legal support services

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Exposure Therapy for Claustrophobia and Nyctophobia
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Claustrophobia and nyctophobia are common anxiety disorders characterized by intense fear and avoidance of confined spaces and darkness, respectively. Virtual exposure therapy (VET) has emerged as a promising treatment modality for these phobias, utilizing immersive virtual reality (VR) environments to simulate feared situations and facilitate gradual exposure. Numerous studies have demonstrated the efficacy of VET in reducing phobic symptoms and improving psychological well-being in individuals with claustrophobia and nyctophobia. VET provides a controlled and safe environment, allowing patients to gradually confront and habituate to their fears by manipulating levels of exposure and providing immediate feedback. By offering realistic simulations of confined spaces and darkness, VET enhances treatment engagement, reduces dropout rates, and complements traditional exposure therapy approaches. Virtual environments used in VET for claustrophobia may include scenarios such as elevators, small rooms, or crowded spaces, while those for nyctophobia might involve dark rooms, forests at night, or enclosed spaces with limited lighting. These immersive scenarios allow therapists to tailor exposure sessions to the specific needs of each individual, fostering a sense of presence and immersion that enhances the therapeutic experience. The advantages of VET include its flexibility, accessibility, and cost-effectiveness. Virtual environments can be easily customized to match the patient's specific phobic triggers and gradually increase in intensity over time. VET also provides access to exposure therapy in remote or rural areas where specialized therapists may not be readily available. Moreover, it reduces the need for real-life exposure, thus eliminating potential risks associated with in vivo exposure. Despite those benefits, a few obstacles remain. Technical challenges, such as motion sickness or visual artefacts, may impact the overall experience and require careful calibration. Additionally, individual differences in the response to virtual environments and potential limitations in generalization to real-world situations warrant further investigation. In conclusion, virtual exposure therapy offers a promising avenue for the treatment of claustrophobia and nyctophobia. It provides, a safe environment that facilitates gradual exposure and helps individuals confront and overcome their fears.

articleTitle: Image-Based Plant Disease Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Due to the nation's rapid population expansion and rising food consumption, agriculture is essential to India's economy and people. Consequently, agricultural yields need to rise. Crops produce so little as a result of diseases brought on by bacteria, viruses, and fungi. Adopt techniques for identifying plant diseases to stop it. To diagnose diseases since they lay a high emphasis on the data themselves and provide significance to the results of certain tasks using algorithms. Here, a method for employing CNN to find plant diseases has been proposed. To ascertain the size of the sick area and the time complexity, simulation studies and analyses are conducted on sample photos. It is accomplished using image processing methods. There are 32 different classes, including three courses focused on plants (apple, potato, and tomato), have been fed to the model. The total number of sick plant leaves is 24, including those that are impacted by diseases like Apple Rust and others. Different performance matrices are built and jointly trained using the ResNet architecture to categorize the images of sick and healthy leaves for the same produced datasets of leaves. When compared to other models like the Random Forest and SVM, the model's output exhibits superior accuracy, which is 99.2%.

articleTitle: Density-based Traffic Control and Stolen Vehicle Detection Using Arduino and RFID
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In India, traffic problems are a major concern, especially for people residing in major cities and sub-urban areas where traffic must be monitored and cleared manually by traffic police due to the sheer population of the nation which can lead to people being stuck in traffic for hours on end. Addressing this problem, we have proposed a solution involving density-based traffic management which also includes a stolen vehicle detection system, identifying red light-violating vehicles, stolen vehicle detection, and emergency vehicle detection for free flow of traffic for emergency vehicles using Arduino, GSM module and RFID.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based System for Nephrologist to Classify Diabetic Kidney Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Progressive loss of renal function is the hallmark of diabetic kidney disease (DKD), a disorder that advances over time and carries a high death rate. Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) can be identified early and treated if found early. Since DKD doesn't have any symptoms, it raises the risk factor when it's at a critical state. In order to prevent DKD, it is crucial from a medical standpoint to use a machine-first model to anticipate when the disease may manifest. Based on their health information, people can use open-source machine learning algorithms to assess their risk of acquiring DKD. In this proposed work, the patient health care dataset is subjected to a variety of machine learning techniques. The quantity of datasets and clinical factors utilized to train the algorithm determines the range of prediction accuracy levels. The goal of this study is to increase the overall accuracy through the use of a combination of machine learning algorithms. The suggested model uses the K-Nearest Neighbour, SVM, and Hybrid algorithm -GBRF -Random Forest mixed with Gradient Boosting that allows for hyper parameter fine tuning. This project's combination strategy produced more reliable results when compared to models utilized in other investigations. Clinical data from a repository serves as the foundation for the existing model. To validate the results, real-time data was also acquired. Random Forest demonstrates the most effective performance of GBRF with the highest accuracy score of 97.5% for repository data and 100% for clinical real-time data, respectively, based on the accuracy, recall, and f1-score from the classification reports among the three algorithms combined with a gradient booster.

articleTitle: Automatic Flow Control Electrolyte Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Electrolyte regulates body functions such as nerve and muscle function, hydrate the body, balance blood acidity, maintain pressure and help rebuild damaged tissue. Usually, in hospitals, an electrolyte is administered to patients orally or through an Intravenous (IV) drip. As per studies, an electrolyte is used to treat the imbalance characteristics of a patient. Continuous monitoring of fluid levels is imperative during the administration of saline therapy for conditions such as dehydration and other medical ailments. Instances of inadvertent emptying of the saline container due to lapses in attention or human error can result in the retrograde flow of blood from the patient's circulatory system, leading to critical medical situations that necessitate a more effective solution. In response to the pressing concern, Automatic flow control electrolyte monitoring system is proposed. The system is designed to proactively sense the fluid saline level and promptly alert the hospital's monitoring room when the contents of the saline container dip below a threshold and an automatic flow control is also incorporated. The system relies on the utilization of a load cell equipped with an HX711 amplifier, which precisely detects the level in the fluid. To execute the flow-stop function, an 8mm flow control solenoid valve is integrated, effectively ceasing the saline flow when necessary.

articleTitle: Empowering Deaf and Mute Children through Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Through the use of deep learning algorithms, this project aims to create a real-time video-based interactive sign language translation education system for people who are deaf or hard of hearing and have trouble learning how to communicate with others. The Flask framework and a pre-trained model for classification are part of the system to improve understanding and communication with sign language. In the future, the project proposes employing python libraries and tensor flow for image input prediction, which can effectively solve many communication problems. The proposed system presents an innovative and engaging approach to teaching and boosting communication abilities in deaf and dumb children. This paper highlights the proposed system's methodology, implementation, and results, demonstrating its effectiveness and potential for further development.

articleTitle: Patient Health Care Monitoring in Home Using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The IoT-based healthcare system has emerged as a ground breaking solution to address the growing demand for remote patient monitoring and timely healthcare intervention. This project presents a comprehensive approach to healthcare monitoring, integrating multiple sensors such as a heart rate sensor, temperature sensor, GSM module, and fingerprint sensor, all orchestrated through an Arduino-based platform. The system aims to provide real-time health data tracking and instant emergency response capabilities, enhancing the quality of healthcare delivery and patient outcomes. The proposed IoT-based healthcare system is designed to be user-friendly, allowing patients to wear the monitoring device comfortably. The collected data is transmitted securely to a cloud-based server for storage and analysis. Healthcare professionals can access the patient's data through a web or mobile application, enabling remote monitoring and timely intervention. This project aims to revolutionize healthcare by providing continuous, real-time monitoring of vital health parameters, enabling early detection of health issues, and ensuring rapid response in emergency situations. The integration of multiple sensors and communication modules through the Arduino platform makes it a versatile and scalable solution that can be adapted for various healthcare settings, ultimately improving patient care and well-being.

articleTitle: EcoDynoSim
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The largest source of pollution and ozone depleting chemical emissions worldwide is transportation. With the advancement of innovation, the introduction of Electric Vehicles has given the transportation framework a foothold in the automotive sector. Currently, electric vehicles are the best option for both individual and public transportation given the climate.Because it combines complex subsystems including the battery management system, executive frameworks, electrical motors, and power electronics interfaces, EV modeling is very challenging. The right component selection can help electric vehicles operate farther and more effectively. A Li-ion battery supply, a permanent magnet DC motor, an H-Bridge controller, a set of wheels, a drive cycle, and a vehicle body are all components of the constructed simulation model. Here, the previously described EV system components were reviewed and simulated using MATLAB's Simulink tool. There has been introduced a simple coordinated State of charge (SoC) and Voltage evaluation approach. By employing this technique, the BMS processor computing difficulties can be avoided while the battery SoC, Current, and Voltage are efficiently analyzed. In light of this, a special model is suggested to achieve improved EV stability and performance.

articleTitle: Water Purifier with Clogged Copper Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Safe and clean drinking water is necessary for maintaining the social health and well-being. Water purification systems (RO) play a vital role in ensuring the removing the contaminants and pathogens from drinking water. Copper filters are commonly used in the water purifiers due to their antimicrobial properties and effectiveness in removal of impurities. We know that the, copper filters can be clogged according to the impurities, leading to the decline in their filtration process. This abstract is to presents about a study which investigates the phenomenon of copper filter clogging in water purification systems. To explore the factors contributing to the clogging of copper filters, includes the type and concentration of contaminants in the water source, filter design, and operational conditions. It also examine the problems faced by clogged copper filters based on their water quality and the performance of water purifiers. This issue is to take forward about crisis, we propose on solutions and preventive measures for maintaining copper filter performance in water purifiers. These solutions may include regular maintenance, chemical treatment, and the development of innovative filter designs. Including, it is discussed about the economic and environmental impact of maintaining copper filters and alterative filtration technologies that may be more changes to avoid clogging in the filter.

articleTitle: VR Premised Micro UAV for Surveillance and Rescue Operations
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: There are catastrophes everywhere in the globe. Every year, tragedies like building fires and forest fires claim thousands of lives. Because it's challenging to find the individual, the majority of lives are lost in fire accidents. In this instance, a drone is used to find the individual. Yet in smaller locations, where there are numerous difficult and secluded areas, bigger drones can't get there. Some places are beyond of human reach, and it is difficult to find the person there. Commercially produced UAV with superior performance in these fields are too pricey. Creating a Mini VR drone that can perform a rescue mission efficiently. This prototype comes with a tiny drone and a portable VR camera. The Pose tracking and 3D near-eye displays are two technological developments in virtual reality (VR), which can provide users a real time experience of a virtual environment. We might be able to locate individuals in emergency circumstances when humans are unable to reach them by incorporating this technology into a tiny drone.

articleTitle: Smart Solutions for Hand Rub Dispenser
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Covid 19 which had a great impact and cost many becomes a worry when they enter into the body of human beings through hands. Miscellaneous vaccines are introduced and they are serving good in different countries. prevents bacteria from entering the body, to prevent these many preventive measures were taken like social distancing, sanitizing hands, etc. Although sanitizing our hands through soap\soapy liquids leads to the spreading of disease so automatic hand dispensers are being used TSOP sensor which has special specifications like accuracy, great sensing ability, and low cost which makes this better than the IR sensor and ultrasonic sensor.

articleTitle: Various Technologies on Object Detecton and Natural Language Processing for Visually Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Modern technology has ushered in a transformative era for individuals with physical disabilities, offering new possibilities for enhanced independence. This proposal introduces a groundbreaking mobile application meticulously designed to empower people with disabilities by addressing common challenges encountered during daily life. The central focus of this app is to harness cutting-edge technology to assist individuals with physical disabilities in achieving greater autonomy. Two core functionalities are at the heart of this solution: object detection and multilingual voice-to-text conversion.

articleTitle: Revamped Surveillance Rover
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The Revamped Surveillance Rover is specifically designed to reach new milestones in Industrial and Defence Surveillance. This project as the name suggests is a revamped version designed considering the present generation of rovers. Real-time data analysis empowers the rover to swiftly detect and identify potential threats, triggering timely alerts. Its communication system facilitates remote operation and live data transmission, minimizing human exposure to risk. In industries, the rover monitors critical infrastructure and manufacturing facilities, identifying anomalies and safety breaches. In military contexts, it enhances security, border surveillance, and reconnaissance missions. Improving the overall mileage and battery life, Proper handling and launching samples instead of collecting on the site, autonomous & controlled operations, On board sample tester (preliminary) and many other features. Using Jetson nano, mapping for autonomous functions and motors are major parts of this project. This project will be set for rover competitions and can be easily adapted to Industrial & Defence Surveillance rovers.

articleTitle: Subjective Analysis and Progressive Assistance of Psychological Disorders
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Living in the present world, with its ever growing population and rapid changes in socio-economic scenarios, awareness on psychological health and its importance has also risen. However, disorders such as stress, anxiety and depression have now been synonymized to be personality traits rather than medical conditions that need to be tactically dealt with. The causes and cures of these psychological disorders may be different for each individual, but the principal factor lies in conceding to the problem. Existing platforms provide generalized counsel to a person, whereas an incremental and progressive approach to aid a person in their mental health journey lays the groundwork for recovery.

articleTitle: Characterization of Wrist Pulse Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This project is focused on the integration of traditional Ayurvedic principles with forefront technology and machine learning techniques to develop a system that operates automatically for the diagnosis of diseases through pulse analysis. Its primary aim is the development of a non-invasive Nadi Pariksha system that can aid healthcare professionals in the identification of various medical conditions. This approach is designed to augment early disease detection and diagnosis, ultimately mitigating the mortality rates associated with delayed diagnoses. The system is primarily focused on the assessment of wrist pulses (Nadi) at three specific anatomical locations, denoted as ‘vata,’ ‘pitta,’ and ‘kapha,’ utilizing pulse sensors. These pulse readings are subjected to processing to extract crucial pulse characteristics such as shape, rate, and amplitude. Advanced signal processing methods, including amplification, filtering, and noise reduction, they are used to improve the quality of pulse data, ensuring the precision of measurements. A substantial dataset of human pulse samples is amassed, representing a diverse range of health conditions. This dataset serves as a critical component in training a machine learning model designed to discern patterns between pulse characteristics and various health conditions, thereby creating a predictive tool for disease diagnosis. The machine learning model undergoes rigorous training and evaluation, with the Random Forest algorithm emerging as the preferred choice due to its superior accuracy (86.4%) when compared to other models, such as XG Boost and Multi-SVM. Prior to real-world implementation, the system's accuracy and reliability necessitate thorough validation through clinical testing. Ethical considerations, encompassing patient privacy, data security, and informed consent, hold utmost significance to ensure the ethical application of this healthcare technology. The potential benefits of this system include early disease detection, reduced mortality rates, and regular monitoring of patients‘ health, making it a valuable tool in preventing delayed diagnoses.

articleTitle: Smart Dosing: Harnessing AI for Alum dosage Predictions in Water Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Water treatment methods, such as coagulation, flocculation, and sedimentation, play a crucial role in maintaining water quality. However, these methods encounter limitations due to the increasing pollution stemming from household, agricultural, and industrial waste. In response to this issue, our study delves into the exploration of advanced machine learning algorithms (SVM, MLR, RFR) for a comprehensive analysis of water. The findings from our research contribute to the development of an innovative laboratory treatment plant designed to mitigate the environmental impact caused by water pollution.

articleTitle: Estimation of Meterological Drought Prediction by SPEI Using SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Water is an important element found on Earth and in modern days scarcity of water leads to drought. Drought prediction is the process to predict the occurrence of drought with the use of several components such as wind speed, temperature, humidity, rainfall. This model is based on Machine Learning mainly using Support Vector Machine (SVM) Algorithm and SPEI data sets. Standardized evapotranspiration precipitation index (SPEI) proposed for drought analysis as a case study in Asian countries. We looked at two composite time periods ranging from three months (SPEI-3) to six months (SPEI-6), and we came to the conclusion that employing SPEI-3 would be more manageable and predictable than the established method. Priority over Random Forest (RF) algorithm due to increased accuracy. Identification of sub-regional patterns of drought co-variability using principal component analysis (PCA). From the original SPEI data, a few new representative ones were created using the PCA. Another algorithm that should be implemented is the gradient boosting machine algorithm. The approach is built on the concept of boosting, which incorporates all of a group of weak learners forecast to generate a strong learner using extra training methods. Our project's primary goal is to use SVM to make predictions with greater accuracy.

articleTitle: Geospatial and Forecasting on Twitter Crime-A Review of Research
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The idea of social media started to gain popularity in the late 1990s and has been vital in bringing people together throughout the world. This study examines how social media, specifically Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram, can increase women's safety in Indian cities. This review article intends to categorize, visualize, and forecast Indian crime tweet data using the social media network Twitter and to present a spatiotemporal view of crime in the nation using statistical and machine learning algorithms. The relevant tweets were retrieved using the search feature of the Tweepy Python package and the ‘#crime’ query, which was then classified using 318 distinct criminal keywords. Geospatial and analytical visualizations are produced by the Python modules gmaps and bokeh, respectively. The accuracy of the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), and Seasonal Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) models are compared in order to find the best model for time series forecasting of crime tweet count.

articleTitle: Classifier Based Malware Detection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: One of the main security issues for the Windows platform is malware. Any sort of computer programme known as malware interferes with the accessibility of computer services. The conventional detection methods, such the intrusion detection and prevention system. The use of signature-based techniques prevents anti-virus software and similar tools from detecting undetectable malware. Consequently, it's essential to precisely identify this type of malware in a Windows or Android environment. This paper introduces classifier based malware detection techniques [CBMT] a machine learning (ML)-based algorithm that excerpts characteristics from the header of a portable runnable file to decide whether the executable is dangerous or not. To combat the infection, a decision tree is used. Additionally, in order to choose the best ML model for the specific issue, comparison analyses of the models are done. Using this, it is probable to create a desktop programme for any platform that can be customised to check for malware.

articleTitle: Dormitory Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
