abstract: The “Dormitory Management” web application is devised with the primary objective of streamlining and optimizing the allocation of university hostel accommodations for college students, concurrently enhancing the efficiency of student activity tracking by hostel authorities. Serving as a digital repository for hostel records, this platform offers a centralized and automated solution for fundamental dormitory management tasks. The core aim of this research article is to meticulously explore the system's design, development, and functionality, showcasing its significant potential to markedly enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of hostel administration processes within educational institutions.

articleTitle: Grouping Based Wrong Way Vehicle Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The Vehicle location is utilized to recognize the vehicles in any video or picture document. The course of recognition of vehicles incorporates the item location by thinking about the vehicles as the essential article. By taking the pictures structure elevated or even view and from street or stopping utilizing observation cameras, the location interaction can be started. Vehicle identification and order assumes critical part in rush hour gridlock checking and the executives. The use of vehicle recognition and order is exceptionally immense. Vehicle identification is utilized on streets, roadways, leaving or some other spot to distinguish or follow the quantity of vehicles present on the spot. This will assist the reconnaissance with passing judgment on the traffic vehicles, normal speed and classification of vehicle. There are number of item recognition methods are accessible to distinguish and arrange them.

articleTitle: GPS Enabled Short Range Communication for Vehicle Tracking and Accident Alert System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: A rise in the number of automobiles on roads has been correlated with an increase in accidents as a result of vehicles becoming more and more affordable. The frequency of accidents has sharply increased in the modern era. People are risking their lives by driving too fast, and since there are no cutting-edge procedures available, the number of accidents can never be reduced.The principal aim is to manage accidents by utilizing wireless techniques to send a message to the victim's phone number or a monitoring station. In case of a mishap anywhere, a note is quickly delivered through a system for mobile communication (GSM) module to the registered mobile phone. During the above incident the relevant sensor will sound, to enable the system to relay the accident's location to the near and dear ones. The accident site's location can be determined with the use of the global positioning system(GPS) device. If an accident happens in a networking area, the aforementioned procedure will take place. If the accident occurs in a non-network area, the location of the accident will be sent from one network repository function(NRF) module to another. The system designed in the work checks for the occurrence of accident and intimates to the nearest medical centres and to the dear ones contacts about the incident using GSM, GPS and NRF modules. The respective authorities take care of the casualties effectively by tracking the location where the accident has occurred within no time.

articleTitle: MED-LENS — Al-based tool for preliminary diagnosis of Dermatological manifestations
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Access to healthcare for skin diseases is challenging, particularly in rural areas, due to limited specialized services, long waiting times, and low awareness. The Med Lens project aims to address these disparities with user-friendly skin disease detection, diagnosis, and consultation services. It leverages technology, including Raspberry Pi 4 Model B and CNNs, to enhance disease detection and provide information The hardware uses Raspberry Pi 4 Model B with a camera module and LCD screen for image capture and display. The software employs CNNs to identify skin diseases accurately, generating detailed medical reports. Database management and cloud technologies ensure data integrity and accessibility. A user-friendly GUI simplifies interactions, allowing input of patient data and delivering rapid, accurate results. This research yielded a positive result achieving a test accuracy of 92.78% and a very low-test loss of 1.11% Med Lens aims to reduce healthcare disparities and improve dermatology care in underserved areas, enhancing patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Fuel Monitoring in Bike Vehicles Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In this work, we explore the feasibility of automatically dispensing gasoline using a prepaid RFID card. Individual RFID cards loaded with predetermined quantities will be provided to each user. The gasoline station's dispenser has an RFID reader that can scan the card and update the available balance on an LCD screen. The user inputs the required fuel quantity via keypad, and the system then determines how long the electrical fuel pump needs to run for and begins distributing the gasoline. When the system detects that the target level has been reached, it will immediately turn off the pump. It utilizes a Raspberry Pi module to alert the user through their smartphone. In addition, there is a fire sensor and a fuel purity sensor in this system to prevent fires and ensure clean fuel. As a result, the gasoline bunk management system will be decentralized and need fewer people to operate.

articleTitle: Careex - an AI Assisted Career Guidance and Eligibility Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The education sector will be seeing a vast change in the way it functions in this digital world. As we shut our doors to the outside, many options and other alternatives have opened right inside our house. There will be two types of people choosing their career. 1. Individuals are stuck as ‘What next’. Since the lack of guidance and not wanting to study what your parents or relatives want us to, has sucked us all many times. 2. There are some individuals who want to enter a particular university, but don't know how to pursue it. In order to solve these two problems, a single platform should be available which will provide a perfect career guidance for the student community. The is to figure out how to choose, identify, and explore their interests while also getting help selecting potential career choices and skill-building alternatives. Successful individuals in their field of interest will provide them with exciting advice in direct interaction with them. CareEx is an AI/ML-based help system that offers a Career dendrogram with many alternatives, including the real workforce requirements, broken down by category, for the public and private sectors. Our solution's primary purpose is to set professional objectives for users and estimate their likelihood of enrolling in the schools and institutions of their choice. With this guidance, many individuals will be able to see the future options that are open to them in the current situation as well as learn more about themselves, their strengths, and the ideal career path for them.

articleTitle: An Exploratory Study of Abstractive Text Summarization Using a Sequence-to-Sequence Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Text summarization has evolved over a period of time in various domains and benefits most professionals and researchers. To provide salient summarization in a short span of time, various approaches to text summarization are discovered. The objective of the paper is to increase the efficiency of the model by delivering a concise and precise summary. The intention of text summarization is to provide sufficient topic coverage and readability. The paper also presents the applications and limitations of text summarization. The study utilized a sequence-to-sequence model stacked with LSTM networks for text summarization. The results of the sequence-to-sequence model are better than other conventional models.

articleTitle: CHECK BUS - Bus Monitoring System for MTC Buses
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The Bus Monitoring System for Local Buses is a comprehensive technological solution designed to enhance the efficiency, safety, and overall user experience of the local bus transportation network. With the exponential growth of technology and population in the region, ensuring an effective public transportation system has become crucial. This abstract provides an overview of the key features and benefits of the proposed bus monitoring system. By tracking the precise location of buses in real time, passengers can access accurate arrival and departure times through mobile applications or display boards at bus stops. This enables commuters to plan their journeys more efficiently, reducing waiting times and increasing overall satisfaction. Additionally, the system allows passengers to book them a seat and the booked seat is verified and allotted by scanner the QR code generated in the user's device with a QR scanner in the conductor's device and authorities to monitor bus schedules, detect delays, and take proactive measures to maintain service reliability. Moreover, the system enhances safety and security by providing live monitoring of buses. Authorities can identify and respond to emergencies promptly, ensuring the well-being of passengers and preventing potential accidents or incidents.

articleTitle: Hospital Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This paper introduces a cutting-edge Hospital Management System (HMS) that combines blockchain technology and NFC hardware to enhance data management, streamline operations, and improve patient outcomes. The system utilizes blockchain as a secure ledger for patient records, ensuring data integrity and privacy. NFC-enabled wristbands/cards grant easy access to patient data for healthcare providers, reducing errors and enhancing care. NFC also streamlines patient check-ins, medication administration, and asset tracking within the hospital. Furthermore, this integration fosters interoperability, allowing patients to seamlessly share medical records with different providers, reducing redundancy and improving care continuity. In summary, the HMS offers a secure and efficient healthcare management solution with potential to elevate standards and interoperability in the industry.

articleTitle: Route-Based User Segmentation and Clustering: A Machine Learning Approach for Enhanced Transportation Service
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Advancements in machine learning have paved the way for innovative solutions in the realm of transportation. This paper presents a novel technique for sorting users based on their travel routes, with a versatile application in autonomous vehicles for intercommunication and enhanced passenger experiences. In this approach, real-time location data and route preferences of users are harnessed to dynamically group travellers sharing similar routes, fostering efficient communication and information sharing during transit. The method employs machine learning algorithms to analyze user trajectories and preferences, forming cohesive user clusters based on their common routes. Users within each cluster are seamlessly connected through an integrated communication platform, facilitating real-time interactions, sharing of route-specific updates, and mutual support. This innovative approach not only enhances the travel experience by promoting social connections among passengers but also holds the potential for improving route optimization, vehicle efficiency, and passenger safety within autonomous vehicle networks. Through extensive experimentation and validation, this technique demonstrates its efficacy in real-world scenarios, showcasing its adaptability and robustness for various modes of transportation. The findings underscore the promising implications of this approach in transforming the landscape of autonomous vehicles and public transportation by creating connected, informed, and engaged passenger communities.

articleTitle: UV-Disinfectant Robot Using Bluetooth
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This robot's job is to help stop the transmission of germs in airports, hospitals, public transportation, and other confined spaces. Using UVC light as an agent, this robot used the physical disinfection approach. Robot uses a biosensor as well as UV light to travel around the space and sterilise the microorganisms. So, the robot can maintain a germ-free environment in the room. The UVC devices are categorised based on mobility, order kinds, combined disinfection agents, auxiliary devices, and disinfectant units. The most effective tool for rendering germs inactive is this mobile robot. Ten UVC lights in total are installed on the robot; there are two lamps on top and eight UVC lamps arranged around a centre column. The column is mounted to a base that has many integrated sensors for obstacle avoidance, motion plus position detection, and motion detection. Robot UVC uses ultraviolet light to disinfect surfaces and equipment; while people are present, it turns off to protect their safety. The robot's UVC lights led can eradicate 99.99% of microorganisms.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Imaging: Network Exudate Detection to Classify Abnormalities
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The DR becomes increasingly common, there is a need to automatically extract and classify disease severity. Due to diabetes problems, about 2% of people with this disease become completely blind, and DR complications make him 10% visually impaired if he has diabetes for 15 years. Furthermore, it plays an important role in the progression of blindness in middle-aged and older adults. If the disease is not recognized as soon as possible, patients can experience a severe stage of irreversible blindness. The shortage of ophthalmologists is a serious problem for the growing number of diabetic patients. Hard exudates must be found to screen and assist in disease monitoring and diagnosis. Therefore, Lloyd's clustering technique was used in this work.

articleTitle: Track the Stop
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The proposed College Bus Tracking System presents a holistic solution to rectify the current inadequacies in college bus transportation by harnessing the capabilities of smartphone technology. The primary goal is to establish a precise real-time tracking mechanism for buses, empowering both students and staff to effortlessly monitor bus locations and receive timely notifications. This initiative effectively alleviates prevalent safety concerns, untimely delays, and inconveniences associated with the existing manual procedures. It is particularly noteworthy that this system holds exceptional significance during adverse weather conditions, as it mitigates the discomfort faced by students and staff due to uninformed waiting at designated stops. To ensure the successful realization of this proposed solution, leveraging the mobile GPS system is pivotal. It is imperative to establish a resilient technological framework, prioritize data privacy imperatives, foster extensive user adoption, implement a meticulous maintenance regimen, and seamlessly integrate the system into existing infrastructures. By addressing these considerations, the proposed College Bus Tracking System has the potential to revolutionize college transportation, offering a safer, more efficient, and user-friendly experience for all stakeholders involved.

articleTitle: A Third Eye for Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Individuals who experience the ill effects of low vision, sight and visual debilitation can't see and distinguish people, items, words and letters. Propose a camera-based detection to visually impaired persons to peruse names of the trained persons, Products, object and texts. This proposed system will help them to identify the person using Facial Recognition technique, and helps to identify the some of the objects in front of them such as(Bottle, chair, person, cat, dog, plant and etc.,). By using Optical character recognition technique, we can ably read the printed texts on books, Magazines and etc, This Proposed system acts as an artificial eye to visually impaired people. It doesn't need any human supervision.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach for Real-Time Drowsiness Detection: Aware Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Driving while fatigued continues to be a serious problem that threatens many lives and necessitates immediate action. As a result, scientists and engineers have worked harder to create reliable and effective sleepiness detecting devices. The integration of artificial intelligence and sensor technologies is highlighted particularly in this paper's thorough evaluation of the most recent techniques and technological developments in sleepiness detection. The proposed sleepiness detection system uses state-of-the-art computer vision, machine learning, and sensor data fusion approaches to track driver states in real time. The system provides a comprehensive and precise assessment of sleepiness levels by examining a wide range of physiological and behavioural signs, such as facial expressions, eye movements, physiological signals, and vehicle dynamics. The difficulties with sleepiness detection, such as dataset diversity, real-world validation, and false positive/negative identification, are also critically evaluated in this study. By overcoming these challenges, the suggested framework aims to reduce mistakes and provide drivers with precise, timely alerts, reducing the likelihood of accidents brought on by driver fatigue. The ultimate goal of this research is to increase road safety by offering a thorough and clever approach to successfully counteract drowsy driving. The improvements in sleepiness detection show great promise for fostering a safer driving environment and ensuring the safety of all road users, with the potential to save innumerable lives.

articleTitle: Location Based Disaster Report
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Disasters of various types and magnitudes afflict regions worldwide, necessitating a comprehensive understanding of their causes, characteristics, and impacts. Preparedness measures are paramount in mitigating the fear and losses that accompany such events. This research addresses the imperative for disaster preparedness by developing a novel informatics approacha region-wise repository and prediction web application. The primary objective of this project is to lower the risk of disaster impact by creating a repository that not only catalogs the types of disasters but also recommends necessary precautions, contingent upon the user's location. Each geographical region's susceptibility to specific disasters is unveiled, facilitating informed decisions regarding housing construction and disaster resilience. Furthermore, this paper emphasizes the colossal human and economic toll of disasters and highlights the pivotal role of the web application in constructing a region-wise disaster repository. By favor of web scraping techniques and machine learning algorithms, this application generates detailed predictions and offers needed precautionary guidance. This research represents a significant advancement in disaster preparedness, empowering individuals and communities to proactively safeguard against the catastrophic consequences of unforeseen events.

articleTitle: MARUNCURA- Tomorrow's Care, Today's Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The percentage of elders in the country is projected to rise to almost 12.5 percent by 2026 and surpass 19.5 percent by 2050. With the elderly constituting 16% of the world's population, It is necessary to be concerned about their health status. Upon this consideration, the project focuses on developing a smart AI application which provides an all- encompassing diagnosis for the elderly. It offers regular medical advice and early disease detection. The application would help solve one of the main issues affecting the older generation, that is a lack of medical expertise and imprudence about their health. Since they are more likely to have multiple chronic medical conditions than younger individuals, older adults utilize medications more often than younger ones. On the whole, the purpose of this application is to give them basic medical assistance. Some of the key implementations of the project includes checking parameters like expiry, dosage, and symptoms, detecting MRI scans, monitoring sprain or fracture through sensors, medicinal intake and monthly check up alerts.

articleTitle: Control and Monitoring of pH Process
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The pH neutralization process is considered as highly requisite in many applications such as pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, chemical industries, power plant and many more. The process in which opposing solution is added to acid or base in order to achieve desired pH value is known as pH control. The pH neutralization process is highly non-linear and has time varying characteristics. The aim of our project is to simulate the pH neutralization process using various controllers and to compare the evaluation criteria obtained from the output response. Conventional PID controller, Fuzzy controller and Neuro – Fuzzy controllers are implemented using is MATLAB 2010. The Performance criteria such as IAE, ISE and ITAE of the conventional and intelligent controllers are compared and efficient method in overcoming the errors occurring in pH Process.

articleTitle: A Compact Flexible Frequency Reconfigurable Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The main aim of our project is to design a frequency reconfigurable antenna with a good gain compared to the existing model. Our proposed antenna will provide a max gain at high frequency. In mobile phone there are three to four antennas are used. Because of this the cost for buying antennas are huge. A huge amount has to be spent to buy antennas and fix it in the mobile phones, so a single antenna canactin different frequency is a best solution for the problem. It is given, a small, flexible frequency reconfigurable antenna. The flexible Rogers RT/duroid5880 substrate, which measures just 30 × 28.4 × 1.5 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, is used in the suggested design. With its two surface-integrated switches by changing the current distribution and, the resonance frequency using various switch situations, this antenna may be reconfigured for a different frequency. The antenna is being stimulated using CST. Over the intended frequency ranges, The stimulated antenna using CST shows notable radiation patterns with maximum gain value of 3.06 dBi and VSWR < 2 used in mobile applications.

articleTitle: Core Concepts of Engineering in Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) is an emerging technological advancement that facilitates immersive and interactive experiences within the context of the real-world environment. The main goal of this project is to lead the way in creating a cutting-edge educational platform based on 3D Augmented Reality. This platform is designed to replace long-standing conventional two-dimensional (2D) educational approaches. The limitations of 2D education in terms of lacking immersive qualities and interactivity have rendered them increasingly ineffective in engaging students. The proposed remedy involves the creation of comprehensive 3D educational models and components, integrated with AR technology. This AR application presents a considerably more appealing and engaging alternative for students to elucidate abstract concepts. This research paper is meticulously designed to explore the applications of AR within the sphere of education, with a particular focus on its relevance in clarifying fundamental engineering concepts, including but not limited to Finite Automata, Data Structures, Operating Systems, and Database Management Systems.

articleTitle: Aquaculture Water Quality Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Aquaculture plays a pivotal role in meeting the growing global demand for seafood, but its sustainability is contingent upon maintaining optimal water quality conditions. This paper presents the design and implementation of an advanced Aquaculture Water Quality Monitoring System (AWQMS) that leverages sensor technologies, data analytics, and real-time communication to ensure the continuous assessment and management of water quality parameters in aquaculture facilities. The AWQMS incorporates a network of sensors to measure crucial parameters such as dissolved oxygen (DO), pH, temperature, ammonia, nitrate, and turbidity. These sensors provide real-time data, which is processed and analyzed using machine learning algorithms to detect deviations from ideal water quality conditions.

articleTitle: Explainable AI Using h2o AutoML and Robustness Check in Credit Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The paper proposes an eXplainable Artificial Intelligence model that can be utilized in credit risk the board and, specifically, in estimating the dangers that emerge when credit is acquired utilizing shared loaning stages. The model applies connection organizations to Shapley esteems with the goal that Computerized reasoning expectations are gathered by the likeness in the hidden clarifications. The exact examination of 15,000 little and medium organizations requesting credit uncovers that both hazardous and not dangerous borrowers can be gathered by a bunch of comparative monetary qualities, which can be utilized to make sense of their FICO rating and, in this manner, to foresee their future way of behaving.

articleTitle: The Influence of Digital Reality with Automated System in Business Transformation and Operational Excellence on Entrepreneur's Performance in the Engineering Service Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The engineering service industry utilizes digital reality in business transformation, provides operational excellence through emotional intelligence, and attains business and entrepreneur performance. India plays a significant role in the global engineering service industry, providing Pre-feasibility, Concept study, basic design, front-end engineering design, Detail Engineering, 3D Modeling Services, As-built services, Project Management, and procurement services. Project delivery happens with the support of the multidisciplinary team from process safety and Environment (HSE), piping, pipeline, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrument, and Civil & Structural for Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals, Refinery, Power, Chemicals and allied sectors. Digital reality in business transformation provides Virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), Artificial intelligence, Machine learning, Cloud computing, and the Industry Internet of Things (IIoTs). Entrepreneurs understand client requirements through emotional intelligence and utilize the latest technology available in the market for better performance, speedy delivery, and flawless quality delivery within a short schedule in a collaborative and integrated environment. Researchers studied through literature research include literature from case studies and concept studies from Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs). This research reveals that the digital reality in business transformation gives better performance to entrepreneurs through emotional intelligence in the engineering service industry. Furthermore, researchers suggest that the government and MSME upgrade current policies to support the digital business transformation to achieve operational excellence in the engineering service industry.

articleTitle: Remindify: A Seamless Automation for Daily Tasks
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In today's fast paced world, managing daily tasks can be difficult. In order to avoid this challenge, the concept of reminder system is used in homes to remind the people about their day to day regular activities. The paper mainly focusses on old age people in reminding them to take their pills regularly at the stimulated time. The system is implemented by installing google assistant on raspberry pi and configured with a customized AI speaker. Rasa is used for text and voice based interactions and it is integrated with the speaker. The system also reminds to switch off the fan, light when not in use and also help us to complete the task which is not done.

articleTitle: Development of Interactive Boolean Algebra Lesson Using Unreal Engine 5
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The aim of this project is to develop a virtual environment for the implementation of Boolean algebra lesson using Unreal Engine 5.0. Traditional educational institution's constrained infrastructure makes it impossible to meet all of the demands of pupils. Because classrooms usually contain students with a variety of learning preferences and educational backgrounds, the traditional educational system frequently underserves many kids. There is no reason for this current situation in education to continue with present technologies. A system that may be created to provide students an immersive educational experience and adapt teachings to their requirements in order to better serve students. Game-based learning (GBL) was studied by researchers and educators as a potential solution to the shortcomings of conventional educational models. Applications and software that train, educate, or aid in topic learning are included in game-based learning. To demonstrate how a GBL system might improve learning of Fundamental Boolean Algebra concepts, a virtual 3D tour is developed using Unreal Engine 5.

articleTitle: IoT Based Smart Biometric Safety and Security in Modern Motorbikes
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This paper introduces a smart biometric protection system for modern motorcycles, integrating seamlessly with IoT via a single PCB. Key features include biometric fingerprint authentication, keyless entry, GPS tracking, and IoT-driven speed control. A user-friendly mobile app enables real-time monitoring and control. The system aims to boost motorcycle security, deter theft, and elevate the user experience, representing a significant advancement in motorcycle technology.

articleTitle: IOT Translator for Sign Language based on Glove
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Sign language is used by individuals with hearing difficulties to communicate with outside world. This language is made up of expressions, emotions and hand gestures made up of different type of signals. Hand movement along with the emotion together makeup the message to be communicated. Though this works perfectly, it takes time to learn this language. Even after learning this person with hearing and speaking difficulties cannot communicate with a larger audience as the other party might not understand this language. There are multiple varieties of sign language available as per the local region like ASL – American Sign Language, ISL – Indian Sign Language, GSL denoting German sign language. All these languages are specifically customised to the local geography to improve the effectiveness of communication. However the key focus is to make speech impaired individuals to communicate with common man. Our solution is to create a middleware that can detect and convert sign language to a audio output heard through a android hand held. This can also be useful to monitor the health of the individuals in a centralised environment.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Descriptive Data Analysis and Statistical Analysis of Vitiligo Among the Patients Attending Opd and Ipd in Gsmc, Palayamkottai.
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Skin disorders can have different symptoms and levels of severity some have occupational or psychological causes, some may be inherited, and it can be short- or extended, painful or pleasant. Skin problems might vary from innocuous to catastrophic. External environmental elements including biological, chemical, and physical elements as well as internal environmental factors like diet, mental health, endocrine function, metabolism, nutrition, immune response, and medication use are the main causes of skin diseases. An estimated 0.5–2% of people worldwide are considered to be afflicted by vitiligo, a common skin condition that causes pigmentation loss. Melanocytes are specifically lost in the condition, which usually leaves no scaly, chalky-white macules. The dermatological condition identified as vitiligo is primarily brought about by pigment loss on the skin's surface without any modifications or disruptions to its appearance. The goal of this study is to evaluate the qualitative description of vitiligo in patients undergoing treatment at Palayamkottai's governmentrun Siddha Medical College. For it to comprehend the profile of the patients enrolled in the study, descriptive analysis will be performed and the required tables and graphs will be created. A statistical approach will be used to determine the application of the distinguishing features. Both quantitative and qualitative data will be evaluated using the student's t-test and chi-square test. This study identifies a number of significant risk factors for vitiligo, such as a person's work, family history, and dietary deficiencies including hereditary and family history, occupational status, and nutritional deficiencies such as iron, copper, and protein. This study is very useful for further research and to cure the condition in perfectly.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Based Selection Method for Antenna Parameters in Microwave Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The usage of machine learning in the field of microwave engineering has increased. This project proposes a design optimized model in order to achieve parameter optimization of 2 × 2 square patch antenna using Artificial Neural Network (ANN) Technique. An artificial neural network was trained to get the optimum value of the antenna parameters in less time. The input of the model is length, width of the square patch and range of antenna parameter value, the output is S-parameters, VSWR. This was made a perfect choice for communication systems engineers due to its low weight, low cost. The formulations are used to calculate the neural network cost function. The proposed neural network can tune and get the best value for the parameter. Then with the help of a machine learning algorithm, geometrical parameters of the patch antenna were designed and optimized. The substrate called fr4 is used. Hence a 2 × 2 square patch antenna element was optimized, designed, and developed.

articleTitle: Placeseries'O – Placement Preparation with Placement Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Nowadays, among students there is an increased inquisitiveness in computer science and the IT industry, which makes them want to learn more about new emerging technologies. But in order to learn those basic technologies, they must be well-versed in the basics of mathematics and coding. Thus, we provide a website with complete guidance for people who are trying to get placed in their dream company, and even working professionals can use this platform to develop their skills in their domain, learn a new skill to make a career shift, or even become freelancers with multiple skills. Students are overloaded with lot of contents on the internet about a company, its interview process, and how to prepare, so we summarize all that information to help people land their desired job. Our website has a detailed system for preparation of the aptitude round, technical round, and HR round, which is customized and different for every IT company, that helps you crack your interview.

articleTitle: VLSI Architecture of Time-Mode Pulse Width Modulation First Order Low-Pass Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The fundamentals of a low pass filter of the first order. The removal of high frequency noise from an audio signal may be accomplished with the assistance of low pass filters, which have widespread use in the field of audio processing. They are also employed in communication systems to eliminate high frequency noise from the signal that is being delivered, which makes it simpler for the receiver to interpret the information. A low-pass filter is a kind of frequencyselective filter that lets signals with frequencies below a predetermined cutoff frequency through while weakening sounds with higher frequencies. The filter's design has a significant role in determining its unique frequency response. One parameter that describes the speed with which a firstorder, linear-time invariant responds to a step input is the time constant. It is denoted by the Greek letter (tau), which is also the name of the parameter. In most cases, it is similar to the amount of time required for a certain parameter to change by a factor of 1e-1. The first step of filtration is mechanical, followed by chemical, and then finally biological.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Radiation Risk Analysis for Sustainable Construction with Agricultural Byproducts
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Agricultural byproducts are increasingly finding utility in the construction and building industry as additives to cement, addressing the environmental impact associated with cement production. Due to the environmental repercussions of cement production, the construction industry has turned to incorporating agricultural waste materials as additives in cement, marking a sustainable shift in building practices. This research focuses on assessing the radiological properties of agricultural byproducts employed in construction, with a special emphasis on their activity concentrations, including 226Ra series, 232Th series, and 40K isotopes. The study measures alpha and gamma radiation level and employs artificial intelligence techniques to analyze these data, with particular attention to the linear regression algorithm's efficacy. Through the application of machine learning, the recommendation system empowers professionals to make informed choices when selecting agricultural byproducts for construction materials.

articleTitle: Enhancing Crop Health Monitoring and Disease Identification in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Agriculture is the main source of food and fodder. It demands constant hard work, attention to detail, responsibility, flexibility, and time to produce good yields. The main problems faced by the farmers are many, for example, water supply to the crops, farming equipment, dependence on traditional crops, storage facilities, etc. The foremost and important issue faced by the farmers is maintaining crop health, pest management and weed removal. The main focus is to manage crops of the same type like tomato, brinjal and green chili. The pest found in these types of plants is also similar. The input images captured from agricultural fields are subjected to image processing techniques to detect the presence of pests. Once pests are detected, the system classifies the pests into their respective types. The accuracy of the pest detection algorithm is 96.44%. The software's efficiency and accuracy is a viable tool for farmers and researchers for detection and mitigation of crop damage. The images acquired from the fields are processed to detect the presence of diseases in the leaves. Once a disease is detected, the software categorises the specific type of disease based on a diverse dataset of tomato leaf diseases. The accuracy of the disease detection algorithm is 80.67%. The system enables farmers to detect and identify plant diseases and respond to that promptly, preventing crop loss.

articleTitle: Detection of Malignant and Benign Skin Lesions using the Influence of Activation Function and Accuracy Analysis in Densely Connected Convolutional Network Compared over Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The aim of this study is to detect Malignant and Benign Skin lesions using Novel Densely Connected Convolutional and compare the accuracy with Convolutional Neural Network. The Novel Densely Connected Convolutional algorithm and the Convolutional Neural Network algorithm are two groups used in this study with a total sample size of N = 10 for prediction of skin cancer and its types like malignant and benign . The G power values are 0.8 with 80% confidence interval. The Novel Densely Connected Convolutional accuracy for predicting skin cancer for the activation function Sigmoid is 80.8%, ReLu is 77% and Softmax 53%. while the Convolutional Neural Networks accuracy for Sigmoid is 76.3%, ReLu is 48% and Softmax 76% . The statistical significance between the two groups, as shown by the T Test p<0.001(2-tailed) significance value. The Novel Densely Connected Convolutional method, which had higher accuracy than the Convolutional Neural Network algorithm, was found to be much more effective at detecting both malignant and benign skin cancer.

articleTitle: Jackfruit Tree Disease Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This project has created a Deep Learning- based system that uses image processing techniques to detect diseases in jackfruit trees. The system, which is based on a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), analyses images of leaves, fruits, and trunks of the tree to determine if they are healthy or not. This dataset includes images of trees that have been affected by a variety of diseases, such as Leaf Spot, Rhizophus Rot, Pink Disease, Pest, and more. The system has been trained and tested using 600 images and has achieved a 95% accuracy rate. This system can help farmers detect diseases quickly and take the necessary steps to reduce the risk of further spread and crop losses. It can be used on a mobile application or web platform, making it easier for farmers in rural areas to access. Ultimately, this system can help to promote sustainable farming practices and improve the well-being of farmers and their communities.

articleTitle: Network Anomaly Based Detection Using Multivariate Correlation Analysis Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In order to identify if network activity is an intrusion or normal, a multivariate correlation 1 analysis-based network anomaly-based intrusion detection system is proposed. The system identifies 2 activities, by taking input from the network traffic, and the input data is preprocessed and 3 transformed into a new set of data. A multivariate correlation model has been developed to identify 4 intrusions using Mahalanobis distance. The system's output is predicted to have a low false alarm 5 rate and a high accuracy rate. In the process of transformation, two types of transformation are done 6 one using the normal triangle area map generation using the base and height. The other one is based 7 on the cluster centroids area which uses a different approach for calculating the triangle area map 8 which uses the distance between the centroids and the input traffic data. After that, a multivariate 9 correlation model was developed based on the transformed data with the training samples and 10 the testing samples utilized to evaluate the performances of the multivariate model. The network 11 anomaly intrusion detection benchmark dataset, KDD cup 99, is taken for evaluation.

articleTitle: Biometric MFA in Smart Automobiles
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: For use in autonomous vehicles, researchers are developing biometric multi-factor authentication (MFA). Transmitters are now often used as vehicle keys because to the ubiquitous nature of automobiles as a mode of mobility. Yet, there is always the risk that this method might be hacked or stolen from. It is suggested that we use biometric identification tools like iris and facial scanning software to solve this problem. If you don't want to utilize fingerprints or facial recognition, the app also supports MFA with a password or PIN. SHA hashing is used to encrypt data in transit to protect customer privacy. Data is never at risk because the system can function independently of the cloud. The primary purpose of the project is to improve the safety of smart car unlocking systems, with the secondary objectives of decreasing vehicle theft and increasing user security as a close second and third.

articleTitle: Effective Approach to Novel Stochastic Gradient Descent compared with Naive Bayes in Real time Weather Prediction using Precision
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: To Analyze the Accuracy of climatic changes in real time using machine learning techniques such as Novel Stochastic Gradient Descent and Naive Bayes. Novel Stochastic Gradient Descent is utilized to determine the weather patterns and the accuracy is contrasted with Naive Bayes. The accuracy to predict the weather forecast on a sample size of 200 for each algorithm. For the SPSS analysis, G power of 0.95, CI (continuous Integration) of 95%, and alpha of 0.29 is used. As a result, Novel Stochastic Gradient Descent 94.25% is more accurate than Naive Bayes (92.78%). The accuracy significance value is 0.18. This demonstrates that there is no statistical significance among the two methods. The Novel Stochastic Gradient Descent achieved accuracy of 94.25%, better than Naive Bayes (92.78%) for the chosen Weather prediction dataset.

articleTitle: The Critical Factors Affecting E-Government Adoption in India: A Conceptual Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: E-Governance has been influencing the lives of common people widely. In this paper, UMEGA and its improved version were empirically investigated. Additionally, the extended version of the model outperformed the original one, with a tad more variance overall being accounted for by behavioural intention. It has been discovered that attitudes were significantly influenced by performance expectations, social influence, perceived risk, and computer selfefficiency, whereas behavioural intention was significantly influenced directly by attitudes, facilitating conditions. These findings force the variables to be considered when regulating the plans to raise the bar for quality. To collect information, a questionnaire was handed to the respondents. The two behavioural intention dimensions, such as confidence in the government and technology, were tested using the acquired data. T-test and ANOVA were specifically conducted on a sample of 70 respondents to measure the significance of Citizen to the aforementioned aspects of e-governance.

articleTitle: Design of an Efficient Mac Unit for DSP Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Multipliers are the crucial elements of VLSI and strategies for processing digital signals. In arithmetic operations, the speed of execution of multiplication functions is critical and has an enormous effect on the extent to which a design performs. This raises an urge for accurate variables which boost the speed, power, and area. Mathematical researchers have gained access to an array of tactics to multiplying numbers, including Recurrent addition, prehistoric Egyptian strategy, Vedic method, Booth method, etc. The three Multipliers are scrutinized using three aspects: delay, area, and power. The MAC unit is a vital ingredient of computer hardware, especially in digital signal processing. Multiplication and accumulation duties are taken care of by the MAC unit. Adder, multiplier, and accumulator constitute the foundational MAC unit. The precise multiplier is used to generate the optimum MAC unit. The proposed MAC unit is synthesized and stimulated in Xilinx 14.5.

articleTitle: Smart Energy Conservation System with Crime Prevention and Control
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Currently, streetlights worldwide consume a significant amount of electrical energy. This paper explores the concept of smart streetlights with a focus on crime prevention in rural areas. The primary objective of smart streetlight systems is to activate lights when required and deactivate them when unnecessary. Additionally, the smart streetlight system described in this paper operates similarly to traditional streetlights, remaining illuminated throughout the night. The preferred operation of the smart streetlight system is continuous nighttime illumination; however, it incorporates a motion sensor to activate the lights in the presence of an object. When no object is detected, the streetlights automatically power down. Furthermore, these streetlights are equipped with cameras that capture images of detected objects. Digital image processing technology is employed for object detection and image storage, with a specific focus on alerting authorities in the presence of weapons. Unlike conventional CCTV cameras, a standard camera is utilized for image capture. This smart lighting system ensures that the lights are illuminated in advance of pedestrian and vehicle presence and extinguished when there is no activity.

articleTitle: IoT Based Ignition System By Insertion And Verification of Driving License
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The goals of this project are to primarily reduce the frequency of accidents caused by citizens who do not hold a valid driving license and drastically reduce instances of vehicle theft. This is achieved by interlinking the license verification of citizens with the ignition system of vehicles achieved by the means of an mobile application and an IoT system comprising of various sensors and components. The project demands the license and fingerprint of the user and utilizes a biometric sensor, card reader for physical verification. It also consists of an Alcohol a Seatbelt sensor and a door-lock sensor which operates after when both the Application and physical verification of the Driver's License is a success. The vehicle turns on iff and only if all the parameters provide a satisfactory result. For the remaining cases the vehicle will not be turned ON.

articleTitle: An Effective Approach to Classify Terrain and Geographical Images Using Alexnet Algorithm Over VGG-16 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This study will compare the AlexNet algorithm against the VGG-16 method in the classification of topography and geographical imagery. The dataset consists of eight different types of terrain which are represented by the 2400 total images in this collection: “asphalt,” “dirt,” “grass,” “floor,” “gravel,” “rock,” “sand,” and “wood chips”. The number of iterations for each group was determined to be 20 using CliniCal software. The novel Alexnet Algorithm having a higher accuracy of 91.55% with an accuracy of 88.38% and a significance level of p=0.011 (Independent group T-test p0.05), there is a statistically significant distinction between the two groups. Regarding the accurate classification of terrain and geographic images, Novel Alexnet Algorithm accuracy of 91.55% is superior to VGG- 16 algorithm accuracy of 88.38%.

articleTitle: Hope – An Arduino Based Safety device
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This paper unveils a groundbreaking Arduino-based women's safety system, meticulously designed to augment emergency response and location tracking capabilities. Activating a distress signal triggers a swift and coordinated response, with the system promptly dispatching a “Need Help” message via GSM to pre-registered contacts, accompanied by real-time GPS-derived location coordinates. The seamless synergy of Arduino technology ensures effective communication and interaction among system components, bolstering user security and expediting response times. By combining Arduino's versatility with GSM's reliable communication and GPS's precision, this innovative system presents a holistic solution to empower women in distress and significantly advance the landscape of women's safety technology. Its potential to save lives and contribute to a safer environment makes it a pivotal development in addressing the safety concerns of women.

articleTitle: Automated Pain Relief Chair
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This paper presents the design, development, and evaluation of a novel voice-controlled pain relief chair which is user comfort and well-being. Chronic pain management is a prevalent concern, and traditional methods often fall short of providing immediate and personalized relief. To provide solution, we propose a technologically advanced solution that combines ergonomic chair design with voice recognition capabilities. To assess the effectiveness of the voice-controlled pain relief chair, a comprehensive user study has conducted. A diverse group participant with varying pain profiles participated in the study. Objective comfort improvement, and usability metrics were collected and analyzed. The results demonstrate the chair's ability to provide rapid and tailored pain relief through its customizable features and user-friendly interface.

articleTitle: A Novel Harris Hawk Algorithm (HHA) to Optimize Deep Autoencoder (DAE) Method of Deep Learning for Cancer Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Over the past decade, the significance of data analytics in health informatics has surged due to the overwhelming influx of multi-modality data. Artificial neural networks have emerged as one of the most important and powerful influences in machine learning, rooted in deep learning. The exact prognostic of cancer remains a challenging problem for healthcare practitioners, even though cancer research has been a steady emphasis throughout the last decades. To increase a patient's chances of survival, early diagnosis is crucial, effectively differentiating between benign and malignant tumors is a considerable challenge. Deep learning has become widely accepted tool among medical researchers as an effective method in this area. A deep autoencoder architecture which was primarily designed for feature extraction is improved by using the Harris Hawk algorithm. Surprisingly, this approach comprises a pre-training step rather than requiring labelled data for training. During this pre-training stage, the proposed Harris Hawk algorithm makes use of exploration, exploitation, and attacking techniques, increasing feature extraction accuracy significantly to an outstanding 93%. This in turn greatly improves the performance of deep auto encoder applications, including those for cell grouping, 3D- brain reconstruction, cancer detection, and the prediction of demographic data. The deep autoencoder optimized using the Harris Hawk method stood out as the obvious choice in terms of accuracy when compared to other autoencoder models including sparse autoencoders (SAE), denoising autoencoders (DAE), contractive autoencoders (CAE)and convolutional autoencoders (CNAE).

articleTitle: Automated Drone-Based Imaging Systems For Plant Health Monitoring Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Accurate and scalable plant health monitoring has entered a new age with the combination of automated drone-based imaging systems with cutting-edge deep learning algorithms. This cutting-edge method uses drones' mobility and adaptability to get detailed photographs, which reveal previously unattainable information on plant health and disease. We have made great progress in identifying plant illnesses, nutritional deficits, and growth irregularities using state-of-the-art deep-learning algorithms. To analyze drone video in real-time, our approach uses convolutional neural networks (CNNs) trained on large datasets of annotated plant images. The ability to quickly diagnose and pinpoint the exact location of plant health problems is a major step forward in developing effective intervention techniques and improving agricultural practices. The system's ability to detect even minute differences in plant health has been greatly improved by incorporating multispectral imaging capabilities, which allows it to go beyond the bounds of simple visual spectral analysis. This study is a breakthrough in agricultural monitoring since it offers a practical, economical, and ecologically sound approach to the problem of ensuring the world's population has access to enough to eat. When combined with deep learning, automated drone-based imaging systems have the potential to completely transform plant health assessment, providing invaluable assistance to farmers, agronomists, and researchers as they work to increase crop yield while decreasing resource inputs and negative environmental effects. Insights into the full scope of this game-changing technology and its potential to profoundly alter the face of contemporary farming are presented in this research.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Oil Spill Detection from SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The main aim of this study is to identify instances of oil spills through the use of images taken from satellite. Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imaging is a prevalent method for oil spills detection. Oil spills into the ocean are becoming commonplace, and they constitute a substantial portion of marine pollution, which can have negative impacts on the biological and economic systems. Object detection is a crucial and commonly studied area in image processing and earth observation, with important applications for society. The prompt detection of a marine oil spill is essential to the success of any cleanup operation, and this can be facilitated by efficient object detection methods. Currently, the system utilizes SENTINEL software that employs machine learning and deep learning techniques. However, the software has limitations in differentiating between mineral spills and biogenic surface films. MATLAB is a powerful technical computing language that enables users to perform complex computations, create visualizations, and write programs in an intuitive environment. It uses scientific notation to express problems and solutions in a straightforward manner. Image processing is utilized as a method for detecting oil spills, and this approach is implemented and tested using MAT LAB software. The accuracy of the results is verified through testing.

articleTitle: Indoor Navigation Using Ultra Wide Band
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Indoor positioning is a significant and intriguing topic in navigation systems that present numerous use cases for investigation. Researchers are exploring technologies capable of providing accurate locations in indoor spaces where GNSS positioning systems are ineffective. In the numerous solutions available for indoor location services, Ultra-wideband (UWB) technology was chosen for its ability to provide high-precision positioning information for multiple points in real-time. This paper presents a UWB indoor positioning system that utilizes time of flight (TOF) algorithm. At times, time difference of arrival (TDOA) algorithms compute range measurements, this facilitates the trans-receiver (TAG) plane position algorithm's location determination. UWB technology was chosen because it is the latest technology available on Android 12 and further also offers high accuracy, resistance to interference and minimal signal reflection from walls. UltraWide Band(UWB) localization encounters various obstacles, such as multipath distortions, additional signal delays, time discrepancies in clocks, signal interference, and the computational resources necessary to determine the user's location.

articleTitle: A Feature Selection Algorithm for Intrusion Detection System Based on Binary PSO
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: When developing models using machine learning, feature selection is an extremely important step. The process of selecting features is an essential part of the construction of an intrusion detection system (IDS). We present an IDS that is based on deep convolutional neural networks (DCNN). Two convolutional layers and three fully linked dense layers make up a deep convolutional neural network (DCNN). The approach that has been suggested tries to increase performance while also reducing the amount of processing resources required. Experiments were carried out using the IoTID20 dataset serving as the basis. A number of different measures, including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, were used in the process of evaluating the suggested model's performance. whale optimization is used, in which Adam, AdaMax, and Nadam's performance was at its highest possible level. The results of all of the experimental analyses suggest that the suggested method has 97% accuracy.

articleTitle: Automated Health Diagnosis and Medicine Dispenser
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The emerging field of health care witnesses a wide range of conversions led by advancements in technology and an increasing need for accessible and effective health care services. One of the arising patterns in this conversion is the combination of automation and artificial intelligence in the healthcare sector. This combination addresses critical problems like accessibility, cost-effectiveness, and satisfaction of the patients. In this concept, we put forward an innovative and transformative idea -An AIML-based automated health diagnosis and medicine dispenser. In a unified patient-centric platform, this system signifies the effectiveness of machine learning, Robotics, Image processing, and natural language processing in order to integrate the two important health care constituents -Diagnosis and medicine dispensing.

articleTitle: Impact of Technology Startup on Economic Development with Reference to India and China
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The founders of a startup company often provide the first capital for the company, however these individuals may also look for funding from other sources before the company officially launches. Startups are often new enterprises that are still in the process of developing their products and conducting research on the market. India gained more than 1,300 active digital firms in the last year, bringing the country's total to somewhere between 25,000 and 27,000. India continues to have the third-largest tech startup ecosystem in the world, after the United States and China. There is a pressing need for institutions to concentrate their efforts on the minds of young people in order to raise awareness of startups and the implications of startups for the expansion of the economy. The objectives of study to determine the rate of growth experienced by technology startups and to investigate the effects that new technology businesses have had on employment and the economies of India and China. This study has mostly concentrated on exploratory research and has made use of secondary data in order to determine the number of unicorn startups. In India the government initiating several schemes and policies for encouraging and promoting new startup and innovators for sustaining the country economy in global market, like China government initiated various promotional schemes to increase more number of startup in their country. Based on the analysis India startups are steeply increased and it's a proud moment which stood one of the third largest countries in global startup index.

articleTitle: Recent Advances and Research Challenges of Deep Learning Framework for Automatic Object Detection in the Real-Time Videos
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: One of the most challenging tasks in computer vision is object detection since it requires both object classification and object localization within a scene. However, their object detection procedure remains difficult due to the complex scene information, poor resolution compared to visible videos, and a lack of training models and publicly labeled datasets. Different video detection algorithms are accessible for automatic object detection to classify and analyze based on particular representative models to address these current issues. This research focuses on reviewing the available methods to aid in the state-of-the-art automatic detection of objects based on real-time videos. First, automatic video object detection methods using deep learning are classified and described. Following that, an overview of the available datasets for detecting objects in video and the most common evaluation metrics is provided. With potential research on enhancing automatic object detection for real-time videos, challenges and future developments related to object detection using deep learning is summarized.

articleTitle: Advancing COPD Diagnosis through Deep Learning, GANs, and Chest X-Ray Analysis for Precise Detection and Severity
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The rate of mortality within those who have COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease) has risen recently, and itis predicted that it willstayon the risein the years to come. Due to the extensive laboratory testing requiredforconfirmation, standardapproachestakeavery long time to diagnose these medicalconditions. Fortunately, with the development of sophisticated approaches and consideration of the ability to develop powerful techniques forpredictingothercriticaldiseases, itisanticipatedthatthis will helptopreciselyandpromptlydetectchronicdiseases.To aid in the diagnosis of COPD, this project aims to create a clinicaldecisionsupportsystembasedondeeplearning(DL) algorithms. Chest X-rays from 100 patients for COPD diagnosis were selected for examination. Chest X-rays are frequentlyutilisedtofindanomaliesthataidinthedetection of COPD. Many X-ray images are needed to traina classification model; however, radiographic Chest X-rays are still limited in availability. This may hinder the effectivenessoftechniquesforCOPDidentificationthatrely ondeeplearning(DL).Inthis study, thegeneratedChestX- rays using a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Data Augmentation is used to get around these restrictions. Each X-ray that is produced falls into one of the two categories: COPD or normal. Now, the GAN-generated syntheticimageswerecombinedwiththerealimagesandfed into the following CNN architectures – VGG16, ResNet, DenseNet, Inception. Amongthesemodels, theoutputfrom the best-performing model is used to identifytheCOPD- affectedpatients. Further, their FEV1 factor range is considered to classify them depending on the seriousness of COPD – Mild, Moderate, Severe and Very Severe.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and HR Digitalization Facilitated by Transformational Leadership
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: HR digitalization involves automation of mundane and repetitive tasks, freeing up the employees’ time to concentrate on more crucial responsibilities. Transformational Leadership is a leadership style that promotes employees to achieve elevated levels of performance. Transformational leadership is capable for facilitating HR digitalization and incorporating Artificial Intelligence technologies in the day-to-day HR practices. Digitalization and Artificial Intelligence is the need of the hour for every business to survive and compete in the market. As humans are the major resources of any organization, manifestation of digitalization and Artificial Intelligence into the Human Resource practices serves beneficial. The primary aim of this article is to comprehensively examine how the application of transformational approach to leadership integrates HR digitalization and Artificial Intelligence in focus to improve the efficiency of the organization. The main purpose of this review article is to enrich the existing literatures related to the topic. In the end, the researchers reached at a conclusion that transformational leaders ensure that transition is managed effectively to minimize disruption and maximize the benefits derived from HR digitalization and Artificial Intelligence. Additionally, it was found that Artificial Intelligence and transformational leadership complement each other by enabling innovation, data driven decision-making and positive changes within the organization.

articleTitle: Sustainable Development: Green Marketing Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: For business enterprises across the world this modern era has brought with him the worldwide environmental concerns, deforestation and economic fluctuations due to which a drastic change in the buying behavior of the customers are being observed. The biggest challenge for the marketers in these days is how to satisfy customer needs/wants without sacrificing the environmental concerns. This necessity has given birth to a new marketing philosophy namely green marketing(GM). Hence, researcher has undertaken a descriptive study wherein 312 customers’ responses were collected by online survey method. The outcome of this research work will be useful for marketers, industry policy makers for designing appropriate policies and activities for adoption of practices of GM.

articleTitle: IoT Based Vehicle Tracking and Monitoring System Using Smart Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Companies like Ola, Uber, and others work in a similar way which is they hire a third-party vehicle and driver i.e. locals of any particular area. These drivers will be connected with the customers who want to avail the taxi service. This makes it easy for the drivers to find their customers faster and also helps people to book any cab at the last minute. This last-minute booking was the one thing that made these applications succeed in their business. Our idea is to enhance their business by getting additional information from the third-party vehicles like petrol level, the heat level of the engines, and also detect accidents that occurred. We need to do this because there are accidents that occur due to driver's negligence. It is the sole duty of the driver to check these things in the car or any vehicle before even starting or getting onto the road but some drivers are not checking their vehicles properly and some vehicles are not even serviced regularly driving those vehicles can create unnecessary problems both to the drivers and customers. This leaves a bad impression on the company that provides this service and affects its reputation. Now to find these parameters in the car that also in real-time we will be using IoT, also called the IoT module or IoT chip is a small electronic device that is embedded on objects or any machine used to send or receive signals when connected to the internet. The IoT chip provides always-on connectivity because it transfers signals in real-time such that there is no need to switch it on every time to use it. These details will then be sent to the application that will be used by Android users. In the application, all the parameters like temperature and voltage will be acquired using sensors like (Voltage sensor ZMPT101B, Temperature Sensor LM35, MEMS sensor ADXL345) and the acquired values will be available. Later this will be integrated into the respective company's application so that the customers can also easily see the vehicle they are travelling to and in case of danger they can warn the driver.

articleTitle: Malaria Disease Prediction using Faster RCNN
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Malaria is a disease caused by Plasmodium parasites that remains a major threat to global health. It affects 200 million people and causes 400,000 deaths each year. The Plasmodium parasite, which is spread through the bites of female Anopheles mosquitoes, is the main cause of malaria. Typically, the use of a microscope in microbiological studies facilitates the identification of infected cells in a blood sample, followed by expert analysis of the results to complete the diagnostic process. This type of expert analysis does not give a completely 100% perfect conclusion and it also costs more. Identifying such targets is also a challenge, largely due to differences in cell shape, density and color, and the ambiguity surrounding certain cell classes. Therefore, a method based on deep learning is used to predict malaria with the highest accuracy. Deep learning-based technologies have proven to be able to achieve human-level accuracy in object detection/classification in image data. These approaches can be used to automate many of the monotonous tasks involved in analyzing micrographs of blood samples. It uses Faster R-CNN. The proposed models were trained and tested on a publicly available erythrocyte image dataset containing both infected and uninfected cells. Methods developed to fine-tune the images using image pre-processing successfully identified malariainfected erythrocytes with the highest accuracy in ashort period of time. The software is also adapted to a budget microcomputer to speed up prototyping.

articleTitle: Impact of Sensory Branding on Buying Intensions for Toiletries, Personal Care & Cosmetic Products in India
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The conventional marketing concept presumes rationality of consumers wherein several reasoned steps define his buying behavior. Sensory marketing being a newly emerging area lack research work especially in India i.e. developing country context. This research gap was recognized and research was undertaken to know the effectiveness of sensory marketing for every products and age groups. Descriptive study involving data collection from 385 customers by snowball sampling method was adopted for this study. Impact of sensory marketing on buying intentions of Indian consumers especially for toiletries, personal care & cosmetic products is a subject matter of study in the current research work. The companies operating in the area of toiletries, personal care & cosmetic products in India may get benefit from the outcome of this research work.

articleTitle: Data Leakage Vulnerability Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Data leakage, the unauthorized transmission or exposure of sensitive information, poses a severe threat to individuals, businesses, and institutions in the digital age. As the volume and importance of data continue to surge, safeguarding against data leakage becomes an imperative. This paper presents a comprehensive exploration into data leakage analysis, aiming to enhance understanding, detection, and mitigation of data leakage risks. We delve into various aspects, including the methodologies, challenges, case studies, and emerging technologies in data leakage analysis. By scrutinizing real-world incidents and sophisticated analysis techniques, we propose strategies and best practices to fortify data security, minimize vulnerabilities, and enable proactive measures in mitigating potential data breaches. The insights presented in this paper serve as a valuable resource to empower organizations and individuals in their ongoing efforts to protect sensitive data and uphold privacy in an increasingly interconnected world.

articleTitle: A Web and Mobile Application to Identify the Availability of Drinking Water Information During a Water Crisis
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
