But, the report indicate that growth of plastic items market is India is increasing @7% per year as against 3% of global average. The researcher has conducted online survey of 487 people in the country by snowball sampling method to know their awareness, usage pattern and effectiveness of plastic ban policy of the Govt.

articleTitle: Report
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)

articleTitle: College Communication App - Chatster
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Our everyday routines and way of life have altered as a result of technology. Therefore, students at schools, colleges, or universities need applications that enable smart phones instead of calling systems to acquire all types of information linked to exams, lecture notes, placement about questions, notifications, events, transportation, etc. Every educational institution offers a certain number of services to its users, including students, parents, guardians, and the general public. If the services offered are more complicated to use, it is quite tough. Because of this, students' enthusiasm in attending college, high school, or universities is waning. Based on the current state of the industry, we created an application to meet the needs of students, parents, or employees. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies like java, android, GPS, etc. to address the issues facing the pupils. We present ‘Chatster’, a mobile application designed to streamline communication within a college community. The app allows students and staff members to efficiently share information about events, announcements, and important updates. Additionally, Chatster offers event reminders and provides event details to enhance student engagement and participation.

articleTitle: Autonomous Billing Cart for Retail Store
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The contemporary smart shopping cart offers a technology response to typical shopping difficulties. It combines RFID product scanning with automated billing to expedite checkout and get rid of long queues. Customers have control over their purchases and can easily update their carts thanks to RFID technology, which allows products to be swiftly scanned and displayed on an LCD screen on the cart. The program may be altered and is multilingual. The system also assures correct itemization and invoicing, which is advantageous to both consumers and vendors. Through the use of IoT technology, comprehensive spreadsheets of product and billing data are generated. These functions are integrated into the shopping cart using a Raspberry Pi, improving vendor inventory management. Hence, this smart shopping cart has the potential to transform the retail sector by streamlining checkout processes and improving retail efficiency. It offers a modern solution to make shopping easier and more convenient for a wide range of customers.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality Based Medical Education
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The education in medical field requires both theoretical knowledge and practical knowledge. It is important for medical student to acquire effective practical skills. Since the students apply the theoretical knowledge in practical manner in human body. Human body is very volatile, gentle, and difficult system. If a student apply trial in the humans for practical knowledge, there may cause the human error which leads to death of the person. To avoid this, the proposed system “Augmented Reality Based Medical Education” is useful. Augmented reality makes the learning process more interactive and interesting. It can reproduce specific circumstances that assist students to rehearse with virtual objects that look like the human body and organ. Like traditional learning, it does not require real patients. By this way, augmented reality prevents risk of human life. Medical education with augmented reality extensively provides real time experiences. It has low risks and also affordable. When any human error occurs, there is no human loss. So the human life can be prevented by the system. The proposed system is developed using tools like Unity which is the complete platform for the developing our application, Vuforia-developer portal, a tool to create image target and Blender which is used to create 3D objects.

articleTitle: Power Theft Detection and Protection in Distribution Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: A distribution line power theft detection and protection system is developed in this project. Voltage sensor and Microcontroller are used in the system's design. The management of electric distribution system has become increasingly challenging due to an increase in the demand for electricity from residential, industrial, and commercial loads. The main obstacle in the distribution network's efficient monitoring and control has been recognized as a lack of information at the base station regarding its state. An unlawful tapping on a distribution line can be found and protected using an electrical power theft detection and protection system. The instrument used in this project to interface between the power line current and Arduino is an ACS712 series current sensor. Relay used as switching gear to protect power line from power theft. All actions that all devices take are controlled by Arduino. With the help of this system, an electrical power theft may be easily detected and stopped without the need for human intervention. It would also increase the profit margin for the power utility business and reduce overload-related faults. By employing this technique, through which the server received the message when users by passed the meter, it was also feasible to identify electricity theft. In addition to detecting and guarding against power theft, this system also provides billing activities.

articleTitle: Assessing Water Quality Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: For all living things, water is one of the most crucial natural resources. The ability to access clean water is essential for human survival. Beyond drinking, water is also necessary for animal consumption, irrigation, as well as domestic and commercial uses. For the stability and conservation of the environment, it is crucial to monitor the quality of treated wastewater to protect the ecosystem. The issue of poor water quality is getting worse every day due to a number of factors & other dangerous chemicals. Laboratory assessments of water samples to determine their fitness to use is a vital step in the water quality assurance process. However, laboratory assessments require adherence to stringent measures, which might be difficult to comply with. Machine learning (ML) has emerged in recent years as viable and cheaper solutions to replace the lab-based assessments, with a limited availability of sufficient data to train the ML models. Unfortunately, such data is not always available, especially in less developed countries. So that the work attempts to fill this gap by creating sample sized datasets that can be used to train & test the ML models. In simple words the datasets were curated by aggregating data from smaller datasets on related concepts, then processed and labeled to make them useful for supervised ML models.

articleTitle: Review on State-of-Art in Insulin Pump Design and Development
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Diabetes Mellitus (DM) is collectively known as Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (T1DM) and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM), gestational and genetically inherited diabetes. Insulin is a hormone produced by β-cells of the pancreas to regulate blood glucose levels. Insulin pumps are recommended when oral drugs are inefficient in producing sufficient insulin in DM patients. This work surveys the insulin pump from commercial and existing literature. State-of-the-art insulin pumps are thoroughly presented in this paper. Functionality, challenges, and technological advancements are presented. Integration with advanced technical features is discussed in the article. With cutting-edge innovations, the development of insulin pumps that enhance the pump functionality is thoroughly explained. Insulin pumps find applications for self-care, bedside insulin administration, physically challenged, and research and development of insulin drug delivery. This survey guides healthcare providers, researchers and professionals in developing an intelligent insulin pump.

articleTitle: Smart Trolley PRO
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Shopping is a fundamental activity in our daily routines. For many, the prospect of standing in long lines to pay for their selections is not only inconvenient but also time-consuming and potentially error-prone, with the possibility of billing errors. Supermarket and grocery store trolleys have been designed to enhance the shopping experience, but they can be cumbersome to maneuver while browsing. To address this, the concept of an autonomous trolley that follows the shopper is introduced. The primary goal of this innovation is to streamline the shopping process by developing a smart trolley that automatically trails the shopper by tracking a unique tag carried by the customer, which communicates with the trolley via Wi-Fi. Additionally, this trolley employs a person-tracking camera positioned at the front to ensure it stays with the correct shopper. It further enhances the shopping experience by tallying the total price of the items placed within it. This technological advancement eases the customer's burden of managing the trolley, as it is designed to recognize and follow the shopper with the associated tag.

articleTitle: An Inclusive Survey of Internet of Vehicles with Emphasis on Cyber Security & Forensics
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The Internet of Vehicles (IoV), often referred to as interconnected automobiles, establishes an expansive network interlinking diverse entities such as users, sensors, and vehicles. This interconnectedness is aimed at mitigating traffic accidents and bolstering the security and safety of intelligent vehicles. However, the IoV ecosystem is susceptible to an array of threats, encompassing spoofing attacks, recognition breaches, privacy violations, and verification vulnerabilities. Given the paramount concern for user safety in developing new smart devices, our focus lies in enhancing cybersecurity by proactively addressing these multifaceted cyber threats. Thus, this comprehensive literature review explores into the realm of safeguarding smart vehicles, encompassing a thorough exploration of potential attacks and innovative solutions.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Home Fire Safety: IoT-Based Wireless Fire Alarm System for Easy Installation and Rapid Response
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: A new wireless fire alarm system provides early warning before a fire damages homes. Traditional systems require extensive wiring and labor for installation, which discourages homeowners from using them. Our innovative system utilizes an Internet of Things approach with multiple sensor nodes placed throughout the home. The nodes contain microcontrollers and flame and gas sensors to continuously monitor for fire. The nodes create a Wi-Fi network to communicate statuses. If sensors detect a fire, the node alerts a central controller node integrated with a 4G module. It immediately contacts emergency services and homeowners through SMS messages, phone calls, and alarm sounds. Homeowners can also check system status by texting the controller. This ad hoc network of wirelessly connected sensor nodes successfully delivers rapid fire alerts and remote monitoring to improve home safety.

articleTitle: Biometric Authentication on Finger Vein Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Finger vein authentication system is a more secure kind of authentication that can be utilized in fields such as signature and fingerprint verification. The specific reason for this authentication is because veins exist beneath the human skin, making them impossible to imitate. Furthermore, the vein pattern remains consistent throughout a person's life. Fingerprints are easily reproduced and fade with age. Iris authentication, the pattern of the iris could change when a person undergoes cataract surgery. The purpose of this work is to design a system that uses biometric authentication based on finger vein recognition by identifying unique vein patterns. The vein pattern is gathered using a Near-Infrared (NIR) camera with infrared light transmission. The goal of this study is to create a system that uses finger vein identification to ensure a secure transaction.

articleTitle: Zahira the Thief
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Accounts on social networks are tracked and found. If a hacker assaults a legitimate user, our system permits the attacker to keep going until our system has all the necessary data on the attacker. Based on the information provided by the user, we create Honeywords, and the original secret key is transformed into another format and saved with the Honeywords. We set up an intermediate server, a shopping server for online shopping, and a cloud server to keep track of user account information. Attackers with access to the original user's email account can quickly change the cloud server's password. In order to identify the attacker quickly, he is invited to conduct an attack in this project. The attacker now logs in to the purchase site, where he is inadvertently tracked and is permitted to make purchases. The server recognizes the attacker, notifies the original owner of the information, and prevents the attacker from carrying out any transactions from his original account.

articleTitle: SARIMA Techniques for Predictive Resource Provisioning in Cloud Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) models for dynamic cloud resource provisioning are introduced and evaluated in this work. Various cloud-based apps provided historical data to train and evaluate SARIMA models. The SARIMA(1,1,1)(0,1,1)12 model has an MAE of 0.056 and an RMSE of 0.082, indicating excellent prediction ability. This model projected resource needs better than other SARIMA settings. Sample prediction vs. real study showed close congruence between projected and observed resource consumption. MAE improved with hyperparameter adjustment, according to sensitivity analysis. Moreover, SARIMA-based resource allocation improved CPU usage by 12.5%, RAM utilization by 20%, and storage utilization by 21.4%. These data demonstrate SARIMA's ability to forecast cloud resource needs. SARIMA-based resource management might change dynamic cloud resource management systems due to cost reductions and resource usage efficiency. This research helps industry practitioners improve cloud-based service performance and cost.

articleTitle: Wireless Autonomous Drone Charging Hub: Revolutionizing Unmanned Aircraft Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The incredible development that the drone industry has experienced over the past few years has coincided with an increase in the quantity of research resources invested in drones. The uses of unmanned aerial vehicles are severely restricted by the short battery lives of these vehicles, which is a challenge that has proven to be difficult to resolve. One potential solution to this problem is the construction of an independent drone charging facility. This study recommends a charging station that is both wireless and entirely autonomous. Furthermore, the station permits a UAV to make a rough landing on the landing strip, which is something that actually occurs quite frequently with real-world systems. If someone really uses the charging station that was suggested, it is possible that it will no longer be necessary to charge the batteries of quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) manually.

articleTitle: Design of Converter for Improvement of LVRT Capability in Grid Integrated PV System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Enhancing a multimode inverter control method for improving the low-voltage ride-through (LVRT) capacity in grid-connected solar PV systems. The strategy aims to address the challenges associated with grid disturbances and ensure stable the PV system's performance. The proposed approach includes multiple operating modes for the inverter, allowing seamless transition between grid-connected and standalone modes during grid faults. The control strategy incorporates a dynamic voltage regulation scheme to maintain voltage stability and prevent system instability during LVRT events. Additionally, advanced control techniques, such as proportional-integral resonant (PIR) control and hysteresis control, are employed to achieve precise current and voltage regulation. The proposed strategy offers improved fault ride-through capability and grid synchronization performance, enabling uninterrupted power supply and minimizing the effect of disturbances in the electricity network on the photovoltaic array. The efficiency and viability of in suggested control technique will be tested through simulation studies and experimental validation. The outcomes of this project can contribute to the reliable integration of solar PV systems with the grid, promoting renewable energy utilization and grid stability.

articleTitle: An IoT Enabled Air Pollution Meter with Digital Dashboard on Smartphone
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Air Pollution which is environmental as well as a social issue faced by the individuals, since it has a variety of negative consequences for human health, climate change and ecosystems. Today, one of the Europe's most important environmental health hazards is Air Pollution. The air quality is the prominent aspect which directly increases the prevalence of illness and reduces the quality of life in cities and metropolitan cities. The ability to make respective solution with in the particular time depends on the air quality data collection and interpretation, necessitating the implementation of monitoring system that monitors the air quality periodically. A full level assessment of key contaminants and their sources can be accomplished using multi-parameter air quality monitoring devices. These monitoring devices are used in various smart cities efforts to monitor air quality as well as minimizing the concentrations of the major polluting substance in various urban and sub-urban cities. The design for detecting air pollution and promoting public awareness is included in this proposed system. The purpose of this research is to leverage the Internet of Things (IOT) in conjunction with the cloud to provide services much more in real-time as well with improved speed. The proposed device will be used in a specific place where there is a lot of pollution. The level of each hazardous pollutant is tested at regular intervals. The amount of each detected pollutant as well as the air quality index at that specified location will be displayed on the smartphone, which will be utilized to calculate the Air Quality Index which is abbreviated as AQI for the perceived pollutants and enhance public awareness. As a result, by examining the gas concentrations in both numerical and graphical form, the public can have a better understanding of the air quality in that place. Furthermore, in the future, the public will be able to register in an app thet will send out weekly or monthly air quality reports via a message that will reach the user as an easier-to-access alert.

articleTitle: Optical and Anti-Oxidant Applications of Zinc Sulfide Doped Nano Biomaterial
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Chitosan is a biomaterial resultant from sugar substance of crab, shellfish, lobster and shrimp. It shows good results in optical, anti-oxidant and catalytic property. Present work explains about enhance the activity of chitosan by doping with zinc sulfide and suppress the size of material in nanometer. Structure and morphology of material were studied using FTIR, XRD, and SEM analysis. Thermal stability was study using TGA and DSC methods.

articleTitle: Hybrid Solar and Wind Power Generation System Using ANFIS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The potential to combine solar photovoltaics (PV) and wind energy to solve the interrelated problem of renewable energy. Focusing on the Indian subcontinent, we evaluated the possibility of establishing connectivity in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, known for its solar and wind energy resources. We analyze solar irradiance and wind speed patterns using PVsyst software, and three decades of historical data. This work presents a new photovoltaic-wind hybrid system using a modified neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) algorithm for maximum power point finding (MPPT). The design aims to increase energy production efficiency and land use, paving the way for sustainable and effective solutions to meet the energy needs of the Indian subcontinent and similar regions around the world. This research represents an important step towards growing more sustainable, sustainable crops for the future.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Technique to Detect Alzheimer's Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Aeras of investigational and clinical study have demonstrated several pathways in the progression of Alzheimer's disease (AD), but no treatments have been developed. Patient lifestyle, clinical, and biological data are increasingly being collected through open data-sharing programmes, and the resulting data set may be infinite in size, far exceeding the capacity of humans to make sense of it. Recent advances in artificial intelligence have opened the door to the possibility of using analysis of medical imagery to aid in the analysis of Alzheimer's disease. A variety of methods, including those based on artificial intelligence, have been devised and used in several research to aid in the CAD of AD identification. The use of AI methods to solve Alzheimer's disease diagnosis challenges in brain imaging will be a major focus of future research in this field. This article delivers an impression of the many images processing, feature extraction, and machine learning approaches that are used to solve the AD detection problem. The final section of the study will include a synopsis of the existing body of knowledge as well as a critical appraisal of potential future research avenues and open questions.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy for Predicting Solar Power Using the Novel Gradient Boosting Regressor Algorithm in Comparison With the RANSAC Regressor Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The aim of the research work objective is to predict solar power generation using the Novel Gradient Boosting Regressor algorithm compared to the RANSAC Regressor algorithm to improve accuracy. Materials and methods: The sample size for the two groups in this study is 60 samples were collected for SPSS study to assess, contrast, and comprehend the efficiency of suggested algorithms. In group 1 there are 30 samples taken from Novel Gradient Boosting Regressor algorithm and in group 2 there are 30 samples taken from RANSAC Regressor algorithm and the G-power analysis was conducted with 80 % power. Results and discussion: From the obtained results, it is observed that is based on independent sample t-test statistically significant difference p = 0.001 (p < 0.05) between the two groups. The RANSAC Regressor method has obtained an accuracy rate of 79 % and the Novel Gradient Boosting Regressor has obtained an accuracy rate of 93.3 %. Conclusion: Novel Gradient Boosting Regressor algorithm performs significantly better than RANSAC Regressor algorithm.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition using ShuffleNetV2 Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: HAR is specified as the crucial task within the field of Computer vision and artificial intelligence. Main aim of HAR is to observing and labelling different human activity images of distinct data sources by machines such as computer. HAR has applications in various fields. CNN model is an appropriate model for HAR task, due to their ability to automaticaly acquire relevant spatial features, capture hierarchical representations, and handle input of various sizes and types. So it is utilized for developing HAR model. This model can detect objects and also can classify images. The model contains wide ranging catogories. ShuffleNetV2 is a particular architecture within it, mainly for efficient and lightweight deep learning task. This paper develops an intelligent HAR using ShuffleNetV2 model which acquired an accuracy about 69.52 percentage.

articleTitle: Techno Cradle
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Infant care has evolved significantly over the years and technology plays a vital role in monitoring the safety and wellbeing. The Techno cradle provides a technological interface between the newborn and the employed parents. Though the existing cradle is comfortable, which requires parents to look after the baby more frequently lacks an autonomous swinging mechanism. The parents will experience stress as a result, which will affect their ability to focus at work. Thus, by introducing the Techno cradle which will swing automatically whenever the baby cries help soothe the baby is useful for parents to balance work and infant care. Integrating numerous sensors and IoT capabilities allows real time monitoring of the baby, sleep patterns, surrounding conditions and baby's sign which enhances features of the cradle. A mobile application is developed where parents receive insights and important messages about the baby inside the cradle. They can even control the swinging motion, play a song for soothing the baby, and rock the toy for the baby's entertainment using the mobile application. Therefore, the Techno cradle that swings automatically in response to a baby's screams reduces the stress of the parents to greater extent while providing peace of mind. It ensures safety of the baby and keeps the baby healthier thus by providing a restful sleep essential for growth and development of the baby.

articleTitle: Business Analytics Contribution in the Growth of Indian Digital Business
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Use of Business analytics in business will increase productivity and efficiency of a business entity. Business analytics has made a significant impact in various business sectors across the world. India being a developing economy can make use of business analytics in developing all its sectors. The present study explores the current usage and its future usage of business analytics in the various sectors of the Indian economy. The researcher has considered the secondary data to analyse the penetration of business analytics in various sectors of India. It is observed that sectors like IT, Travel and transport, Pharma and healthcare and retail and e-commerce show a positive growth in the use of business analytics while sectors like FMCG, Telecom, Engineering and manufacturing and energy & utility have shown a negative growth in use of business analytics in India during the period of study. However, there is a potential growth in the use of business analytics across various sectors in India, since there is a huge unexplored market available in India.

articleTitle: Detection of Heart Disease Using Sensor Enabled Device and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: An immobile, bulky, expensive, and non-sendable continuous cardiac monitoring device is used by the majority of hospitals and health organisations. This machine learning model warns if the patient's heart rate changes in an alarming way. Therefore, the goal of this project is to build and create a prototype of a gadget that can detect worrying changes The pulse within a person's cardiovascular rhythm and sends an immediate SMS warning to medical professionals or someone in authority. The goal is achieved by creating an Arduino microcontroller that uses a GSM Shield module to serve, creating an SMS interface to facilitate communication between the device and a pulse sensor module for the purpose of detecting worrisome variations Monitoring a user's heart rate through the application of photoplethysmography.

articleTitle: Multi-Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: One of the foremost contributors to mortality in the modern world arises from a combination of factors, with heart disease and diabetes being prominent among them. The challenge of predicting multiple diseases in clinical data analysis is of significant concern. Machine learning has proven its efficacy in aiding decision-making and handling the vast volume of healthcare data. Several ongoing experiments delve into harnessing machine learning for disease prediction. This paper introduces a novel approach to identify crucial features by leveraging machine learning techniques to enhance the universal diagnosis of diseases. It encompasses the utilization of various features and established classification methods to construct predictive models for diabetes and heart disease. The proposed method employs an ensemble approach, incorporating a voting classifier that combines sigmoidal, AdaBoost, SVC, and decision tree algorithms to achieve heightened accuracy. The research also involves the application of traditional classifiers, presenting a comparative analysis of their respective performance, revealing disparities in accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Electric Vehicle Charging Stations with High Efficiency Sic- Based Three-Port Dc/Dc Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This paper introduces an inventive isolated port of three DC/DC converter that melds a series resonant converter (SRC) and a dual active bridge (DAB) converter, with a specific focus on catering to the charging needs of electric vehicle (EV) stations, including both fast and slow charging capabilities. The port configuration of the proposed converter simplifies the component requirements, leading to cost reductions and a more compact system design when compared to standalone charger systems. The control approach is straight forward, employing phase shift and frequency modulation to concurrently regulate the output power of both fast and slow charging ports. Furthermore, an phase shift angle is determined to minimize transformer current when exclusively operating the DAB adapter for slow charging. To validate the converter's performance, a 5-kW SiC-based simulation with an impressive power density of 2.74 kW/dm³ is tested using a 600 V input voltage, and a 400W SiC-based prototype is assembled and tested with a 48 V input voltage. The converter consistently delivers high-efficiency over a wide variety of output voltages, with rated efficiency reaching 98.2%.

articleTitle: Prevention and Intimation of Accident Zone Location
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Accidents on roadways continue to pose a significant threat to public safety, demanding innovative solutions for prevention and swift response. This paper presents a comprehensive approach to leveraging IoT technology for accident prevention and location notification. The research begins with a review of existing literature on accident prevention and notification systems, emphasizing the need for a more robust and integrated approach. This system harnesses the power of IoT by seamlessly connecting vehicle sensors, road infrastructure, and traffic monitoring systems, enabling accurate identification of accident-prone zones. In the event of an accident, the IoT system swiftly alerts emergency services, law enforcement, and nearby vehicles, reducing response time and enhancing accident management. Utilizing IoT devices, such as sensors and actuators, location information is collected and disseminated to ensure precise navigation to the accident scene. The results of the study showcase a substantial reduction in accident response time and improved accident prevention, highlighting the transformative potential of IoT technology in road safety. This research contributes to the advancement of accident prevention and management systems, offering a practical and efficient solution that leverages the capabilities of IoT. It represents a critical step toward safer and more secure roadways, ultimately saving lives and reducing the economic cost associated with accidents.

articleTitle: Enhancing Healthcare with Li-Fi Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In the pursuit of enhancing healthcare, Li-Fi, a cutting-edge visible light-based wireless communication technology, offers transformative potential in critical settings such as the ICU and OT. Li-Fi's high-speed data transmission in the ICU enables real-time patient monitoring and instant access to electronic health records, aiding rapid decision-making. In the OT, it facilitates precise surgery with low-latency access to critical data and seamless team communication. Furthermore, Li-Fi's inherent security, with its limited signal range and obstruction requirements, safeguards patient data in an environment where privacy is paramount.

articleTitle: AGROFACTS
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: A significant economic engine is agriculture. It is essential for a thriving ecology. A vast variety of agricultural goods are essential to human life in practically every way. Farmers must adapt to climate change while supplying more food grains of higher quality to a growing global population. Knowing the soil's nutritional composition and climatic circumstances will help the farmer choose the best crop to plant in those conditions and increase crop output and growth. This data is to be collected using specialized sensors which will be fed to the pre-trained machine learning model through a hardware interface that offers suggestion of appropriate crops for the data supplied. The model is deployed in a Web application using the FLASK framework which provides interface between the model and the web application. The study has been made on various prediction algorithms to suggest the best crop to obtain its maximum yield. In the agricultural industry, machine learning techniques are employed to increase crop output and quality. The suggestion of an ideal crop can be aided by the use of relevant algorithms using sensed data. In addition, users can send purchase request and they can purchase products such as fertilizers, pesticides, weedicide, manure through website. Vendors can show their products for sale conveniently.

articleTitle: Advanced Home Surveillance Using openCV and ML
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Security is a major worry in today's world. Due to multiple detailed obligations, the demands of our busy life frequently led to homes being left neglected. To solve this worry, the majority of people have resorted to Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) cameras to protect their homes while they are abroad. In the context of smart cities, surveillance camera video plays a critical role in crime prevention and investigation. However, it is worth mentioning that traditional video surveillance, which primarily records without undertaking object analysis, is seen as less effective in the face of developing security issues. So, we use openCV for optimised image processing. We'll have an initial image and then capture an image if any motion is detected and compare structural similarity on both the images to detect any missing object. Another major feature of this project is face-recognition which is done using LBPH Face-Identification method. Using Machine Learning, first we will train the model with the dataset then we will detect the presence of face in frames. After that we make predictions by using the trained model to accurately identify the person.

articleTitle: Fault Detection and Prevention With Energy Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This research paper presents an approach, to managing energy in settings focusing on analyzing power usage accurately within homes. The system is powered by the ESP32 microcontroller. Incorporates essential components like the ZMPT101 voltage sensor and the ACS712 5 current sensor. The paper explains the principles behind analyzing power consumption encompassing voltage, current, power factor, active power, and energy usage. It also describes the calibration process for these components. Discusses how Amazon Web Services (AWS) is integrated to process and analyze data. The results highlight how this system can provide homeowners with insights into their energy consumption empowering them to make decisions, about efficiency and sustainability.

articleTitle: Diabetic Care: NIG
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: These days, diabetes is a serious illness in our nation. A person with diabetes mellitus must constantly check their blood glucose levels to ensure optimal insulin consumption. The patient utilizes a glucometer or an invasive procedure in the lab to monitor their blood sugar levels. They must prickle their finger in order to use the glucometer, which hurts. Additionally, tissues get stiff with repeated finger pricks. We came up with the concept of a non-invasive glucometer to prevent this. We can test the glucose level by measuring the intensity received after the light has been sent, using a red laser and an ambient light sensor. They won't have to poke themselves, making it more pleasant to use. Additionally, using this gadget will be more portable. The Raman spectrograph will be used to assess the light's intensity. Accuracy will be much improved by the training and testing of the datasets. The graph of the weak will be displayed to maintain their glucose level.

articleTitle: Prediction of Depression using the KNeighbors-Classifier Algorithm Compared for Improved Accuracy with Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The intention of the research is to regulate the level of precision via comparing the Support_Vector_Machine(S-V-M) algorithm and KNeighbors Classifier for predicting Depression. The proposed machine learning method aims to enhance the accuracy of depression prediction using the S-V-M algorithm, in evaluation with the Novel KNeighbors Classifier. The training dataset comprises two groups, with 10 individuals in each group. The example size calculation conducted via a pretest control of 80%, a significance level of 0.05%, then a 95% sureness interval. When associated to the current system, which has an accurateness of only 84%, it remained originate that the future method attained 95% accuracy. Here exists no consequence amid the S-V-M Model then KNeighbors Classifier Prototypical grounded on a example T-test through the p value is 0.000 (p<0.050). next it indicates that There exists a statistically meaningful distinction between the outcomes of the two algorithms. The outcomes of the training indicate that the KNeighborsClassifier procedure has a higher accurateness in predicting depression compared to the existing system. While the current system is capable of predicting depression, the Novel KNeighbors Classifier algorithm exhibits better performance in depression prediction. Therefore, the Novel KNeighbors Classifier algorithm is recommended for depression prediction.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Tool to Predict and Analyze Students' Stress for Their Academic Growth
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Due to inadequate preparation and direction, students are currently unable to pursue careers as scientists, doctors, engineers, or pilots. The administration of the school, can use different steps in order to improve performance among pupils by motivating them to achieve their objectives and providing them with the necessary training and direction so that they can pass the entrance test for their further education by being aware of their areas of strength. We have developed a web application as a solution to the aforementioned issue, allowing the administration to gather pupil information and save it in a database for use in tracking attendance, marks, and performance. Next data gathering, the factors that determine the pupil's result are separated and entered into a web application that can forecast whether the pupil will pass the entrance exam. For the purpose of determining if the student is prepared to take their tests with confidence, a quiz that assesses the students' mental health is provided before the inclusion of this prediction. If the management or mentors of the institute determine that a student cannot pass the test or that their mental health requires extra coaching, they can offer them adequate counsel. Our project involves developing an effective web application that uses the random forest machine learning algorithm to examine the mental health of the student. We installed it in our web application since we obtain an accuracy of 94%. This online application will serve as a conduit between high school students and the administration of the school. Utilising this tool, administrators may assess students' abilities and provide them with the appropriate guidance.

articleTitle: Enhancing Accuracy in Crop Yield Estimation Through the Integration of Naive Bayes and Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This article improves the accuracy of crop yield forecast by using convolutional neural network and Naive Bayes algorithm. Supplies and Procedures. The study comprised 42 samples, which were grouped into two sets of 21 samples each. While the second group utilised the Convolutional Neural Network technique, the first group used the Naive Bayes technique. The statistical power of the study was established at 80% with an alpha level of 0.05 and a beta level of 0.20, using G power. Results: The Naive Bayes algorithm tends to have a higher accuracy rate, which in this case is around 88%. On the other hand, the Convolutional Neural Network algorithm has a slightly lower accuracy rate of approximately 82%. Independent sample t-test using this paper. It has a significant value of p is .046 (p<0.05), this is statistically significant. Conclusion: The Naive Bayes algorithm was discovered to exhibit a higher level of accuracy in comparison to the Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm.

articleTitle: MediID: Medicine Identification System Displaying Simplified Uses of the Medicine Using Python
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: There are various kinds of diseases prevailing in the present world and the medication prescribed for the same is also growing enormously. To keep track of benefits of every single medicine on a person's medication list is quite difficult. This is where MediID will be helpful. The main goal of MediID is to present the medicine's uses in layman's language to the end-user. MediID will be a versatile tool since it will accept various inputs, including images, audio recordings, scanned images, and written descriptions of medications. From the medicine name which is extracted from the input using deep learning, MediID will search through the relevant records that are available in the database. Finally, the end-user will be shown about the utilities of the medicines in plain, basic terms.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Trolley for Visually Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Mall is a place where people get their daily stuff needs However, it is a challenge for the visually impaired people shopping in supermarkets. When you shop at the supermarket, visually impaired people are frustrated when they find objects shopping list and help is not available. Beat them problems The smart trolley is designed with a mobile application. This offers an app that helps customers locate of the product. It also offers centralized and automatic billing the system uses RFID. Every product from mall, supermarket equipped with an RFID tag to identify its type. Every purchase the shopping cart is implemented with a product identification device (Arduino Uno), which includes a microcontroller, an RFID reader. to buy product information is read using an RFID reader cart and will be displayed on the receiver to which it is connected a guide The total amount of the invoice is transferred at the settlement point to the computer via the Bluetooth module. So it makes the process easier for both visually impaired and supermarket owners.

articleTitle: Potato Leaf Diseases Detection Using Machine Learning And Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Agriculture plays a vital role in sustaining human life, providing the food and resources needed for survival. With the advent of digitalization, technology has permeated every aspect of our lives, including agriculture. The potato, a versatile tuber, is a widely enjoyed and commonly consumed staple in diets across the globe. To ensure a prosperous potato production, establishing a robust food security system becomes imperative, given its high nutritional value in terms of vitamins and minerals. Nonetheless, it is crucial to address diseases affecting potatoes including early blight and late blight. The manual assessment of these leaf diseases is labor-intensive and inconvenient. In the present investigation, we have implemented a system that utilizes a combination of machine learning and deep learning methodologies to classify two distinct types of diseases in potato plants, relying on the assessment of their leaf conditions. We utilized a range of models including support vector machine, naive bayes, K-Nearest Neighbor, Decision Tree, Random Forest, convolutional neural network, Sequential2, and VGG 16 to establish a highly accurate classification system. Notably, our experiment yielded an impressive accuracy of 95.36% within the initial 10 epochs of VGG 16 training, affirming the viability of the deep neural network approach. This research has made a substantial contribution to the agricultural sector and has provided valuable insights for farmers to effectively classify Potato leaf Disease, yielding optimal results.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Sensor-Based Irrigation System for Efficient Water Management in Remote Agricultural Regions
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Irrigation system with lower cost is considered to be increasingly significant, based on rising growth of human population, demand for food and global warming. This investigation attempts to provide a low cost sensor based irrigation system for monitoring and controlling from remote regions and to optimize water use for farming irrigation. A sensor based irrigation system that monitors and controls the supply of water uses sensors and actuators. It is specifically designed to automate the water supply from reservoirs and to crops over irrigation system. System lifecycle and waterfall model has been considered in development factor. The protocol suite, ardunio are integrated to provide the system model. Here, pumping approach has been utilized to provide water supply to soils. This system design offers sensing, power supply, monitoring and controlling factors and internet sources. Experimentation was carried out in MATLAB environment and simulation outcomes demonstrate practical and effectual way of implementing the anticipated system model. This irrigation system is need not only for farmers and also for increasing the economic functionalities. Moreover, this may diminish manual supervision that is needed for water supply by invoking remote monitoring and control system.

articleTitle: Development of Smart Energy Meter Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Technology advancements have increased our dependency on electrical and technological equipment, emphasising how crucial power is to leading a pleasant existence. However, the widespread problem of power theft poses a serious risk to grid infrastructure, particularly in nations like India. The use of Smart Energy Metres (SEMs) is suggested as a defence against this. SEMs employ wireless communication to identify and stop power theft by keeping an eye on trends of energy usage. The system described in this article provides a versatile solution for both postpaid and prepaid billing by utilising SEMs for power theft detection and automatic invoicing. By substituting automated solutions for manual metres, we improve energy management, provide ongoing oversight, and help to spot metre manipulation and electricity theft.

articleTitle: Convenient Way of Accessing Multimedia Functions Using Ml and Open CV
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In current world, most of the activities are machine-used and the existing systems to human computer interaction is not sufficient or efficient. So this paper demonstrates the idea to facilitate the interaction by using hand movement with help of Arduino sensor. This innovative approach harnesses the power of gesture recognition, enabling users to control and manipulate digital interfaces effortlessly. By bridging the physical and virtual realms, this technology opens new avenues for creative expression, efficient task execution, and enhanced user experiences. This paper delves into the realm of human-computer interaction through Arduino sensor-based hand movement, exploring the underlying principles, applications across various domains, and the potential to reshape the way we interact with computers.

articleTitle: Anemia Detection Through Image Analysis and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: A non-invasive method for early anemia identification. The technology uses image processing and analysis to extract important characteristics from pertinent regions, including the fingernails or conjunctiva. With the use of sophisticated algorithms, these characteristics will be connected to hemoglobin levels to provide an accessible smartphone application for anemia screening. The goal of the project is to advance non-invasive, effective diagnostic techniques that will facilitate early intervention and improve access to healthcare.

articleTitle: Automated Driving Licensing System Based on Wireless Sensor Networks and IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The advent of autonomous vehicles has revolutionized the automotive industry, offering promising advancements in safety, efficiency, and mobility. To integrate these autonomous vehicles into our society seamlessly, it is imperative to establish a robust licensing system that ensures the safe operation of automated vehicles on public roads. This paper presents an effective Automated Driving Licensing System (ADLS), a digital framework designed to regulate and license autonomous vehicles. The ADLS leverages cutting-edge technology, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, and secure data management, to evaluate and validate the capabilities of autonomous vehicle systems. Through a comprehensive assessment process, the system assesses the vehicle's ability to navigate various road conditions, respond to dynamic environments, and prioritize safety for passengers and other road users. The automated licensing issuance system ensures that only vehicles meeting predefined safety and performance criteria are granted licenses. Successful licensing is a testament to the vehicle's readiness for autonomous operation within specified geographic regions and under predefined conditions. The proposed system offers a comprehensive approach to safely integrate autonomous vehicles into our transportation ecosystem. Furthermore, the ADLS establishes a framework for continuous monitoring and updates, enabling ongoing assessments to keep pace with evolving technology and safety standards.

articleTitle: IoT Based Smart Shopping Cart
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: A supermarket is a place with different sorts of products which comes under a same roof, by this shopping becomes easy but there are some issues with this type of shopping method that is traditionally every person in the supermarket purchases the product by collecting them all in a trolley. Upon purchase, the billing process takes quite some time and also waiting in long queue will be even worse on festive season and weekends. To overcome these problems, we could incorporate the advancing technology by introducing a smart shopping cart, this method benefits the buyers as well as the shop owners. Each cart has an inbuilt system of a RFID reader to scan the products instead of barcode, an LCD module for displaying product details and cost of total products purchased by the customers. A webpage for generation of a digital copy of the bill has been created by using ESP8266 Wi-Fi module and a power supply for stepping down the voltage and the system to can be implemented by using the Arduino IDE, it is a software tool which we have used for programming.

articleTitle: Crop Selection and Cultivaton using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In the face of the growing global population and the challenges posed by climate change, sustainable agriculture practices are essential. This paper explores the use of Machine Learning (ML) in crop selection and cultivation to address these challenges. Traditional methods are often inadequate given the increasing population and shifting climate patterns. Machine Learning, with its data-driven and predictive approach, has the potential to revolutionize crop management. The study investigates various ML algorithms like neural networks, decision trees, and ensemble models to analyze datasets covering factors such as soil quality, climate conditions, and historical crop performance. By using these algorithms, the goal is to optimize crop selection for specific regions, leading to higher yields and reduced environmental impact. The paper also explores real-time data acquisition methods like IoT sensors and satellite imagery to gain a comprehensive understanding of agricultural landscapes. Furthermore, the paper discusses how ML algorithms can be used in precision agriculture, enabling farmers to make informed decisions regarding irrigation, fertilization, and pest control. By analyzing extensive datasets, these algorithms can predict the best cultivation practices, reducing resource wastage and improving efficiency. The integration of Machine Learning not only provides a data-driven approach to crop selection but also promotes sustainable agriculture, contributing to food security and environmental conservation. This research encourages the adoption of Machine Learning in agriculture, highlighting its transformative potential in global food production systems. By harnessing the power of artificial intelligence, the paper envisions a future where agricultural practices are not only productive and efficient but also environmentally conscious and sustainable.

articleTitle: Quantum-Inspired Neural Network For Enhanced Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The field of quantum computing has seen significant progress in recent times, leading to the emergence of innovative methodologies across several areas, particularly in machine learning and neural networks. This research study introduces a quantum-inspired neural network (QINN) that has been particularly developed to improve image recognition capabilities. In contrast to conventional neural networks, the Quantum-inspired Neural Network (QINN) utilizes concepts derived from quantum mechanics, including superposition and entanglement, to process and encode information effectively. The paradigm we propose incorporates quantum bits (qubits) as computing units instead of traditional binary nodes, simultaneously enabling the representation of many states. Moreover, the use of the intrinsic parallelism of quantum mechanics is harnessed to provide expedited and more effective data processing, particularly within the concealed levels of the network. The researchers ran benchmark tests using well-recognized image datasets, including CIFAR-10 and ImageNet. The study's findings indicated that QINN displayed superior accuracy rates compared to traditional methods and revealed faster convergence throughout the training process. Additionally, our quantum-inspired methodology demonstrated significant efficacy in analyzing pictures containing nuanced characteristics, highlighting its potential in practical scenarios where precise identification is of utmost importance. In summary, integrating quantum principles with neural network topologies has the potential for groundbreaking advancement in image recognition skills. QINN is a groundbreaking advancement in this domain, emphasizing the unexplored capacity to use quantum phenomena for sophisticated machine learning objectives. Potential areas for future study are the expansion of network scalability to accommodate bigger datasets, exploration of security measures that are resilient against quantum threats, and investigating hybrid models that integrate both quantum and conventional paradigms to enhance overall performance.

articleTitle: Smart Dustbin Navigator
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: India, facing a significant waste management crisis due to its massive population, is struggling despite traditional cleanup efforts by municipal bodies. The concept of creating 100 smart cities was introduced by the prime minister but is still in its early stages. These smart cities bring new responsibilities, with waste management being a crucial aspect. Proper trash disposal begins with efficient management of garbage bins.Strategic placement and regular emptying of bins are essential for effective waste disposal within communities. The introduction of real-time monitoring systems within these bins could revolutionize waste management. By employing IoT protocols, bin status could be transmitted wirelessly, triggering email notifications when bins are full and need to be emptied. Ultrasonic sensors could help users locate nearby bins and assess the amount of waste present.The key challenge in many Indian towns is the unclean state of bins. This essay proposes enhancing the often-neglected dustbin, introducing an intelligent approach to waste management. IoT protocols would enable constant communication of bin status, generating alerts for timely action. Ultrasonic sensors would aid users in finding bins and gauging fill levels. This advancement could greatly improve cleanliness and waste disposal in urban areas. Through such measures, India could take a significant step towards effective waste management in the context of its smart city initiatives.

articleTitle: Intra College Web Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The “Intra-College Web Communication System” has been created to abrogate the issues found in the rehearsing manual framework. This software is renounced for eliminating and, sometimes, reduce the backlogs encompassed in the existing system. Moreover, this system is effective manner. Online chatting websites for college students. Passed out student they can chat with the current college student. passed out student and current student they can keep touch with each other. They can share general message and job messages with each other. Passed out student have the job opening they can share with this web sites Using that they can post for job opening. Current college student known any new opening they can post the job post. Student, teacher and principal all can interact with each other. we have classified into two types of chat job chat and general chat. Job chat post job messages and general chat post general message. These services that are of frequent use, has extensive use cases in the educational domain by providing relevant applications and system tools to students and teachers for seamless communication. The system is through to the web services which is here implemented as a java application where java and HTML client support mutual communication. The proposed system provides an affordable application for users in their day-to-day life. The cloud integration in this application offers better educational standards with very less expenses.

articleTitle: Design of Aircraft Control System for Accident Prevention
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In recent years, aircraft accidents have highlighted the critical need for advanced control systems to enhance flight safety and prevent catastrophic events. The proposed control system utilizes high-precision sensors (accelerometers, gyroscopes, radar, optical) to gather real-time data on the aircraft's position, orientation, speed, and environmental conditions. Intelligent algorithms and predictive models process this data to accurately assess risks and predict hazardous scenarios Adaptive control algorithms dynamically adjust control surfaces, engine thrust, and flight control parameters to maintain stability and maneuverability. The system prioritizes proactive measures, employing predictive algorithms to anticipate hazards and adjust the aircraft's configuration and trajectory. The proposed control system will undergo rigorous testing through advanced simulations and real-world flight trials. Its performance and effectiveness in preventing accidents will be evaluated across various scenarios. By combining cutting-edge technologies, intelligent algorithms, adaptive controls and pilot assistance, the proposed control system aims to revolutionize flight safety, reducing accidents and ensuring passenger and crew safety.

articleTitle: Navigating the Metaverse: Trends and Opportunities in 2023
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The idea of the Metaverse, which entails employing immersive technologies like virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and others to extend the bounds of the physical world, has drawn a lot of interest. However, there is currently no consensus over the precise nature of the Metaverse, leading to inconsistent writings. By examining previous studies, this research article seeks to offer a thorough knowledge of the Metaverse. It looks at the Metaverse's trends, traits, difficulties, and prospects, especially in relation to numerous application disciplines. The report also proposes the Metaverse Research Model, a conceptualization and clarification of core Metaverse concepts that provides helpful direction for future research.

articleTitle: Fisherman Border Detector Using IOT Andlora
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The peninsula, island and the coastal countries had their boundary limit in the sea, the people's lives in those types of country have the work of fishing in the sea due to carelessness or without knowing their boundary limit of their country they crossing the borders. In such situation the lives of fishermen continue to be difficult. They are being abducted and their boats are being captured. Nowadays people living in coastal areas are loss their valuable life unknowingly. Those peoples shot death by the neighborhood militants, saying that they crossing the borders. So, our project is designed to avoid such kind of accidents and to alert the fisherman about the border areas. In our project, we are using GPS module is used to alert the fisherman in which distance they are from the border. The automatic alarming system is going to be provided along with this device which alerts in case any sort of issues. This is devised in such a way that the application can be easily been utilized by all the people in the surroundings. The application operates based on device tracking. This provides ease to operate even for illiterate people. The paper aims at providing a system that will alert the fishermen well in advance and ensure maximum safety and peace at the border.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Classification using Fine Needle Aspiration Test with Graphical Neural Networks in Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: As per the statistics given by World Health Organization (WHO), in the list of reasons for women mortality, breast cancer holds the sixth place. Women in India also suffer from Breast cancer in a huge amount Breast cancer is basically the breast affected by carcinogenic cells. This can be of two types - Benign and Malignant. Benign denotes the non-spreadable cells whereas malignant cells are widely spreadable and cause several other cancers. The early the detection the easierto cure. In order to predict cancer in early stage with high accuracy, it requires the hands of technology. The main role of technology here is to predict the cancerous cells in much accurate way. Here comes the use of machine learning and deep learning. Using several neural networks, we can predict the outcomes in which each neural network performs with different accuracy levels for same data. This paper shows the detection of breast cancer type by taking the Fine Needle Aspiration (FNA) test data as input and uses the graphical neural network (GNN) to predict the type of cancer cells with higher accuracy than Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).

articleTitle: LIDAR Micro Drone with Proximity Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: India is an emerging nation in many ways, mostly in the area of technology. One among them drone's usage is around the corner. Drones are employed across numerous domains and contain a broad range of uses, from thermal inspections to shooting and videography. This is a small, lightweight drone that can fly indoors, outdoors, in forests, or gardens. It uses proximity sensing technology called LIDAR, or light detection and ranging, to detect obstructions. By altering the light and buzzer frequency in accordance with proximity, the user is continuously informed about the drone's closeness, allowing it to be managed appropriately to prevent collisions. Thus, it is constructed with a micro drone equipped with a LIDARbased obstacle detecting capability. This drone facilitates an understanding of both drone flight and drone obstacle detection. Additionally, flying it in a dense forest with tight spaces is less dangerous because to its smaller size and cheaper cost.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Investigation to Examine the Preferences and Satisfaction Levels of Outpatients in Relation to the Quality of Services Provided by Hospitals in the Vellore District
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The satisfaction of one's customers is still the most intriguing aspect of doing company. Any business should seek to maximize earnings while decreasing overhead as much as possible. Increased sales combined with decreased expenses can lead to a healthier bottom line. Satisfied customers are more likely to return, which contributes to a growing firm. In recent years, patient happiness has become an increasingly important indicator of healthcare quality. As healthcare IT has evolved over the past few years, service providers' practices have shifted significantly. Today's health care system has challenges for every level of government, every region, every political party, and every insurance provider. This can be traced back to the unusually high degree of competition present in this market. The delivery of medical care is shifting from the public sector to the private, for-profit, and nonprofit sectors. The researcher set out to investigate patients' perceptions of the quality of hospital care and their level of satisfaction with the treatments they received. It is desired that all professionals, medical and otherwise, will pay careful consideration to patient care quality in all that they do. An in-depth knowledge of the patient and a conviction that the patient is the most important factor in one's success as a health care provider are necessary for achieving high levels of patient satisfaction, which is the most valuable asset that health care practitioners possess.

articleTitle: Smart Waste Segregator
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The increasing global waste generation poses a significant challenge to environmental sustainability. Waste segregation is a crucial step towards effective waste management and recycling. This project introduces a “Smart Waste Segregator” system that utilizes sensor technology to automatically classify waste into metallic and non-metallic categories. Using a network of sensors, the Smart waste segregator detects waste items as they pass through the system. Once the waste item is identified as metallic or non-metallic, the smart waste segregator activates the appropriate mechanism to divert the waste into the corresponding bins. This segregation process occurs seamlessly and swiftly, minimizing human intervention and reducing the chances of cross-contamination. The inductive proximity sensors are used for metal detection. Ultrasonic sensors are used to detect bin-level information. The entire system is operated by an Arduino Mega microcontroller.

articleTitle: Animal Intrusion Detection And CropProtection Using Yolo And Sound Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The YOLO algorithm redefines object detection by framing it as a regression problem. Instead of sliding window approaches, YOLO divides an image into a grid and assigns bounding boxes to objects within grid cells. Each bounding box prediction also includes class probabilities, making YOLO a single-pass approach that efficiently localizes and classifies objects simultaneously.

articleTitle: Tourism Prediction Using Clustering and Time Series Modelling
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The tourism sector is one of the largest and fastest growing in the world's economies. In 2016, it was responsible for 10.2% of the world's GDP and 6.6% of annual exports. By 2027, it is expected to outperform retail and public services in terms of its contribution to the overall GDP, which ranges from 2.5 to 4%. The influence of climate on international travel is one of the key considerations. The world's climate has changed significantly since pre- industrial times, according to solid scientific data. Rising sea levels, an increase in the frequency and intensity of hurricanes, warming oceans, protracted droughts, and glacier melt are just a few of the severe effects that are predicted to result from these changes. Due to the extreme sensitivity of regional climates to both travellers and tourist attractions, the tourism sector and all of its stakeholders must adapt. Consequently, the worldwide phenomena of climate change is now having a significant impact on decision-making within the tourism industry.

articleTitle: Smart Agri Guide
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Access to accurate and current information is essential given how quickly the agriculture industry is changing. For farmers, researchers, students, and hobbyists, the suggested solution offers a wealth of information about diverse crops, cultivation methods, and the worldwide agricultural scene. Our website offers a user-friendly platform with detailed articles, pictures, and information about a variety of crops, from common ones like wheat, rice, and maize to uncommon variants and specialty crops. View in-depth profiles that cover the history, geography, growing requirements, and harvesting techniques of various crops. The website goes beyond the fundamentals, exploring modern advancements in agricultural technology, pest and disease management, and sustainable farming methods. The program serves as the entrance to a growing online market for agricultural crops that connects farmers, suppliers, and customers. The application gives a ground-breaking platform that alters how agricultural products are purchased and sold. Farmers and producers may easily advertise their produce, get in touch with new customers, and broaden their market. By offering capabilities for inventory management, price tactics, and logistical assistance, the program streamlines the selling process.

articleTitle: Impact of Big Data Analytics in Global Business for Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The analysis of big data has a major and widespread impact on the way international business is conducted in regard to sustainable development. By using the power of large and diverse data sets, businesses have the potential to gain invaluable insights about the behavior of their customers, the trends of the market, and the effectiveness of their operations. This gives them the ability to make decisions based on facts that not only boost their profits but also assist their efforts to achieve long-term sustainability goals. Thanks to big data analytics, businesses now have the ability to more effectively allocate resources, reduce waste, and come up with innovative solutions to challenging environmental and social issues. Additionally, it permits proactive tactics that encourage economic growth while minimizing negative consequences on the environment and society, thereby producing a corporate ecosystem that is more sustainable and responsible. This helps detect potential possibilities as well as threats in a global context that is always shifting.

articleTitle: Design and Development of IOT-Based Intelligent Farming System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: There are nearly 14 nutrients required for plant growth which include the macronutrients' nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), potassium (K), calcium (Ca), magnesium (Mg) and sulphur (S) etc. The Intelligent Farming system helps to determine the soil's fertility due to factors like pH, texture, organic matter etc. These sensors work by inserting the probe which receives electrical signals, which in turn shows the value required. The irrigation system is used to regulate steady water flow for plants required. A mobile based application can also be implemented for the benefit of farmers which help the users to monitor data, regulate water flow to crops anytime at ease. This mobile based application can be connected to the Intelligent Farming System which enables the users to monitor and get weather and soil and even regulate water control for crops. This mobile application can also help the user to get the analytic data required to buy and sell yield along with their locations This system would benefit farmers of any scale as it would reduce their burden of worrying about watering crops, pest elimination, do the necessary precautions.

articleTitle: IoT Based Robot for Domestic Surveillance Using ESP-NodeMCU
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In recent years, the Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionized the way we interact with and monitor our surroundings. One compelling application of IoT technology is in the field of domestic surveillance, where smart devices and sensors are employed to enhance security and convenience. This abstract presents an overview of an IoT-based robot designed for domestic surveillance, leveraging the ESP-NodeMCUplatform. The proposed system combines the capabilities of a mobile robot with the flexibility of the ESP-NodeMCU microcontroller, creating an efficient and cost-effective solution for monitoring and securing residential spaces. The key components of this system include a robot chassis, wheels, motors, a camera module, ultrasonic sensors, and the ESP-NodeMCUmicrocontroller. To enhance the robot's navigational capabilities, ultrasonic sensors are integrated into the system.
