These sensors enable obstacle detection and avoidance, ensuring that the robot can move autonomously through the home environment without colliding with objects or obstacles. Additionally, the robot can be programmed to follow predefined paths or respond to specific events, such as detecting unusual movements or sounds. Thus an IoT-based robot for domestic surveillance using ESP-NodeMCU represents an innovative and accessible approach to enhancing home security and automation. Its ability to provide remote monitoring, real-time alerts, and autonomous navigation makes it a valuable asset for homeowners seeking a comprehensive and cost-effective solution to protect their living spaces

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Tennis Shot Type Prediction Using Gait Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This paper proposes a real-time tennis shot prediction system based on computer vision and gait analysis. This method uses the Position Pipeline to extract the tennis player's position markers from the webcam sequence. These positional signals are then used to calculate the player's gait characteristics, such as step length and cadence. A machine learning model based on gait measurements is then used to predict the type of shot the player will make. The expected recording style is displayed in real time on the webcam video. This technique was tested using a dataset of tennis players hitting different shots. The algorithm accurately predicts shot patterns 95% of the time. Tennis players who follow the recommended method can improve both their play and technique. It can also be used to develop new training programs and evaluate the effectiveness of different training philosophies.

articleTitle: Spectro - Temporal Based Feature Extraction for Identification of Pathological Voice Signals from Normal
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Vocal pathology commonly referred to as vocal disorders or dysphonia that focuses on assessing, diagnosing, and treating diseases that have an impact on the voice's quality, function and output. It entails the evaluation and treatment of a wide range of vocal anomalies and difficulties that may result from functional, neurological, psychological, or physical reasons. One-fifth of the world's population has experienced vocal abnormalities brought on by illnesses or other dysfunctions. Voice disorders are any irregularities in a person's typical speech, which has an impact on social integration and communication. Prior to substantial study, a variety of conventional (invasive) procedures for voice disorder detection were employed. However, computer-based (non-invasive) techniques for voice problem detection are now available. Identification of voice pathology in most of the proposed systems used precise database and obtained lesser accuracy. This work utilizes various number of voice signals for the vowel /a/, /i/ and /u/ for both healthy and pathology from Saarbrucken voice database. Various features such as MFCC, MFCC delta, pitch, crest, entropy, flatness, flux, kurtosis, roll off point, skewness, slope, spread, harmonic ratio and spectral centroid were extracted for both healthy and pathological voices. Feature selection methods such as principal component analysis and fuzzy entropy measures were used to obtain prominent features. MFCC, MFCC delta and spectral centroid were found as a significant feature from FEM which helps in categorization of various voice disorders.

articleTitle: Parkinson's Disease Detection by Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Parkinson's disease is a special type of neurological condition which is quite common and has an impact on people's lives all over the world. For the condition to be successfully treated and managed, early detection, attention and diagnosis are very essential. Recent research has demonstrated that early signs of Parkinson's disease might include changes in speech, such as those in speaking rate and voice quality. In this study, this paper suggests a brand-new method for identifying this Parkinson's disease using speech alterations. In this paper, we introduce a machine-learning model that can analyze speech samples and reliably identify Parkinson's illness. Our methods are based on the examination of several speech characteristics, including pitch, jitter, and shimmer, which are well-known to be impacted by the illness. Our results show that our method performs well when applied to a dataset of speech samples from people with and without this disease.

articleTitle: Blind Cicerone
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: We propose a camera-based application that combines object detection and text extraction using OCR. It is a useful and adaptable system with wide range of potential applications which utilizes camera as its primary input source. This can be a smart phone camera, webcam, or any other camera-equipped device. The system performs real-time object detection on the camera frame, identifying objects and their precise locations. Bounding boxes are drawn around detected objects to visually indicate their positions. In addition to detecting objects, the system can also recognize and label the objects it identifies. This recognition can be based on a pre-trained model that associates objects with class labels. If text is detected within the camera frame, the system uses Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to extract and convert the text into machine- readable format. OCR algorithms are applied to recognize and extract printed or handwritten text. Once an object is detected and recognized, or if text is extracted, the system utilizes a Text-to- Speech (TTS) API to convert the recognized text or object label into spoken language. This enables the application to provide audible feedback to the user, enhancing accessibility.

articleTitle: Fake News Classification in Twitter Data Using Innovative K Nearest Neighbor Comparing Logistics Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Improve the accuracy of identifying fake news on Twitter by employing the Advanced K Nearest Neighbor Algorithm then evaluating the results against those obtained through Logistic Regression Algorithm. Materials and Methods: The research is divided into two groups, each with a sample size of 42 individuals. The first group, comprising 21 participants, will apply the Advanced K Nearest Neighbor Algorithm, while the second group, also consisting of 21 participants, will use the Logistic Regression technique. The study has been designed with G power 80% parameters of α=0.05 and beta=0.2. Result: Innovative K nearest neighbor Algorithm 81.55 % identifies objects and increases the measured accuracy over Logistic Regression 79.0 % with implication value of 0.001 (p < 0.05). Conclusion: In terms of accuracy, the Innovative K Nearest Neighbor Algorithm outperforms Logistic Regression Algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Automatic Payment of Car Parking Charges with Random Forest and Comparison over Naïve-Bayes Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The focus of the article is to develop a new RandomForest technique and compare it to the Naïve Bayes Algorithm to produce an automatic reduction in amount for car parking rental and reduce excess of waiting time. No. of two groups were chosen for the investigation, with sample sizes of 10 for each group. Random Forest is in group 1, and NaiveBayes is in group 2. The new RandomForest method and the naive Bayes algorithm are introduced for thorough experimentation. The two sample sizes were tested using the 452 rows of data in the Smart Parking System dataset, which included title time and p-class label variables. In comparison with the NaiveBayes algorithm, which has an accuracy rate of 70.66%, the new RandomForest approach has a slightly better accuracy of 74.10%. 0.001 (p<0.05) and indicates that there is no statistical significance between these groups. Statistically significant disparities between these groups are obviously present. While the comparison the two algorithms, the Novel RandomForest classification is much accurate than Naïve-Bayes Algorithm.

articleTitle: Eight-Legged Spider Bionic Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The innate human drive to venture into uncharted territories, uncover new realms, and continuously surpass scientific and technological limits is an irresistible force. However, this thrilling endeavor often carries inherent dangers and risks. Nonetheless, exploring the unknown remains imperative for the progress and safety of our society and the world at large. Robotic systems present an ideal solution for venturing into these hazardous environments, eliminating the need for human presence in potentially perilous areas. Our spider bot embodies this concept, incorporating an array of sensors and leveraging reinforcement learning an artificial intelligence technique that emulates the movement of spiders. The spider robot utilizes kinematic motion, powered by Theo Jansen linkages, and its operations are controlled through the Arduino IDE.

articleTitle: An Automatic Control Optimal Staff Scheduling Using Smart Biometric Timekeeper
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Inefficient attendance tracking and absence management which are based on manual scheduling creates manager discretion and results in inefficient staff scheduling. Time and attendance tracking systems, often comes with manual data entry. The integration of fingerprint biometrics plays a vital role in accurate attendance tracking. In the proposed approach, biometric data is utilized to formulate an optimization model for staff scheduling. The proposed approach enables User-friendly interface for manager oversights, improved operational efficiency and fairness in scheduling. Due to this administrative burden has been minimized. The proposed approach offers significant advantages over traditional methods, including better resource utilization and accuracy in attendance tracking. Future enhancements to this approach could include expanding the system's adaptability to different types of organizations, exploring additional biometric data sources, and enhancing the system's scalability and integration with other HR and management tools. Overall, this new approach to staff scheduling offers a number of promising benefits for organizations of all sizes.

articleTitle: Recognizing Distraction for Assistive Driving by Tracking Body Parts Using Novel Convolutional Neural Network with LGM Classifier Over Random Forest with Improved Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In the context of identifying driver distractions, the goal of this study is to investigate the degree of accuracy exhibited by the most recent iterations of deep learning algorithms. Both Convolutional Neural Networks Utilising LGM Classifier (CNNLGM) and Random Forest (RF) are compared head-to-head in the research presented here. The investigation required a total of 118 samples, which were then divided equally between two categories consisting of 58 specimens each. Group 1 utilized the CNNLGM Classifier, in contrast to Group 2's utilization of the RF technique. The RF code was implemented using software from Google Colab, and the same program was also used to import the dataset. A pre-test power of 80% and an alpha value of 0.05 were taken into consideration while determining the appropriate size of the sample for the experiment. This was accomplished with the assistance of an online tool for statistical analysis. Previous research provided the necessary information for determining the appropriate size of the sample to use. The findings of the simulation showed that the Novel CNNLGM Classifier achieved an accuracy of 96%, whereas the RF algorithm could only achieve an accuracy of 82%. There was a substantial disparity in the levels of accuracy achieved by the two approaches, as measured by a significance value of 0.001 (p<0.05). To summarise, when utilizing the data that was supplied, the CNNLGM Classifier performed noticeably better than the RF algorithm when it came to identifying when a driver was paying attention.

Author Keywords: Novel Convolutional Neural Network with LGM Classifier

articleTitle: Design and Development of IoT Camera with CHATBOT for Domestic Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is an increasingly influential technology that is shaping our future by connecting physical devices through the internet. To enhance security measures and establish a wireless smart campus, this proposed work aims to optimize the existing wireless video surveillance system using IoT. This approach enables coordinated tracking over a wide area, ensuring superior tracking and monitoring capabilities. Detecting and responding to suspicious activities is a critical task for security personnel in today's context, with a particular emphasis on the safety of pets and children. Traditional AI cameras offer solutions for monitoring, but they do not provide real-time images of children, and manual supervision can be costly and impractical. To address this issue, the proposed solution involves the design of a smart IoT camera that can communicate and provide real-time images at a minimal cost. These cameras can engage in conversations and send images via a chat platform like Telegram and Whatsapp. IoT cameras contribute to real-time building access monitoring, offering remote streaming capabilities accessible from anywhere. Some IoT security cameras even incorporate advanced features such as facial recognition and computer vision to identify intruders or suspicious individuals. The front end of this work includes a video processing module that analyses monitored images and applies sophisticated algorithms to compare them with user-defined security criteria. Making a Chatbot is the first step in enabling the IoT camera to participate in discussions, reply to messages, and review them. When a security threat is detected, the monitoring system triggers an immediate alert. This technology can be applied in various domains, including public safety monitoring and residential community surveillance.

articleTitle: An Efficient Fetal Health Prediction System Using Enhanced XGB Classifier Compared Over K-Nearest Neighbor Classifier with Less Complexity and Improved Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The aim of this research is to improve the Fetal Health Prediction using the XGB Classifier and in comparison, with K- Nearest Neighbor. Prenatal diagnostics, which includes screening and diagnostic testing, can give important details about the fetus's health and help people comprehend the risk. This study aims to offer clinicians and expectant mothers convenient services by gathering secondary data from diverse sources. In this study, a total of 3200 data points was utilized for our research purposes. Out of these, 2560 data points were allocated for training, while the remaining 640 data points were set aside for testing. The entire process was iterated 10 times for robustness. The study involved two distinct groups, with each group consisting of 10 samples. The K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) Algorithm was categorized under Group 2, while the XGB Classifier Algorithm was assigned to Group 1. The statistical power of our analysis was set at 80%. The XGB Classifier Algorithm demonstrated a notably higher accuracy rate of 95.96% compared to the KNN Algorithm, which achieved an accuracy of 87.74%. The calculated significance value was 0.001 (p < 0.05), indicating that there is a statistically significant difference between the two algorithms considered for the development of the Novel Fetal Health Prediction System. In conclusion, our findings highlight that the XGB Classifier Algorithm outperforms the K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm with an impressive accuracy rate of 95.96%, which is significantly higher than the 87.74% accuracy achieved by the latter. This underscores the potential superiority of the XGB Classifier Algorithm for the task at hand in the context of fetal health prediction.

articleTitle: Integrating Active Contours and Decision Trees for Systematic Hemorrhage Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Medical imaging is a pivotal tool for visualizing internal bodily structures and comprehending organ and tissue functions. This study focuses on a system designed to identify and categorize hemorrhages in CT scans. Different imaging techniques like CT scans, MRI, and X-rays can produce these visuals. The system's main objective is to identify hemorrhages and, when found, categorize them. To accomplish this, various initial processing steps, such as converting to grayscale, adjusting size, detecting edges, and enhancing clarity, are executed on the CT images, readying them for further evaluation. Morphological operations identify shape-related hemorrhage features, using the Sobel and marker techniques to highlight regions of interest. Subsequently, the watershed algorithm facilitates hemorrhage detection through segmentation. Once hemorrhages are detected, feature extraction is performed for classification. Active contours define hemorrhage areas, and extracted features enter a Decision Tree classifier for type determination. Results can be interpreted in collaboration with medical professionals. This research enhances hemorrhage prediction and classification in medical images, achieving 92% average accuracy in classifying three hemorrhage types.

articleTitle: Fake App Detection Using Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In today's environment, fraudulent actions in mobile applications have become a major worry. It is now critical to identify and stop fraudulent activity within mobile apps due to their continued rapid growth across multiple sectors. This abstract presents a comprehensive approach to fraud app detection leveraging sentiment analysis techniques. Our goal is to identify fraudulent mobile applications within app stores by analyzing user-generated reviews and ratings. We first compile a dataset of app reviews and get the text data ready for analysis. Sentiment analysis is employed to assign sentiment scores to each review, providing insights into user opinions. We present a machine learning model trained on labeled data to identify whether an app is fraudulent based on the sentiment scores and other relevant criteria. Standard measures like F1-score, ROC-AVC, accuracy, precision, and recall are accustomed to evaluate performance. A visual evaluation of Visualizations such as ROC curves and precision-recall curves demonstrate the model's ability to discriminate between fraudulent and non-fraudulent apps. Our results shed light on the effectiveness of our fraud detection system, enabling informed decision-making and potential improvements. This project emphasizes the importance of data-driven approaches in addressing the ongoing challenge of app fraud detection.

articleTitle: Sustainable Cultivation of Algae for Renewable Fuel Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Biofuels are the alternate type of fuel and which completely carbon neutral fuel. The fuel produced from the algae are the Third-generation fuel. The proposed process involves the cultivation of algae in a sustainable manner. The process involves separation of biomass from the cultivated algae, dried and extracting oils and lipids for fuel production using chemical/physical methods. The Bagasse (i.e., the dried material after extracting the oil from the algae biomass) can be used as a manure as it has high nitrogen and protein content. The system monitors the growth of the algae with various sensors, it monitors the CO2, Light intensity, Optical Density, Humidity and Temperature of the Bioreactor. These data are collected and processed with the help of IOT.

articleTitle: “Dual Tone Multi Frequency for Home Automation”
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Home automation system achieved great popularity in the last decade and it increases the comfort and quality life. In this paper, a model of electric machine control device through SMS by utilizing GSM is proposed. GSM convention was picked on the grounds that it doesn't rely uponcell phone stages. GSM SIM 900A and Arduino Uno for controlling a hand-off module were used here. Hand-off module worked as perorders given through SMS and cell phone at that point got the input of the summon. The concept of serial communication and AT-commands has been applied toward development of smart DTMF based home automation system. Home owners will be able to receive feedback status of any home appliances under control whether switched on or off remotely from their mobile phones. The Dual Tone Home Automation system represents a paradigm shift in the way homeowners interact with and control their living spaces. This innovative solution merges aesthetics and functionality by seamlessly integrating dual-tone design elements with cutting-edge home automation technology. This abstract provides an overview of the key components and benefits of the Dual Tone Home Automation system. The system comprises a sophisticated network of smart devices, including lighting, security, and entertainment systems, all meticulously designed to harmonize with the dual-tone interior and exterior design of modern homes. This integration is achieved through a centralized control hub, enabling homeowners to effortlessly manage and customize their living environment. Functionality-wise, the Dual Tone Home Automation system offers homeowners unprecedented control over their living spaces. With the convenience of a mobile app or voice commands, users can adjust lighting intensity, set preferred room temperatures, monitor security cameras, and even curate immersive entertainment experiences. Moreover, the system employs advanced AI algorithms to optimize energy usage, promoting sustainability and cost-efficiency.

articleTitle: An Overview of Machine Learning for Mechanical Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The international economy is undergoing continual change. Machine learning has the potential to transform several sectors, including mechanical engineering. Implementation has already started, with a current emphasis on specific application scenarios and how to implement them. Machine learning offers a number of innovative and fascinating methods, especially for applications in mechanical engineering. The available knowledge will help to significantly increase the systems' quality, efficacy, and adaptability. User area units now have new business models. Machine learning makes sure that data technology and software are gradually becoming the main forces behind innovation in mechanical engineering applications. In a number of industries, the growing interchangeability of individual machines may indicate that in the future, supplemental services in particular rather than just the machine itself may be in high demand. It also explains why many specialized fields of engineering scientific application have machine learning on their agenda, including management

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Brain Tumour Detection: A Systematic Review of Segmentation and Classification Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: A brain tumour is an abnormal development of brain tissue that disrupts normal brain function. The proper diagnosis of a brain tumour relies heavily on its correct identification. This article discusses the pros and cons of recently developed technologies for diagnosing brain tumours. We propose a generic flow map that can be used in many different situations, including the detection of brain tumours. The many accessible datasets are given for use in evaluating brain tumour algorithms. There is a need for research that identifies brain tumours with decent efficiency and fair effort, therefore this article compares the performance of recent literature additions in terms of Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity, and time consumption.

articleTitle: Virtualization Using Docker Container for Reproducible Desktop Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: To overcome the conventional and traditional technique of sharing data by sending a file through a hard drive or even sending a file across the internet requires a third-party program or a medium (hardware). To eliminate the intermediary channel that we use to transmit and receive data (hardware and software for file sharing), we are streaming a desktop to the client's browser so they can access a common OS among them using Docker Container. The desktop that is being streamed to our browser (client side) is kept in a private container that can only be accessed with the credentials that we have (hostname, password). The hardware components may be modified to our liking, such as increasing the RAM capacity, storage size, and container lifetime. This allows us to commercialize it as a product that contains all of the peripheral software and can be deployed wherever we want, for example. Simply put, our concept is inspired by Google Suite, but instead of distributing online apps, we are attempting to stream a whole operating system through a browser. Which will provide enough storage as requested by the client.

articleTitle: A Study on Aggregator Business Model for Instant Grocery Delivery Services
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This study is to understand the preferences of the general public while using online Instant delivery services. Data was collected from 105 respondents through an online survey. Factor analysis is done to find how a set of preferences vary based on various factors like Age group, gender, Average monthly grocery spend, their current purchasing practice. Independent sample t-test is done to find significant difference in responses of different age groups and also with people who are already using and those not used the services, with respect to various factors listed in the survey. The study gives suggestions based on the various factors that the public give preferences while purchasing groceries using Online grocery delivery services. It emphasizes the potential of Aggregator business model to be successfully implemented for the Instant grocery delivery business.

articleTitle: Enhancing Gesture Recognition: Exploring CNN-LSTM Networks for Dynamic Dual- Hand Gestures
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Various hand, lip, and facial gestures are often used by millions of people who have speech and hearing difficulties to communicate. Indian Sign Language (ISL) has a highly extensive vocabulary that differs from region to region. There is no publicly available dataset on serial gestures for ISL. The dynamic hand gesture dataset, which the authors have made public, is broken down into 33 categories, including days of the week, months of the year, and gestures used frequently. This dataset was compiled using a burst shot data gathering technique. A smaller portion of the dataset is used to enable fast examination, with 12 classes representing the 12 months of the year. It is somewhat intricate due to its recommendations, and each category often contains 5–6 movements. The method for installing the particular neural network on hardware is also covered in this publication. The suggested concept is designed to run on hardware that consumes less power. The proposed model is further compared with other sequential architectures to find the best model for hand gesture motion detection.

articleTitle: Forecasting Cyber Intrusions Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Because of the integration of physical processes, computer resources and communication capabilities, cyber physical systems (CPS) have evolved greatly in a variety of dynamic applications. But, these systems are seriously in danger from cyberattacks. Algorithms must be changed to spot these attacks in these systems, in contrast to issues that arise from accidents. It should be highlighted that employing machine-learning algorithm is critical to making it easy to analysing, appraise, and uncover hidden patterns in data due to the information produced by these devices is produced in massive quantities, with such a wide diversity, and at such a rapid rate.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Classification Using Different Transfer Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Heart diseases are becoming more common daily, especially among the older population. Therefore, an automated detection system is necessary to avoid the life-threatening effects of heart disease (HD). Early identification of heart problems may be determined by an automatic system, which specialists in the medical field use. In the past days, different diseases were detected by manually identifying features from the Electrocardiogram signal (ECG). However, the latest study has shown that information extraction and categorization may be done independently by employing deep learning (DL) neural networks. To develop efficient DL models, massive amounts of information are necessary; this is not the case for physiological signals. Therefore, in terms of transfer learning, both the recognition and categorization of heart diseases are considered. In this work, we have used eight transfer learning (TL) models to classify HD based on the information gained from millions of data that are applied to our data set. Various TL models are evaluated based on accuracy, layers, optimizer, and signal-to-image conversion method.

articleTitle: Detection of Brain Tumour By Segmenting the Magnetic Resonance Image Using K-Nearest Neighbour Algorithm and Compare the Sensitivity and Accuracy With Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The main objective of this research is to use the “K-Nearest Neighbour” (“KNN”) algorithm to detect brain tumours in MRI images and to compare its sensitivity and accuracy to that of the “Convolutional Neural Network” (“CNN”)algorithm. Brain tumours were identified in MRI scans using the “KNN” and “CNN” algorithm, and the sensitivity and accuracy of the identified images were compared. Group 1 with 20 samples using “KNN” and Group 2 with 20 samples using “CNN” were analysed by compiling the entire dataset of 40 samples with 80% of pretest power. Pursuant to the simulation, the “KNN” algorithm has a 95% sensitivity to detect brain tumours, whereas the “CNN” approach has a 90% sensitivity to do so. While “CNN” algorithm only diagnoses brain tumours with 84.10% accuracy, “KNN” algorithm does so with an accuracy of 98.5%.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Smart Alert System for Driver Drowsiness
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Road transportation is one of the primary mode of transportation, used by people to travel on a daily basis. Since this mode of transportation is cost-effective, it also makes drivers to transport goods and commodities in highways, especially during night time. These factors result in a profound amount of road accidents. Road accidents remains to be a global concern resulting in innumerable fatalities and injuries. Many of these accidents are caused by driver drowsiness, which is a major issue that requires immediate actions. Using machine learning technology, camera can be used to capture and monitor various driver-related parameters including eye movement and mouth movement to predict the drowsiness and yawning state of the driver. Dlib's pre-trained model is used to detect the facial features of the driver. The pre-trained model use CNN algorithm internally to detect the face. The Mouth Aspect Ratio (MAR) and Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR) is calculated and accordingly alerting the driver to prevent road accidents manifold.

articleTitle: Communication Network Rapid Fault Detection Restoration System For Reliable Underground Distribution OFC Using Modern Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This research paper explores the advancements in communication network infrastructure, focusing on the development of a novel system called the Communication Network Rapid Fault Detection Restoration (RNDFR) system. The objective of this system is to ensure reliable underground distribution of Optical Fiber Cables (OFC) by leveraging modern technology. The paper discusses the key components and features of the RNDFR system, including fault detection techniques, monitoring and alerting mechanisms, remote sensing technology, automated restoration processes, centralized control and management, data analytics, and predictive maintenance. The research highlights the potential of the RNDFR system to revolutionize underground communication networks, minimizing downtime and maximizing service reliability.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Signature-Based Components in Hybrid Intrusion Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: In cybersecurity, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) protect against emerging cyber threats. Combining signature-based and anomaly-based detection methods may improve IDS accuracy and reduce false positives. This research analyzes hybrid intrusion detection systems' signature-based components' performance and limitations. The paper begins with a detailed history of signature-based detection methods responding to changing threat situations. This research analyzes signature databases to determine their capacity to identify and guard against current threats and cover known vulnerabilities. The paper also examines the intricate relationship between signature-based detection and anomaly-based techniques in hybrid IDS systems. This investigation examines how these two methodologies work together to uncover old and new attack strategies, focusing on zero-day vulnerabilities and polymorphic malware. A diverse dataset of network traffic and attack scenarios is used to test. Detection, false positives, and response times assess signature-based components. Comparative examinations investigate how signature-based detection affects system accuracy and efficiency. This research illuminates the role of signature-based aspects in hybrid intrusion detection systems. This study recommends integrating signature-based detection techniques with anomaly-based methods to improve hybrid intrusion detection systems (IDS) at recognizing and mitigating various cyber threats.

articleTitle: Raspberry-Pi Based Exigence Informer
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Through calls and text messaging, people can inform others using mobile phones. The phone battery may occasionally run out, the user may be preoccupied with another conversation, or bandits may steal the phone. This paper is concerned about the manner in which and whom to alert. A device is created using a Raspberry Pi to prevent this. By identifying gestures and using voice commands, the emergency message is transmitted. The apparatus has a microphone that receives spoken commands and transmits messages of emergency. A similar emergency message is prepared and transmitted to the social media app Telegram when the camera detects certain hand gestures. The telegram bot is added after the group is created. The gadget is easy to use and has a hotspot connection capability. The group can include buddies and significant individuals. Within a few seconds, the message is sent to the entire group. It can undoubtedly be used as a speed substitute.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Computer Architecture for Signal Processing Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: For many applications, reconfigurable computing is becoming more appealing. Architectures, design approaches, and applications are all covered in this study of reconfigurable computing. The Altera Stratix II and Virtex 4 FPGA processors mentioned in this article are examples of recent advances in reconfigurable architectures. There are two types of design methodologies: general purpose and specific purpose. Data encryption, video processing, network security, and image production are just a few examples of the applications driving reconfigurable technology. This report examines the progress made in academic research and commercial development in reconfigurable computing for DSP systems over the last fifteen years. ASICs, PDSPs, and other DSP implementation media are all examined in this study in order to comprehensively detail the range of design options available to system engineers. Many DSP applications, including video, audio, speech, and control, are still years away from utilising reconfigurable computing to its full potential. demonstrates how the FFT algorithm can be pipelined over a two-level reconfigurable array of arrays in a variety of ways, depending on the application requirements. The performance of this processor when combined with a reconfigurable system with a GPP (General Propose Processor) and commercial DSPs is compared in various circumstances. The Architecture purposed reduces power and speeds up the execution of programmes, according to experimental results.

articleTitle: Reimagining Altruism in the Technological Era: Nurturing Societal Welfare and Contributions Through Collaborative Digital Platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: This demonstrates a digital tool that allows people to make contributions of things like food, clothing, literature, and support for non-binary gender centers while also promoting charitable giving. Technology offers a framework for streamlined participation, bridging the gap between enthusiastic volunteers and NGOs. Volunteers create profiles exhibiting their skills, while NGOs monitor profiles, provide opportunities, and interact with volunteers. The mobile-friendly application takes donations of physical items and features sections for feedback, event management, and communication. The platform promotes volunteer-NGO collaboration, provides privacy controls and essential resources for centers that need them, and is based on the belief that by helping others, we may improve their lives and promote a collaborative and considerate society.

articleTitle: AI-powered Traffic Lights
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: With the ever-increasing population, automobiles production and sales have seen a massive percentage increase. With the increase in production, there has also been an increase in traffic congestion. Most of the traffic occurs because of the inefficient traffic light systems in intersections where several streams of traffic need to cross each other. Present-day traffic signals are operated in three ways, either the signals are based on timers or a manual controller who regulates the signal or an actuated signal. Traffic jams cause many environmental issues such as air pollution which leads to Global warming as well as many respiratory problems. The proposed system gives a solution to traffic congestion by using the cameras in signals, determining the traffic density in each lane, and assigning priority to each lane to be cleared. The traffic density of each lane is determined by pre-trained machine learning algorithms. This system is also cost-effective since we need not install any additional hardware technologies* (IR sensors, proximity sensors) instead use the existing cameras that are already installed. The system assigns lanes with emergency vehicles (Ambulances, Firetrucks, etc.) with the highest priority irrespective of the lane's traffic density. The system focuses on reducing the travel time of vehicles and optimizing traffic flow, which in turn reduces the usage of natural resources.

articleTitle: Role of Internet of Things in Renewable Energy Sources: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Recent advancements have involved the use of intelligent, digitally based control systems to convert energy into finished goods. In today's businesses, everything is managed and observed by computerized systems because of the quick and high-quality production methods. Automation has grown important in industries because it incorporates a large number of sensors and controls due to its integration into systems. Furthermore, with the help of these ancillaries and the internet, all the data has been transmitted and recorded. When the internet of things is used, the performance of the sensors and controllers is more accurate and efficient. But with real-time decision-making, IoT-enabled renewable energy solutions guarantee productivity, controls, optimal output, and lower costs. This work's goal was to examine how the Internet of Things (IoT) is used in the renewable energy industry, a topic that has been extensively covered in the literature.

articleTitle: AI Based Warehouse Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Efficient warehouse management is a crucial factor for optimising the complex logistics and supply chain operations of modern industries. Even though there has been significant advancement in automation and optimization, there is a noticeable gap in research when it comes to addressing the complex challenges of adapting and ensuring the secure transportation of goods in warehouses. This research paper presents an innovative solution to bridge this gap, offering a comprehensive approach that integrates Artificial Intelligence(AI), Ant Colony optimization(ACO), robotic arm integration and ultrasonic sensor for obstacle detection for the efficiency of obstacle detection and safer goods transportation. Traditional warehouse management systems often depend on static vehicle control strategies which result in suboptimal resource utilisation and occasional collisions in the warehouse. To comprehensively address these challenges, our system integrates AI and ACO principles to optimise vehicle routing paths, thus minimising travel time. A unique feature of our approach is to include an ACO algorithm to facilitate adaptive vehicle speed control, ensure safe warehouse floor navigation and avoid collision with both stationary and moving objects Moreover, our system integrates a robotic arm into the warehouse environment, which includes flexibility in material handling. In addition this enhances the overall efficiency and adaptability of warehouse operation with evolving demands in modern industries. This research paper presents a solution to contemporary warehouse management challenges utilising AI, ACO and ultrasonic sensors for obstacle detection and robotic arm integration. The adaptive speed control mechanism optimises the vehicle route and provides the safety of goods.

articleTitle: Intelligent Smart Trolley System Using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: By using the idea of Arduino to connect all the items in the grocery store, and automated smart shopping system is created. This work aims to create a trolley using an RFID reader for automatic supermarket. To make the transaction more comfortable, a trolley is equipped with an RFID reader and electrical hardware system. The RFID card, whose price is fixed into the reader, fixes those products that are about the specific quality. When an item is displayed to the reader, its description is added to the purchase bill and displayed on the LCD screen. The billing is made even faster and takes less time because all the data is updated to the webpage for billing updates through an Arduino.

articleTitle: Crack Detection for Metal Surfaces Using Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The walls of metal surfaces may crack due to environmental changes and subpar surface materials, it is necessary for upkeep as well as exposure that is ongoing and will adversely impact the ecosystem. Cracks are one of the first indications that a substance or metal surface is degrading. Manual process has several drawbacks, such as the crack's invisibility, the time commitment, and the total reliance on the expertise of the specialist. In order to replace manual testing, automatic image-based fracture detection is applied, which is less expensive than the manual method. The causes of cracks and methodologies or techniques used to locate the location where cracks are formed are both clearly described in this paper with examples of inputs and outputs. To determine how well the proposed uses DL algorithm works and how well it addresses the shortcomings of the current manual method, it has been tried against a variety of metal crack images. In this system, Fuzzy K-Means and the Alex Net algorithm are the two primary algorithms. The Fuzzy K-Means algorithm is used for removal of front ground and background images and Alex Net algorithm is used for the detection of the algorithm is intended to serve a variety of needs by estimating the crack's characteristics so that the bricklayer can take the appropriate action to prevent the deterioration of aircraft structures. The result of this model shows whether there is any crack in the system and the place where the crack is present in the image.

articleTitle: Criminal Activity Detection and Prevention Using CCTV Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The mere presence of CCTV cameras can deter crime by making criminals think twice about committing an offense. This is because they know that they are being watched and that their actions may be recorded. CCTV footage can be used to identify criminals after a crime has been committed. This can help the police to apprehend the criminals and bring them to justice. CCTV footage serves as valuable evidence in criminal investigations. Recorded video can provide crucial details about events, timelines, and individuals involved, helping law enforcement agencies to identify suspects and gather evidence for court proceedings. By deterring criminal activities and aiding in the swift identification and apprehension of suspects, CCTV cameras contribute to preventing crimes from occurring or escalating. This can lead to safer communities and reduced crime rates. Machine learning-based CCTV crime detection systems can be used to analyze large amounts of CCTV footage in a short amount of time. This means that they can be used to monitor large areas, such as cities or airports.

articleTitle: Classification of Motor Imagery EEG Using Functional Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are a technology that offers the consumer an opportunity manner of communicating with computers. Implementation of a BCI system involves measuring the electrical activity of the brain (EEG) and converting it into output commands. EEG with the mental simulation of hand movements (Motor Imagery EEG) can be used for BCI. In this proposed work the recorded Motor Imagery EEG of several subjects is taken as a database, and the signals are pre-processed by applying filters. Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) and CSPL are extracted. By varying the filter value from 5–15 Hz, for a single subject, 150 samples were recorded from 15 channels with a minimum of 14 features taken as input to the Classification Learner. Optimizable SVM is used for Classification. The classification accuracy is high at 76% when the filter value is 7.

articleTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: The Advanced Head-light Control System (AHCS) seeks to automatically change the vehicle's headlamp beam in horizontal direction to as fully illuminate the curving road is possible without upsetting other motorists. Here, the steering wheel serves as the foundation of our suggested solution for the horizontal headlamp adjustment. The mechanism makes, advantage of the two lights. There are two lights: one for the far-reaching beam and the other for the nearby beam. When the car is traveling below the limit of speed, the lower light (for low beam light) is going to be on, and when it is traveling beyond the threshold speed, the upper light (for high beam light) is going to be on. The threshold figure that we used was 50 Kmph. The microcontroller receives an output from the steering wheel, and depending on whether the wheel is turning to the right or left, it drives the headlight in that direction. On the DC motor, the headlight is mounted. During the conceptualization stage, a few factors included the components' accuracy, dependability, and availability.

articleTitle: Automata Bin
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Waste management and segregation is one of the most essential components of the sanitary process but the people are still unaware about the types of wastes and its method of disposal. To ensure the masses gets awareness as well as the garbage gets segregated and disposed correctly. This work focuses on designing a smart IoT based dustbin which scans the image of the garbage in real-time and compare it with the pre-defined data on the system. Then, it is classified into different categories by utilizing a combination of computer vision and an image classification machine learning algorithm based on Tensor Flow library together. The real time image of the trash is compiled by the ML model using OpenCV library. This model works by cross referencing the given data to the labelled dataset of the model. Since this model utilizes labelled data for classification the results produced will be more accurate compared to other such methods. The model is trained using 100 epochs and hence results in more accurate results. The segregation of waste at the initial step can reduce the burden on the garbage collectors, improves the recycling rate and promotes sustainability.

articleTitle: IoT Smart City Air Quality Monitoring System Using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Computing and Control for Engineering and Business Systems (ICCEBS)
abstract: Many factors, including population growth, increased vehicle use, industrialization, and urbanisation, have contributed to an increase in pollution levels throughout time, which has a negative impact on human wellbeing by adversely affecting the health of those exposed to it. To keep an eye on In this project, we'll build an IOT-based air pollution monitoring system that will track the air quality via an internet-connected web server and sound an alarm whenit drops below a certain threshold, which occurs when harmful gases like CO2, smoke, alcohol, benzene, and NH3 are present in sufficient quantities. On the LCD and on the website, the air quality will be displayed in PPM for easy monitoring. You can use your mobiledevice to check the pollution level as part of this IOT project from anywhere.
